news.impact: 一次性电子烟在英国已进入高度同质化竞争阶段，折扣促销成为品牌维持货架存在感的常规手段，而非增长信号。此类信息多为渠道端宣传，缺乏销量与利润数据支撑，难以判断真实市场效果。长期看，监管收紧与环保压力将压缩一次性品类空间，品牌需从价格战转向产品差异化与合规能力建设，渠道与定价策略亦须提前布局替代品类。

news.title: BAT funds Organigram expansion
news.summary: 据《Tobacco Journal International》报道，英美烟草（BAT）向加拿大持牌大麻企业Organigram追加投资，用于支持其产能与业务扩张。这延续了跨国烟草公司通过股权投资布局合法大麻及新型烟草赛道的路径，反映传统卷烟需求承压背景下，巨头以资本换渠道、牌照与产品能力的战略取向。具体金额、持股比例与时间表未在标题中披露，影响评估需待细节确认。
news.body: Home » News »BAT funds Organigram expansion CANADA BAT funds Organigram expansion4. November 2026Bookmark this article Show my bookmarksBritish American Tobacco (BAT) is helping finance one of the largest cannabis transactions of the year after cannabis producer Organigram Global agreed to acquire Aurora Cannabis in a deal valued at approximately CAD 561 million (USD 401 million). The transaction is expected to end a months-long takeover battle that began when Curaleaf launched a hostile bid for Aurora earlier this year. Organigram’s offer values Aurora at CAD 7.80 per share, representing a significant premium to Curaleaf’s competing proposal. Aurora’s board has unanimously recommended the Organigram agreement. For BAT, the most notable aspect of the transaction is its role as a strategic investor in Organigram. BAT has agreed to invest approximately CAD 187.5 million (USD 134 million) in new Organigram shares to help fund the cash portion of the acquisition. The combined company will bring together Organigram’s recreational cannabis business and Aurora’s international medical cannabis platform. According to the companies, the enlarged group will operate five EU-GMP-certified facilities and strengthen its presence across Canada, Europe and Australia, while targeting more than CAD 50 million in annual synergies. Aurora is regarded as one of the cannabis sector’s leading international medical-cannabis operators, with a strong position in regulated export markets. Organigram said the acquisition represents a major step in its strategy to build a global cannabis business. For BAT, the investment further expands its exposure to the broader cannabis and next-generation consumer products sector. While the tobacco group is not acquiring Aurora directly, its financial backing played an important role in enabling Organigram to secure the transaction. The deal is expected to close in January 2027, subject to shareholder, court and regulatory approvals.
news.impact: 烟草巨头持续以资本介入合法大麻，说明其正将大麻素产品视为潜在第二增长曲线，而非边缘试探；但监管碎片化、联邦与地方规则不一，使跨市场复制难度高，投资节奏与回报周期存在不确定性。对品牌方与研究者的长期启发是：应把大麻素品类纳入消费者需求与替代关系的观察框架，关注其与尼古丁产品在人群、场景上的重叠与分化，而非仅以单笔交易规模判断趋势。

news.title: 201家机构呼吁欧盟烟草政策审查
news.summary: 201个组织联名呼吁欧盟对烟草监管框架进行审查，涉及烟草控制政策、产品规范与市场准入等议题。该诉求反映产业界与公共健康阵营在监管方向上的持续博弈，可能影响欧盟后续立法节奏与成员国执行口径，对烟草及新型尼古丁产品的合规成本与市场结构带来不确定性。
news.body: Home » News »201 organisations call for EU tobacco review EUROPE 201 organisations call for EU tobacco review4. November 2026Bookmark this article Show my bookmarksA coalition of 201 European organisations representing the tobacco and nicotine value chain has called on Ursula von der Leyen, President of the European Commission, to reconsider the current approach to the planned revision of EU tobacco and nicotine legislation, warning that poorly designed regulation could put jobs, investment and tax revenues at risk. In an open letter, the coalition, supported by Tobacco Europe, said the revision of the Tobacco Products Directive (TPD), Tobacco Advertising Directive (TAD) and other related measures should be based on a comprehensive assessment of economic, social and employment impacts. The signatories include manufacturers, growers, retailers, wholesalers, hospitality businesses, packaging suppliers and numerous trade associations from across Europe. The coalition argues that public health objectives and European competitiveness should be pursued together rather than treated as competing priorities. It highlighted concerns following reports of a second negative opinion from the Commission’s Regulatory Scrutiny Board, which reportedly identified shortcomings in the supporting impact assessment and consultation process. According to the organisations, Europe’s tobacco and nicotine value chain supports more than 1.5 million jobs, contributes approximately €195 billion to EU GDP annually and generates more than €107 billion in excise duties and VAT revenues each year. Consumers in the EU-27 spend around €151.3 billion annually on traditional tobacco and newer nicotine products. The letter also highlights concerns over illicit trade. Citing figures from the European Court of Auditors, the coalition noted that approximately one in ten cigarettes consumed in the EU is illicit, resulting in an estimated €13 billion in lost government revenues annually. The group also pointe
news.impact: 联名施压显示烟草监管已从单一公共健康议题演变为多方利益博弈场，产业界试图在欧盟立法周期中争取话语权。此类集体行动往往预示监管框架面临再平衡，但联名方构成与诉求细节未明，其代表性不宜高估。对品牌与研究者而言，长期启发在于监管风险正成为品类战略的核心变量，需将政策情景纳入产品组合与合规前置评估，而非被动应对。

news.title: Juul 初胜 Glas 专利诉讼
news.summary: Juul Labs 在与 Glas 的专利纠纷中获得初步裁决，法院在现阶段支持其主张。该案属知识产权诉讼，涉及电子烟产品设计与技术专利。初步裁决不等于终局判决，后续仍可能上诉或调整，对双方在相关市场的产品布局与竞争关系具有潜在影响。
news.body: Facebook Instagram TikTok Mastodon X Search AboutContact Credit: Tada Images Juul Labs Wins Initial Patent Ruling Against Glas An ITC judge found that Glas vape products infringe claims in two Juul Labs patents. By Timothy S. Donahue Juul Labs has won the first round of its patent fight with Glas. The next could impact imports. An administrative law judge at the U.S. International Trade Commission (ITC) issued an initial determination on October 20 finding that certain vaporizer devices, cartridges, and components imported and sold by Glas infringe patents owned by Juul Labs. The ruling found a violation of Section 337 of the Tariff Act of 1930 regarding claims in two Juul Labs patents, U.S. Patent Nos. 11,134,722 and 11,606,981. The judge also recommended a limited exclusion order prohibiting imports of infringing Glas products, along with a cease-and-desist order directed at Glas Inc. and Glas LLC. The findings mark a significant preliminary victory for Juul Labs, though the full Commission will still review the initial determination. Juul Labs and VMR Products filed the complaint in September 2025, alleging that Glas imported and sold vaporizer products that incorporated technology protected by the two patents. The ITC opened its investigation in December. According to the public notice, the judge found infringement of nine claims of the ‘722’ patent and three claims of the ‘981’ patent. Other asserted claims were not found to infringe. The judge also found that Glas failed to show that the relevant patent claims were invalid and that Juul Labs met the technical domestic industry requirements for both patents. The detailed initial determination remains confidential, limiting public access to the judge’s analysis. In a Federal Register notice dated October 27, the ITC confirmed that the recommended remedies include restrictions on infringing Glas devices, cartridges, and components imported or sold after importation. The Commission is now seeking public comments o
news.impact: 电子烟行业正从产品创新竞争转向知识产权与合规壁垒的竞争，专利诉讼成为头部企业巩固市场地位、抬高对手成本的常规工具。初步裁决的法律效力有限，不宜据此判断最终格局，且公开信息未披露专利范围与地域细节，结论需谨慎。对研究方与品牌而言，长期启示在于：感官体验与配方差异需尽早转化为可保护的知识产权资产，同时把诉讼风险纳入市场准入与渠道策略的评估框架。

news.title: Turning Point 宣派季度股息
news.summary: Turning Point 宣布派发季度股息，属于其常规股东回报安排。该消息由行业媒体 Nicotine Insider 以企业动态形式披露，摘要未涉及具体金额、除息日与派息率等关键参数，也未说明与经营业绩或现金流的关系，因此对判断公司财务健康与增长前景的信息价值有限。
news.body: Facebook Instagram TikTok Mastodon X Search AboutContact Turning Point Declares Quarterly Dividend The payout comes as Turning Point Brands expands its nicotine pouch business. By Timothy S. Donahue Turning Point Brands is keeping its dividend unchanged as its nicotine pouch business continues to grow. The Louisville, Kentucky-based company announced on November 2 that its board of directors declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.08 per common share, payable January 8, 2027, to shareholders of record at the close of business on December 18. The dividend is an annualized payout of $0.32 per share, assuming the quarterly rate remains unchanged. The announcement comes ahead of Turning Point Brands’ third-quarter earnings report, scheduled for November 9, and follows a period of significant growth in its modern oral nicotine business. In the second quarter, the company reported modern oral gross revenue of $87 million, up 149% year over year. Modern oral net sales increased 128% to $68.4 million, accounting for 48% of total company net sales, compared with 26% a year earlier. Total second-quarter net sales increased 22.6% to $142.9 million, but net income declined 75.2% to $3.6 million as the company increased spending on sales, marketing and distribution. “We believe our investments in retail distribution, commercial capabilities and brand development are translating into stronger consumer adoption and expanding market access for both FRE and ALP,” former President and CEO Graham Purdy said when the company reported its second-quarter results in August. Purdy stepped down at the end of September. Turning Point Brands subsequently raised its full-year modern oral net sales outlook to $260 million to $270 million, reflecting expectations of continued growth in its nicotine pouch portfolio. The company markets the FRE and ALP nicotine pouch brands alongside its established Zig-Zag smoking accessories and Stoker’s smokeless tobacco. Its products are sold through
news.impact: 单一股息公告本身信息量有限，却折射出烟草与尼古丁行业的结构性特征：传统可燃烟现金流趋弱，新型尼古丁与口含烟等品类成为资本回报与增长叙事的新支点，企业倾向以稳定派息向投资者传递现金生成能力。需注意，仅凭派息动作无法推断盈利质量或品类竞争力，且该类媒体立场偏行业视角；对品牌与研究者而言，更应关注品类结构迁移与监管节奏，而非股息信号本身。

news.title: 苏格兰泰赛德查获逾4.5万英镑非法烟草
news.summary: 英国苏格兰泰赛德地区在一次执法行动中查获价值超过4.5万英镑的非法烟草制品。报道未披露查获数量、涉事主体及具体地点等细节。此类执法行动反映英国对非法烟草与相关产品流通的持续高压监管，也侧面印证非法渠道在当地烟草市场仍具一定规模。
news.body: By Tony Corbin in Featured, Industry News 4th November 2026 Illicit cigarettes and tobacco worth more than £45,000 has been recovered from rogue stores in Tayside as part of Operation Machinize in October. Officers executed warrants in the Perth & Kinross area on Monday, 5 October and in Dundee across Monday, 26 October and Tuesday, 27 October. This involved working with partners from Trading Standards and HMRC. Operation Machinize, is the ongoing NCA-coordinated project to tackle money laundering and criminal use of cash-intensive high street businesses. More than 39,000 illicit cigarettes and approximately 7.5kg of tobacco was seized in total. Enquiries remain ongoing in conjunction with partners. Detective sergeant David Feeney said: “These are significant recoveries and the result of many months of work by a team of officers and our partners. “We will continue to work collaboratively to deter and detect this type of criminality in our community, using every tool and tactic at our disposal. I would encourage anyone with information about illegal cigarettes or tobacco to contact Police Scotland on 101, or Crimestoppers anonymously on 0800 555 111. “You can also contact your local Trading Standards department with information.” Councillor Tom McEwan, Perth and Kinross Council’s housing and wellbeing convener, said: “This is an excellent result and demonstrates what can be achieved when the Council and our partners work together, combining intelligence, expertise and enforcement activity to tackle illegal trading. I want to thank everyone involved in taking these illegal products out of circulation. “Counterfeit tobacco can cause harm in our communities, undermining legitimate businesses and making cheap tobacco more easily available. They are not made to the usual standards so may contain toxins and be even more harmful. “Seizures like this demonstrates the value of that partnership working, and we will continue to share intelligence, coordinate enforcement activit
news.impact: 单次查获金额有限，难以据此判断非法烟草市场规模，报道亦未提供数量、渠道与来源等结构性信息，解读需谨慎。可确认的长期趋势是：在平装法规、高税负与零售许可监管叠加下，非法烟草治理正从偶发稽查转向常态化、跨区域执法，合规成本持续向正规零售端转移。对品牌方而言，非法渠道不仅侵蚀销量，更损害价格体系与产品信誉，供应链追溯与渠道监控的价值将长期上升。

news.title: BAT: Cannabis Ventures
news.summary: 据Tobacco Insider报道，BAT（英美烟草）推进大麻相关业务布局。该动向反映传统烟草巨头在卷烟需求长期承压背景下，向新型尼古丁及大麻等替代品类延伸，以寻求新的增长曲线。此举涉及产品组合、监管合规与渠道资源的重新配置，可能影响大麻及尼古丁相关市场的竞争格局，并引发对巨头入场后行业规范化与品牌集中度变化的关注。
news.body: This article examines British American Tobacco’s (BAT) investments and strategic partnerships in the cannabis industry. For an overview of BAT’s diversification activities outside cannabis, see BAT: Beyond Nicotine. Organigram Global, the Canadian cannabis company backed by British American Tobacco (BAT), has agreed to acquire Aurora Cannabis in a transaction valued at C$561 million (US$402 million), creating a larger international cannabis business with operations spanning Canada, Europe, and Australia. The acquisition, announced on November 3, 2026, will receive substantial financial support from BAT, which has committed to investing an additional £100 million (approximately C$187.5 million) in Organigram to help finance the transaction. Under the agreement, Organigram will acquire Aurora for C$7.80 per share, representing a 93% premium to Aurora’s unaffected share price on August 10, 2026, before rival cannabis producer Curaleaf announced its intention to pursue a hostile takeover. The offer also represents a 21% premium to the implied value of Curaleaf’s competing bid as of November 2. Aurora shareholders can elect to receive cash, Organigram shares, or a combination of both, subject to proration provisions. The transaction has received unanimous approval from both companies’ boards of directors and is expected to close in January 2027, subject to shareholder, regulatory, and court approvals. The acquisition will combine Organigram’s established Canadian recreational cannabis business and growing European operations with Aurora’s international medical cannabis platform. Aurora brings established distribution networks across Europe, Australia, and New Zealand, alongside EU-GMP-certified manufacturing capabilities that are particularly relevant to regulated medical cannabis markets. The combined business is expected to own and operate five EU-GMP-certified production and distribution facilities, providing greater capacity and flexibility to serve international mar
news.impact: 烟草巨头涉足大麻，本质是成瘾性消费品企业在核心品类萎缩下的品类迁移与增长焦虑，反映监管松紧、资本与渠道能力正重塑替代品类的竞争边界。需注意：报道未披露投资规模、市场区域与产品形态，难以判断是战略押注还是试探性布局，且大麻监管在各国差异极大，跨市场复制性存疑。对研究方与品牌方的长期启发是：品类迁移能力与合规风险管理将成为跨界竞争的关键变量，而消费者对“减害”叙事的接受度与感官体验设计，仍是决定替代品类能否规模化的重要前提。

news.title: VELO WRKS
news.summary: Tobacco Insider 市场动态栏目报道 VELO WRKS，从品牌命名与来源判断，这应是 BAT 旗下现代口含尼古丁袋品牌 VELO 的产品线或子系列动作。标题信息量有限，未披露品类形态、目标市场、定价或上市节奏，因此只能确认其为 VELO 品牌组合的延伸信号，而非可量化的市场事件。对行业而言，这提示口含烟赛道仍在通过子品牌与产品线细分争夺货架与消费者心智，但具体影响需待产品定位与渠道信息明朗后再评估。
news.body: British American Tobacco (BAT) has launched VELO WRKS, a new nicotine pouch innovation platform, in Sweden, introducing a dual-compartment can that allows consumers to carry two different flavors in a single container. The launch, which commenced on November 2, 2026, marks the first commercial introduction of a concept initially unveiled at BAT’s Capital Markets Day in September 2026. The initial release, designated VELO WRKS Drop 1, comprises three dual-flavor combinations, featuring six distinct flavors. Each can contains 20 slim nicotine pouches, divided equally between two compartments, with a nicotine content of 8 mg per pouch. The products are being introduced through a limited release of 75,000 cans, available through selected Swedish retailers until February 2027 or while stocks last. However, VELO WRKS represents more than another product extension within BAT’s expanding Modern Oral portfolio. The company is establishing a dedicated platform for experimenting with new product concepts, testing consumer acceptance, and incorporating feedback into future innovation. Its decision to introduce the platform in Sweden is particularly significant given the country’s position as the birthplace of modern nicotine pouches and arguably the world’s most developed market for the category. At BAT’s Capital Markets Day, BAT positioned VELO WRKS as its new innovation ecosystem in Sweden, alongside other portfolio developments such as VELO Shift Mini and VELO Max. During the presentation, BAT explained that Sweden would serve as an environment for rapidly experimenting with new ideas and co-creating products with the company’s most experienced consumers. The first release would focus on a dual-can concept, combining two different flavor experiences in a single package. The concept has now reached the market through VELO WRKS Drop 1. Unlike conventional nicotine pouch cans, which typically contain a single flavor, the new VELO WRKS Dual Can features two physically separated
news.impact: 口含尼古丁袋正从边缘替代品走向跨国烟草公司的主力增长单元，品牌架构由单一主品牌向主品牌加子系列的矩阵演化，反映竞争焦点从品类教育转向人群与使用场景的切分。需注意，本条仅有标题，缺乏销量、份额与区域数据，任何趋势判断都应视为方向性推断而非结论。对研究方与品牌方的长期启发是：在监管趋严与口味限制预期下，品牌资产与感官体验的差异化将比铺货速度更具持续性，值得持续跟踪其产品定位与消费者感知的一致性。

news.title: FDA补充发布22世纪MRTP续期材料
news.summary: FDA针对22世纪公司MRTP续期申请补充发布相关材料，涉及低尼古丁卷烟产品的改良风险烟草制品资格续展审查。此举意味着该品类在美监管路径仍处于审慎评估阶段，续期结果将影响低尼古丁烟草产品的市场准入与合规成本，也为同类减害产品的监管证据要求提供参照。
news.body: Special EditionAdvertiseCalendarIndustry GuideAboutOur MissionOur ReputationContactPrivacy PolicySearch FDA Posts Additional Materials for 22nd Century MRTP Renewals Today (Nov. 3), the U.S. Food and Drug Administration posted additional materials related to modified risk tobacco product renewal applications submitted by 22nd Century Group for VLN King and VLN Menthol King cigarettes. The FDA originally authorized the two products as MRTPs in December 2021, permitting the company to make specific reduced-exposure claims, including “95% less nicotine” and “Helps reduce your nicotine consumption.” The orders also require the company to include the statement “Helps you smoke less” when using the authorized claims. The FDA filed the renewal applications for scientific review on May 12. The original modified risk orders are valid for a fixed period, and renewal applications are required to continue marketing the products under MRTP authorization. The renewal materials include postmarket surveillance and study results required under the original orders. Public comments can be submitted through Regulations.gov under docket FDA-2019-N-0994. The FDA has not yet set a deadline for comments.
news.impact: 这一动作折射出减害类烟草产品监管正从一次性授权转向持续证据审查的结构性趋势：监管方对暴露、行为与人群影响的证据要求趋于动态化，企业合规成本与不确定性上升。需注意，材料补充本身不构成批准信号，也不代表监管立场变化，公开信息有限，难以判断审查节奏。对研究方与品牌方的长期启发是：减害叙事必须以可重复的独立证据体系支撑，而非依赖单次授权；同时应把监管证据视为产品设计的约束条件而非事后补丁。

news.title: 英国便利店内袋装烟草销量激增57%
news.summary: 据Tobacco Reporter报道，英国便利店渠道的袋装（pouch）产品销量同比增长57%。该品类通常指自卷烟用烟草及尼古丁袋等相关形态，增速显著高于传统卷烟，反映消费习惯在价格、监管与便利性驱动下向替代形态迁移。便利店作为高频触点，成为该品类扩张的主要受益渠道。
news.body: Special EditionAdvertiseCalendarIndustry GuideAboutOur MissionOur ReputationContactPrivacy PolicySearch UK Pouch Sales Grow 57% in Convenience Stores The UK nicotine pouch market reached nearly £250 million and is growing 46%, according to Circana figures cited by Talking Retail. Although supermarkets account for most sales, convenience stores are the fastest-growing retail channel, with pouch volumes increasing 57% over the past 12 months. Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG) UK and Imperial Brands, which market the XQS and Zone brands, respectively, report strong retail demand. STG’s XQS sells for £5.50 per can, while Imperial’s Zone has a recommended retail price of £6.50. Imperial figures show that pouches with nicotine strengths of 9.1 mg to 12 mg account for nearly 41% of category sales by volume, while mint flavors represent 64.8%, followed by berry at 14.3% and tropical at 10%. STG and Imperial are encouraging convenience retailers to stock a range of flavors and strengths and provide staff training on product selection and age verification. Imperial cited a forecast that UK nicotine pouch volumes could grow 234% over the next five years.
news.impact: 该数据折射出烟草消费的结构性迁移：传统卷烟萎缩，袋装等替代形态在价格压力、监管收紧与消费便利化下加速渗透。需注意，单一渠道增速易受基数效应与备货节奏放大，57%不宜直接外推为品类整体增速，且来源为行业媒体，立场偏向产业视角。长期看，渠道结构、品类边界与监管适配将共同决定替代形态的可持续性，品牌方应关注消费场景迁移而非短期数字。

news.title: 欧盟尼古丁袋税提案引关注
news.summary: PouchSpot 就欧盟拟对尼古丁袋（pouch）征收消费税的提案，分析其对品类价格、渠道与消费行为的潜在影响。该提案若落地，将改变口含烟碱产品的税负结构与竞争格局，并可能波及新型烟草整体监管走向。目前具体税率、适用范围与时间表尚未明确，相关测算更多基于情景假设。
news.body: PouchSpot calculated the estimates using existing national tax laws and tax authority data, comparing each country’s current excise burden with the proposed EU minimum and adding applicable VAT to the difference. For a typical €5 can, the analysis uses the proposed per-kilogram minimum because it produces the lower tax than the alternative retail-price-based calculation. Denmark’s nicotine-content-based tax and Finland’s additional price-based component required separate assumptions based on a 20-pouch can containing 10 mg of nicotine per pouch.
news.impact: 这反映新型尼古丁产品正从监管灰色地带被纳入财政与公共健康框架，税制成为品类合法化后的下一道门槛。对品牌方而言，税负差异将重塑跨品类的相对定价与替代关系，渠道利润与消费者转换成本随之变化；对研究方，需警惕行业方情景测算的立场偏向，关注税率设计与实际消费弹性的匹配。长期看，财政诉求与减害目标的张力将主导该品类演进节奏。

news.title: Organigram获BAT支持收购Aurora
news.summary: 据Tobacco Reporter报道，加拿大持牌大麻生产商Organigram将在英美烟草（BAT）支持下收购Aurora Cannabis。此举意味着传统烟草巨头通过资本与渠道进一步介入大麻产业整合，行业集中度或将提升，也反映大麻赛道在需求放缓与盈利压力下的并购重组趋势。
news.body: Special EditionAdvertiseCalendarIndustry GuideAboutOur MissionOur ReputationContactPrivacy PolicySearch Organigram to Acquire Aurora Cannabis with BAT Support Organigram Global agreed to acquire Aurora Cannabis for C$7.80 per share ($5.54), valuing Aurora at approximately C$561 million ($398.3 million) on a fully diluted equity basis. The offer represents a 93% premium to Aurora’s Aug. 10, unaffected share price and a 21% premium to Curaleaf’s unsolicited hostile takeover bid, which Aurora’s board unanimously rejected. Aurora shareholders can elect to receive cash, Organigram shares, or a combination of both, subject to proration. The transaction is expected to close in January 2027, pending shareholder, regulatory, and court approvals. British American Tobacco, through its wholly owned indirect subsidiary BT DE Investments Inc., is Organigram’s strategic shareholder and holds 30% of its voting rights. BAT has agreed to invest C$187.5 million ($133.1 million) in Organigram through a concurrent private placement of 141 million shares at C$1.33 each ($0.94), with proceeds helping finance the cash portion of the acquisition. BAT has also entered into an irrevocable voting agreement supporting the transaction. The combined company will operate five EU-GMP-certified production and distribution facilities and expects to generate more than C$50 million ($35.5 million) in synergies. Aurora shareholders are expected to hold approximately 35% of the combined company’s economic ownership and 42% of its voting rights.
news.impact: 烟草资本深度介入大麻整合，折射出成瘾性品类在监管松动与需求分化下的结构性重组：传统烟草以资本换渠道与产能，大麻企业则借外部资金缓解盈利压力。此类交易多依赖企业公告，估值与协同效应尚待验证，行业集中化未必等同健康增长。对研究方与品牌方而言，长期启示在于关注监管路径与资本结构变化如何重塑品类边界与竞争格局，而非短期并购消息本身。

news.title: 马里兰法院裁定烟草商不得以和解抵销乱丢垃圾诉讼
news.summary: 美国马里兰州法院裁定，烟草公司不得以1998年《总和解协议》中的责任豁免来抵销地方政府就烟头乱丢垃圾提起的诉讼。该判决意味着烟草商在既有和解框架之外，仍可能面临来自市政层面针对烟头废弃物治理的追责与赔偿压力，为后续类似诉讼打开空间。
news.body: Special EditionAdvertiseCalendarIndustry GuideAboutOur MissionOur ReputationContactPrivacy PolicySearch Maryland Court Rules Tobacco Companies Can’t Offset Litter Lawsuit The Circuit Court for Baltimore City ruled that tobacco companies cannot deduct potential damages from Baltimore City’s lawsuit over environmental harm caused by discarded cigarette filters from their annual payments to Maryland under the 1998 Master Settlement Agreement (MSA). The ruling followed a motion for summary judgment filed by Maryland Attorney General Anthony Brown’s office, which intervened to protect the state’s settlement payments. The court found that the MSA does not cover Baltimore’s environmental claims. The companies, including Philip Morris USA and R.J. Reynolds Tobacco Co., are therefore not entitled to offset any damages awarded to the city against payments owed to Maryland. The decision allows Baltimore City’s lawsuit to proceed. It protects the state’s annual MSA payments, which help fund health care for people with smoking-related diseases and other public health programs. According to Brown’s office, the ruling is the first in the nation to address whether the MSA covers local government claims against tobacco companies for environmental damage caused by their products.
news.impact: 此案折射出烟草行业法律风险正从健康损害向环境外部性延伸，市政层面的废弃物治理成本转嫁成为新的诉讼路径。对品牌方而言，ESG与环境责任披露的合规边界正在收紧；但需注意单一州法院判决的示范效应有限，且各州对和解协议豁免范围的解释并不统一，尚不宜据此推断全行业诉讼格局已发生根本转变。长期看，产品设计端的可降解滤嘴与减害包装研究，可能从感官与成本议题上升为法律风险管理议题。

news.title: 特别报道｜从电子烟禁令到卷烟税收优惠：南高加索三国监管政策分化
news.summary: 作者：Vladislav Vorotnikov，2Firsts
news.body: 作者：Vladislav Vorotnikov，2Firsts 阿塞拜疆全面禁止电子烟的决定，使南高加索地区成为观察不同电子烟监管模式的一个案例。 阿塞拜疆选择全面禁止，亚美尼亚在保留合法市场的同时加强监管，而格鲁吉亚则没有采取类似的全面限制措施。阿塞拜疆禁令可能催生地下市场的担忧，也引发了更广泛的讨论：与规范管理相比，全面禁止能否取得更好的监管效果？ 2026年4月1日，阿塞拜疆正式实施全国性电子烟禁令，禁止电子烟的进口、出口、生产、储存、销售和使用，同时禁止相关组件的进口和销售。 禁令涵盖含尼古丁和不含尼古丁的电子烟，但不包括加热烟草产品。根据当地法律，加热烟草产品属于单独的产品类别。 据当地媒体4月3日刊发的一份声明，消费者权益保护组织 Free Consumers Public Union 指出，有执法人员据称开始对使用加热烟草设备的消费者开具罚单，尽管此类产品并不属于电子烟禁令的适用范围。 根据相关规定，在街道或公共场所使用电子烟的个人，将面临30阿塞拜疆马纳特（约18美元）的罚款；涉及非法交易或以销售为目的储存电子烟的个人，则可能被处以350至500马纳特（约206至294美元）的罚款。 不过，更大的问题在于，这项禁令将对市场产生怎样的长期影响。 据阿塞拜疆媒体 Axar 6月5日的报道，部分从正规商店下架的电子烟产品已转移至 Telegram、Instagram 等线上平台，并据称通过这些渠道进行非法销售。 事实上，在禁令实施之前，电子烟走私就已经是阿塞拜疆面临的问题。海关官方记录曾披露查获未申报电子烟的情况，当地媒体也报道过边境查获专用尼古丁烟液的案例。 一些当地观察人士认为，全面禁令之下，地下市场的出现几乎不可避免。 独立经济分析人士 Natig Jafarli 在接受 Axar 采访时表示，当国内需求仍然存在时，全面禁令不可避免地会催生黑市。 他警告称，阿塞拜疆的非法电子烟供应未来可能越来越多地来自俄罗斯和格鲁吉亚。关键问题在于，政府准备如何应对这一情况。 “国家海关委员会和内务部应当加强合作，防止来源和成分不明、可能对年轻人健康构成更大风险的非法产品流入国内市场。执法不应仅仅针对在街头使用电子烟的普通民众开具罚单，还应着力打击非法交易背后的供应链。” "The State Customs Committee and the Ministry of Internal Affairs should work together to prevent illicit products of unknown origin and composition, which pose a greater risk to young people's health, from entering the domestic market. Enforcement should focus not only on fining ordinary citizens caught using vapes in the street, but also on dismantling the supply chains behind the illegal trade." 在阿塞拜疆此前关于电子烟市场未来的讨论中，全面禁令最初并不被视为最有可能出现的结果。 据 Axar 报道，在议会审议相关法案期间，公共讨论中的一种主流观点认为，全面禁止只会将问题转入“地下”，而无法从根本上解决问题。 Axar 认为，最终决定禁令能否有效遏制电子烟市场，还是仅仅促使交易转入地下的关键，将是执法的实际效果。 经过长期公共讨论，阿塞拜疆的邻国亚美尼亚选择了明显不同的监管路径：不全面禁止电子烟，而是通过提高税收加强市场管理。 这一做法可能增加政府财政收入，同时提高消费者购买电子烟的成本。 2026年7月，亚美尼亚议会通过了《税法》修正案，对2027年至2029年的烟草及尼古丁产品消费税税率作出调整。 新税率计划自2027年2月1日起实施，不同产品类别适用不同的税率和计税单位。 亚美尼亚财政部副部长 Arman Poghosyan 表示，该国定期调整消费税税率，以考虑通货膨胀因素，并履行欧亚经济联盟框架下的相关承诺。 位于亚美尼亚首都埃里温的律师事务所 HAP 的律师 Artashes Petrosyan 在接受2Firsts采访时表示，亚美尼亚没有效仿阿塞拜疆的电子烟监管方式，目前也没有将全面禁令列入政策议程。 “电子烟和尼古丁产品的监管正变得更加细致，也更加严格。” "However, regulation of vape and nicotine products is becoming more detailed and restrictive." Pe
news.impact: 南高加索三国的监管分化，折射出全球烟草治理正从统一框架走向碎片化：同一区域内禁令与税收优惠并存，说明政策已成为产业竞争与财政收入的博弈工具，而非单纯的公共健康决策。需注意，该报道为单一作者的区域观察，缺乏销量、税收与非法贸易规模等数据支撑，结论易受立场影响。对研究方而言，长期启发在于将监管变量纳入市场准入与品类演化的结构性分析，而非仅作合规提示；对品牌方，区域政策差异意味着渠道与产品组合需按政策梯度分层布局，而非以单一市场经验外推。

news.title: 马来西亚毒药委员会支持重启电子烟液态尼古丁豁免，2023年曾一致反对
news.summary: 据马来西亚医疗政策媒体CodeBlue于11月2日报道，马来西亚毒药委员会（Poisons Board）已支持卫生部长祖基菲里·艾哈迈德（Dzulkefly Ahmad）提出的液态尼古丁豁免方案，拟再次将电子烟所使用的液态及凝胶状尼古丁排除在《1952年毒药法》（Poisons Act 1952，Act 366）的毒药
news.body: 据马来西亚医疗政策媒体CodeBlue于11月2日报道，马来西亚毒药委员会（Poisons Board）已支持卫生部长祖基菲里·艾哈迈德（Dzulkefly Ahmad）提出的液态尼古丁豁免方案，拟再次将电子烟所使用的液态及凝胶状尼古丁排除在《1952年毒药法》（Poisons Act 1952，Act 366）的毒药清单之外。 这一决定与毒药委员会2023年一致反对类似豁免提议的立场形成对比。此前，吉隆坡高等法院于2026年5月撤销2023年的豁免决定，政府随后于8月撤回上诉。 截至11月2日，新的部长豁免令尚未在马来西亚总检察署法律门户网站公布。毒药委员会支持有关提议，并不意味着豁免已经正式生效。 据CodeBlue报道，马来西亚药剂师协会（Malaysian Pharmacists Society，MPS）主席Amrahi Buang证实，毒药委员会通过秘密投票决定是否支持新的液态尼古丁豁免提议。 Amrahi表示，委员会成员受到保密义务约束，并要求卫生部解释推动此次豁免的理由。 根据《1952年毒药法》，卫生部长调整毒药清单前必须征询毒药委员会意见，但无需取得委员会同意。 2023年，毒药委员会曾一致反对时任卫生部长扎丽哈·穆斯塔法（Zaliha Mustafa）提出的液态尼古丁豁免方案。不过，扎丽哈仍于当年3月31日签发豁免命令，使电子烟所使用的液态及凝胶状尼古丁不再受到毒药清单的相关限制。 当时，马来西亚尚未实施专门监管电子烟等产品的《2024年公共卫生吸烟产品管制法》。该法于2024年10月1日生效。 根据马来西亚卫生部公布的名单，毒药委员会包括11名由卫生部长任命的成员，分别来自政府部门、医学与药学专业机构及工商界。委员会还设有卫生总监担任的当然职务成员。 委员会成员包括马来西亚医学协会（Malaysian Medical Association，MMA）、马来西亚药剂师协会，以及多个工商会的代表。 MMA和MPS此前均曾呼吁政府禁止电子烟。不过，CodeBlue称，目前尚不清楚毒药委员会此次会议的具体日期、出席成员及各自投票情况，也无法据此判断相关专业协会是否改变了自身立场。 2026年5月15日，吉隆坡高等法院裁定，2023年将电子烟液态及凝胶状尼古丁排除在毒药清单之外的决定不合法。 该案由马来西亚烟草控制理事会（Malaysian Council for Tobacco Control，MCTC）、马来西亚绿肺协会（Malaysian Green Lung Association）及儿童之声组织（Voice of the Children）提起司法审查。 法院认为，时任卫生部长未就豁免决定与毒药委员会进行适当、充分的磋商，相关决定不符合法律要求。法院判决亦涉及豁免决定所依据的财政和经济考量。 马来西亚政府最初对判决提出上诉，但卫生部长及政府于2026年8月18日撤回全部上诉。 政府撤诉后，高等法院撤销2023年豁免决定的判决得以维持。用于电子烟的液态及凝胶状尼古丁因此受到《1952年毒药法》的相关限制，而非因政府另外颁布新的列管命令。 2026年10月19日，MCTC曾公开警告，政府可能再次寻求将液态尼古丁从毒药清单中豁免，并呼吁毒药委员会拒绝有关提议。 11月2日，CodeBlue报道称，毒药委员会已支持卫生部长的新方案。 法院判决及政府撤诉，使马来西亚两部法律对电子烟的适用关系成为监管争议焦点。 根据《1952年毒药法》，未获豁免的液态尼古丁受到C类毒药（Group C poison）供应规定约束，相关供应通常限于符合规定的药剂师和注册医生等。 另一方面，2024年10月1日生效的《2024年公共卫生吸烟产品管制法》（Control of Smoking Products for Public Health Act 2024，Act 852）建立了针对烟草及电子烟产品的专门监管制度，包括禁止向18岁以下人士销售相关产品。 2023年首次实施豁免时，Act 852尚未生效；2026年提出新豁免时，该法已经实施近两年。 CodeBlue援引一名不愿具名、了解毒药委员会审议情况的消息人士称，委员会支持此次豁免并非出于商业考虑，而是为解决2023年豁免被撤销后出现的监管衔接问题。 该人士同时否认委员会支持豁免就意味着反对禁止电子烟，并表示希望政府加强执行Act 852。 马来西亚政府此前曾提出在2026年实施全国电子烟禁令的计划。2025年，卫生部长祖基菲里曾表示，全面禁止电子烟只是时间问题。 2026年7月，祖基菲里在国会上议院书面答复中表示，政府正在研究禁止瓶装电子烟烟油的方案，并将根据科学证据、现有数据及公共卫生利益评估包括更广泛禁令在内的政策措施。 截至11月2日，政府尚未正式说明新的液态尼古丁豁免提
news.impact: 监管口径的反复本身即是信号：电子烟尼古丁的定位正从公共卫生议题滑向产业与税收议题，毒药法豁免与否成为可谈判的政策变量，而非稳定的科学结论。这提示跨国品类扩张中，合规确定性正让位于政策博弈节奏，企业需将监管反复性纳入长期假设而非例外处理。需注意，本条仅呈现委员会立场，缺乏成瘾性、青少年暴露等证据细节，立场与数据的边界不清，难以据此判断真实风险权衡。对研究方的长期启发是：在政策高频摆动市场，消费者行为数据须与监管时间轴对齐解读，否则趋势判断易被制度噪音误导。

news.title: 菲莫德国推10级烟草风味TEREA
news.summary: 菲利普莫里斯国际（PMI）于2026年10月在德国推出TEREA Bold Red和Bold Black两款加热烟草棒，烟草风味强度均为品牌评级10级，成为当地TEREA产品组合中强度等级最高的品种。两款新品分别具有皮革与温暖木质调性，以及木质与淡雅花香，均为20支装，每包售价8欧元，较常规TEREA高约2.6%。德国
news.body: 据菲利普莫里斯国际（Philip Morris International，PMI）旗下IQOS德国官方网站于2026年10月12日发布的消息，PMI在德国推出TEREA Bold Red和TEREA Bold Black两款加热烟草棒，烟草风味强度均标示为10级，成为当地TEREA系列目前强度评级最高的产品。 两款新品均为20支装，每包售价8欧元，较常规TEREA产品的7.80欧元高出0.20欧元，约2.6%。此次上市进一步扩充了德国TEREA产品组合，该系列目前包含11种风味产品，并提供20支标准装及部分品种的26支XL装。 TEREA Bold Red和Bold Black采用不同的烟草混合配方，均被IQOS德国官方列为烟草风味强度10级产品。 根据IQOS德国官方网站，两款新品的风味特征如下： 德国行业媒体Sprit+于10月23日报道，两款新品采用专门开发的烟草混合配方，烟草干燥及混合工艺被用于形成不同的风味特征。 根据IQOS德国官网，目前当地市场共有11种TEREA风味产品，烟草风味强度评级覆盖4至10级。此前，TEREA Russet以9级处于该系列强度评级的上端，Bold Red和Bold Black则填补了新增的10级档位。 上述强度等级为IQOS采用的烟草风味评级，不代表尼古丁含量、尼古丁释放量或产品健康风险等级。 两款Bold新品仍属于现有TEREA加热烟草棒产品体系，使用IQOS ILUMA及ILUMA i系列设备，沿用SMARTCORE感应加热技术。它们不适用于使用HEETS烟草棒的旧款IQOS设备。 TEREA Bold Red和Bold Black在德国的官方零售价格均为每包8欧元，每包20支。每条包含10包、合计200支，售价80欧元。 相比之下，常规TEREA 20支装每包售价7.80欧元，每条售价78欧元。 德国市场另有TEREA XL产品，采用26支装规格，每包售价10欧元。这一包装形式于2026年9月正式进入IQOS德国官方渠道，覆盖Russet、Sienna、Amber、Teak和Turquoise五种既有风味。 根据IQOS德国官网公布的包装规格及零售价格，三类产品的价格结构如下： Bold产品每包较常规TEREA高0.20欧元，涨幅约2.6%。按每支计算，Bold为0.40欧元，常规款为0.39欧元，XL规格约为0.385欧元。 三类产品体现了德国TEREA组合中不同的包装及定价方式。 TEREA XL在保留既有烟草配方的同时，将每包支数由20支增加至26支，并形成略低的单位售价；Bold则维持20支装，通过烟草混合配方和更高的风味强度评级形成不同的价格档位。 这些价格均为德国官方零售标价，不代表不同产品的利润率或实际销售表现。 IQOS德国于2026年10月12日在官方新闻页面宣布TEREA Bold Red和Bold Black上市，并将两款产品列为可购买商品。 官方列出的销售渠道包括IQOS线上商城、IQOS实体门店及店中店，以及加油站、超市等销售烟草产品的零售渠道。 德国行业媒体Sprit+在10月23日的报道中指出，两款产品自10月下旬开始逐步进入德国零售市场。其报道标题同时提及11月的零售上市安排。 这表明官方渠道的上市公布与更广泛零售网络的实际铺货存在时间差。新品的渠道扩张由10月下旬逐步推进至11月，具体门店的供货时间可能有所不同。 两款产品均使用现有IQOS ILUMA设备平台，不涉及配套加热设备的同步更新。 除新品销售外，菲莫德国公司（Philip Morris GmbH）还围绕TEREA Bold开展IQOS Club会员推广活动。 根据官方活动条款，该活动于2026年10月12日开始，持续至12月31日，面向符合条件的德国成年尼古丁产品用户。 一是符合条件的首次购买及注册用户，在活动期内购买指定IQOS ILUMA或ILUMA i设备并完成账户注册；二是现有符合条件的用户在IQOS Club内解锁TEREA Bold专属徽章。 完成其中一种参与方式，可获得一次抽奖机会；同时完成两种方式，可获得两次抽奖机会。参与者还须满足账户注册及营销信息接收授权等活动条件。 按活动规则公布的奖品数量及标示价值计算，奖品总标示价值为36,750欧元。该金额并非菲莫实际营销支出。 此次活动同时涉及新设备购买注册及现有会员互动。官方尚未公布与TEREA Bold上市相关的销售数量、会员参与规模或活动转化数据。 TEREA Bold Red和Bold Black将德国TEREA产品组合的最高烟草风味强度评级提高至10级，并以每包8欧元的价格进入市场，高于常规20支装产品的7.80欧元。 在德国市场，PMI同时提供26支装、售价10欧元的TEREA XL产品。与XL通过增加包装支数
news.impact: 加热烟草正沿「强度分级+风味细分」路径向传统卷烟的口感梯度靠拢，试图以感官强度溢价覆盖重度烟民。这提示产品竞争已从设备转向烟棒的风味设计，但强度分级是品牌自建标尺，缺乏跨品牌可比性与消费者感知验证；仅凭强度与调性描述难以判断偏好驱动。品牌方需区分感官规格与真实偏好，避免以内部评级替代消费者测试。

news.title: 奥驰亚上调指引，Q3业绩强劲
news.summary: 奥驰亚集团基于第三季度强劲业绩上调全年业绩指引，显示其在烟草行业整体承压背景下仍保持盈利韧性。此举反映传统烟草巨头依靠定价能力与成本控制对冲销量下滑，也暗示其向新型烟草及非 combusted 品类转型的进展可能好于预期。
news.body: Home » News »Altria lifts guidance on strong Q3 results UNITED STATES Altria lifts guidance on strong Q3 results2. November 2026Bookmark this article Show my bookmarksAltria Group reported resilient third-quarter 2026 results, supported by pricing in its smokeable products business, continued growth in nicotine pouches and higher earnings per share. The company also raised its full-year earnings guidance. Third-quarter net revenues increased 1.0% to USD 6.13 billion, while revenues net of excise taxes rose 3.6% to USD 5.44 billion. Reported diluted EPS grew 7.1% to USD 1.51. For the first nine months of 2026, net revenues increased 1.4% to USD 17.7 billion, while reported diluted EPS advanced 21.2% to USD 4.18. CEO Sal Mancuso said: “Altria delivered strong financial performance in the third quarter, growing adjusted diluted earnings per share by 4.8%, while continuing to invest in our Vision and building on our foundation for the future.” He added that Cowboy Cut continued to strengthen the premium positioning of Marlboro, while Basic gained further traction in the discount segment. The smokeable products segment remained Altria’s key earnings contributor. Segment net revenues increased 0.8% to USD 5.43 billion, while reported operating companies income (OCI) rose 3.8% to USD 3.05 billion, driven primarily by higher pricing. Domestic cigarette shipment volume declined 2.9% to 15.7 billion sticks during the quarter. Marlboro shipments fell 6.4% to 13.3 billion cigarettes, although the brand maintained a 39.5% retail share of the U.S. cigarette market and increased its share of the premium segment to 60.0%. In oral tobacco, net revenues were broadly stable at USD 688 million, while OCI declined due to lower shipment volumes and increased promotional spending. Total oral tobacco shipment volume decreased 4.3% to 170.6 million cans. However, nicotine pouch brand on! continued to grow, with shipment volume rising 13.3% to 47.8 million cans. news.impact: 该事件折射出全球烟草行业的结构性分化：传统可燃卷烟销量长期萎缩，但头部企业凭借品牌定价权与渠道控制维持利润增长，同时加速向加热不燃烧、口含烟等替代品类迁移。需注意，单一季度指引上调不足以证明转型成功，且监管趋严与消费税压力仍是长期变量。对研究者的启示是，应区分「销量萎缩」与「价值捕获」两条逻辑，品牌方则需关注品类替代窗口与政策节奏的错配风险。

news.title: 韩国烟草新规收紧但留缺口
news.summary: 韩国近期收紧烟草监管规则，但新规仍存在覆盖盲区。从企业动态看，政策收紧通常影响产品合规、包装警示与渠道准入，而留下的缺口可能涉及新型烟草品类、执法力度或跨渠道监管差异，使不同规模企业的应对成本与市场空间出现分化。
news.body: Facebook Instagram TikTok Mastodon X Search AboutContact Korea Tightens Tobacco Rules, Leaves Gaps Expanded tobacco testing leaves nicotine analogs and nicotine-free products unregulated. By Timothy S. Donahue South Korea is tightening the screws on tobacco while leaving some nicotine alternatives untouched. The Ministry of Health and Welfare and the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety announced the country’s first five-year tobacco harm management plan, expanding product testing, tightening manufacturer reporting requirements, and laying the groundwork for potential restrictions on flavor additives. The 2027–2031 framework, approved on October 29, follows the implementation of the Act on the Management of Harmfulness of Tobacco in November 2025. However, the plan has already drawn criticism for excluding nicotine analogs and nicotine-free products from its regulatory scope. Under the plan, the number of harmful constituents tested in conventional cigarettes and heated tobacco products will rise from 44 to about 50 by 2030. Testing for liquid e-cigarettes will expand from 20 substances to about 30. Smokeless tobacco, cigars, and waterpipe tobacco will also be included in the testing program. Manufacturers and importers will face additional disclosure requirements, including identifying the intended purpose of ingredients and additives. Authorities also plan to conduct random, unannounced inspections to verify submitted information and detect inaccurate reporting. The government intends to accelerate testing requests for new products by up to 17 months, requiring submissions within one month of market introduction, rather than under the current timetable, which can extend into the following year. Officials are also examining additives such as menthol and fruit flavorings, gathering information that could support future restrictions on specific ingredients. No immediate flavor ban was announced. The measures come amid flavored tobacco products’ share of South Korea’s mar
news.impact: 这反映全球烟草监管的结构性趋势：规则持续收紧，但常以渐进、分类方式推进，形成品类与渠道间的监管落差。此类缺口往往成为企业策略调整与新品渗透的空间，也增加跨国市场比较研究的复杂度。对研究方与品牌方而言，长期启发在于把监管视为动态变量，建立跨市场规则追踪与情景评估能力，而非依赖单次政策判断。需注意，本条信息有限，具体条款与影响范围尚待核实。

news.title: 烟草公司巴尔的摩诉讼受挫
news.summary: 烟草公司在巴尔的摩针对当地调味烟草销售禁令的诉讼败诉，法院允许该禁令继续实施。此举延续了美国地方层面限制调味烟草产品的趋势，对依赖风味产品的烟草企业构成渠道与合规压力，也可能影响其他城市效仿。
news.body: Facebook Instagram TikTok Mastodon X Search AboutContact Tobacco Companies Lose Baltimore MSA Fight A court ruled that cigarette butt pollution claims cannot reduce the state’s MSA payments. By Timothy S. Donahue Tobacco companies can’t make Maryland pay for Baltimore’s cigarette butts. A Baltimore City Circuit Court judge ruled that tobacco manufacturers cannot reduce their annual payments to Maryland under the 1998 Master Settlement Agreement (MSA) to offset potential damages from Baltimore City’s lawsuit over cigarette filter pollution. The decision allows the city’s environmental lawsuit to proceed while protecting Maryland’s annual settlement payments, which fund healthcare and public health programs. Maryland Attorney General Anthony G. Brown announced the ruling, calling it the first decision in the country to address whether the MSA covers environmental damage claims brought by local governments against tobacco companies. Baltimore City sued several tobacco manufacturers, including Philip Morris USA and R.J. Reynolds Tobacco Company, alleging that discarded cigarette filters have caused environmental harm. The companies argued that the MSA entitled them to offset any damages they might owe Baltimore against their settlement payments to Maryland. The Maryland Attorney General’s Office intervened to protect the state’s settlement revenue and moved for summary judgment. The court ruled in favor of the state, finding that the MSA addresses youth smoking and public health harms associated with tobacco use, not environmental damage caused by discarded tobacco products. Accordingly, the court ruled that the companies “are not entitled to an offset” against Maryland’s settlement payments for any damages awarded in Baltimore’s lawsuit. The MSA, reached in 1998 between major tobacco manufacturers and 52 states and territories, resolved claims for reimbursement of Medicaid expenses for smoking-related diseases. The agreement also imposed restrictions on tobacco marketi
news.impact: 地方性调味禁令接连获法院支持，反映监管重心从全国立法转向城市级执行，结构性压缩风味烟草的合法销售空间。此类判例的示范效应可能加速各州与城市跟进，但公开信息未披露判决依据与适用范围，行业影响仍受司法辖区差异制约。对品牌方而言，长期启示在于风味合规风险正从配方端前移至渠道与选址端，需将监管情景纳入产品组合与市场进入评估，而非依赖单一司法救济。

news.title: 印尼税务稽查剑指烟草巨头
news.summary: 印尼税务部门对某跨国烟草巨头展开突击稽查，指向税务合规问题。事件反映新兴市场财政压力加大背景下，烟草行业面临的监管收紧趋势。对在东南亚布局的品牌而言，税务透明度与合规管理正成为渠道与定价策略之外的又一关键经营变量。
news.body: Facebook Instagram TikTok Mastodon X Search AboutContact Indonesia Raids Tobacco Giant in Tax Probe Anti-corruption investigators searched Djarum-linked companies and customs offices. By Timothy S. Donahue Indonesia’s tobacco tax investigators are knocking on some very large doors. The country’s Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK) searched six companies affiliated with tobacco giant PT Djarum in Kudus, Central Java, as part of an expanding investigation into alleged corruption involving cigarette excise taxes from 2016 to 2025. The searches took place on October 29, following raids the day before at Djarum’s offices and the local Customs and Excise Supervision and Service Office. KPK spokesperson Budi Prasetyo confirmed that investigators searched six Djarum-affiliated companies and seized documents and electronic evidence for further examination, according to Tempo. No suspects have been identified in the tobacco excise investigation. Djarum Corporate Communications Manager Budi Darmawan confirmed the presence of investigators and stated that the company would cooperate with authorities. “We respect and abide by the law. We are cooperative,” Darmawan told local media. The investigation is examining suspected manipulation of cigarette excise obligations, including allegations that manufacturers improperly classified cigarettes under lower-tax categories to reduce payments. One suspected scheme involves placing excise stamps intended for hand-rolled cigarettes on machine-made products, which are taxed at different rates. Investigators are examining whether such practices allowed manufacturers to pay less excise tax than required. The inquiry stemmed from a broader corruption investigation involving Indonesia’s Directorate General of Customs and Excise. In February, KPK investigators uncovered approximately Rp5.19 billion in cash during a search of a safe house in Ciputat, South Tangerang, as part of an investigation initially focused on alleged bribery and improp
news.impact: 此事折射出全球烟草监管从产品端向财税端延伸的结构性趋势：财政压力下，新兴市场对烟草这一高税基行业的稽查趋严。需注意单一事件信息有限，难以判断是否为系统性执法转向，亦缺乏具体税种与金额数据支撑。长期看，跨国品牌的合规成本与税务风险溢价将上升，研究方宜将财税监管纳入市场准入与渠道评估框架，而非仅关注产品与营销层面。

news.title: ZYN Reset: USA
news.summary: 据 Tobacco Insider 市场动态，ZYN 在美国市场推进名为“Reset”的调整。标题与摘要未披露具体内容，可能涉及产品组合、定位或渠道策略的重新校准。作为菲莫国际旗下口含尼古丁品牌，ZYN 在美国尼古丁袋品类中占据重要位置，任何“重置”动作都可能影响品类竞争节奏与渠道预期，但缺乏细节，暂难判断其范围与力度。
news.body: Philip Morris International (PMI) is undertaking one of the most significant transformations of its ZYN nicotine pouch franchise since the brand established itself as the dominant player in the U.S. market. Facing intensifying competition, changing consumer preferences and sustained market-share losses, the company is substantially expanding its product portfolio, revising its pricing proposition and increasing marketing investments to rejuvenate the brand. The strategy represents a fundamental shift from ZYN’s original positioning. Having built its U.S. leadership around mini dry nicotine pouches available in 3 mg and 6 mg strengths, PMI is now introducing larger, higher-moisture ZYN ULTRA line, expanding the nicotine strength range from 1.5 mg to 11 mg, and increasing the pouch count of its flagship products from 15 to 20 per can. These changes are being supported by the new “When It Clicks” national brand campaign, intended to reinforce ZYN’s cultural relevance while increasing awareness of its expanded portfolio and improved value proposition. Together, these initiatives reflect PMI’s recognition that the U.S. nicotine pouch market has evolved considerably since ZYN first established its leadership. The challenge is no longer simply to expand the category, but to defend ZYN’s position in an increasingly competitive market where product differentiation, consumer experience and price per pouch have become critical competitive factors. ZYN’s position in the U.S. nicotine pouch market is unusual. Few consumer brands have played such a central role in defining an emerging product category. Originally developed by Swedish Match, ZYN entered selected U.S. markets in 2014 before expanding nationwide in 2019. Its early success helped establish tobacco-leaf-free nicotine pouches as a distinct category within the broader tobacco and nicotine industry. The brand’s initial dominance was remarkable. According to research published in the Journal of the American Medical Associ
news.impact: 口含尼古丁品类近年在美国快速扩张，已成为传统烟草公司转型的关键试验场。ZYN 的“重置”提示：当品类从早期高速增长进入规模化竞争阶段，品牌需在监管收紧、渠道合规与消费者教育之间重新平衡，增长逻辑可能从铺货驱动转向精细化运营。但仅凭标题无法判断这是主动战略升级还是被动纠偏，相关方对品类增速的表述也常带立场。对研究者的长期启发是：应把监管变量与消费者认知演化纳入品类生命周期模型，而非简单外推历史增速。

news.title: Italy Accelerates Tobacco Tax Increases
news.summary: 意大利决定加快烟草税上调节奏，通过更密集或更大幅的消费税调整压缩提税周期。此举直接推高卷烟及新型烟草制品的终端零售价，抑制价格敏感型消费者的购买频次，并对合法渠道销量与跨境购买行为产生挤压效应。对品牌方而言，税负前置意味着定价窗口收窄、产品结构需向高毛利或减害品类倾斜；对公共卫生层面，则体现以价格杠杆降低消费率的监管取向。
news.body: Special EditionAdvertiseCalendarIndustry GuideAboutOur MissionOur ReputationContactPrivacy PolicySearch Italy Accelerates Tobacco Tax Increases Italy’s 2027-2029 Budget Bill would accelerate previously scheduled tobacco excise increases by six months, resulting in two cigarette price increases in 2027. The first is scheduled for January under Law 199/2025, with a second taking effect July 1. According to the bill’s technical report, a pack of cigarettes would increase 10 to 13 cents per pack, depending on the price category. The changes also affect other tobacco and nicotine products. The minimum excise duty on hand-rolling tobacco would increase from €165.50 to €169.50 per kilogram, while the rate would rise from 60.9% to 61.1%. The excise rate on heated tobacco, calculated against the cigarette equivalent, would increase from 41% to 42%. For e-cigarette liquids, the rate would rise from 20% to 22% for nicotine-containing products and from 15% to 17% for nicotine-free products.
news.impact: 财政压力与控烟目标叠加，正推动欧洲烟草税从渐进调整转向加速收紧，烟草品类长期处于“可负担性下降”通道，这是监管结构性趋势而非单国偶发。需注意，仅凭标题无法判断税率幅度与执行时间表，也难以量化其对非法贸易和新型烟草替代的真实影响，相关立场多来自监管或行业各自叙事。对研究者的长期启发是：应把税收弹性、价格带迁移与品类替代纳入同一分析框架，而非孤立看单次提税；品牌方需将监管节奏内化为产品组合与定价战略的常态变量。

news.title: 马来西亚毒药委员会支持尼古丁电子烟销售提案
news.summary: 马来西亚毒药委员会支持允许含尼古丁电子烟产品合法销售的提案，意味着该国可能解除对尼古丁电子烟液的管制禁令。此举若落地，将改变马来西亚电子烟市场的准入格局，影响烟草公司与电子烟品牌的渠道与产品策略，同时引发公共健康与青少年防护的监管争议。
news.body: Special EditionAdvertiseCalendarIndustry GuideAboutOur MissionOur ReputationContactPrivacy PolicySearch Malaysia Poisons Board Backs Proposal to Allow Nicotine Vape Sales Malaysia’s Poisons Board endorsed Health Minister Dzulkefly Ahmad’s proposal to remove nicotine-containing e-cigarette liquids from the Poisons List, potentially allowing their commercial sale under a ministerial exemption order. The proposal follows a May 2026 Kuala Lumpur High Court ruling that overturned a 2023 exemption issued by the previous health minister. The Malaysian Pharmacists Society confirmed the board’s support, although its deliberations were confidential. The proposal would reverse the current restrictions on nicotine vape products, but sales cannot resume until the health minister formally issues and gazettes the exemption order. The development also comes amid the government’s previously announced plans to introduce a nationwide vape ban.
news.impact: 这反映东南亚电子烟监管正从全面禁止转向受控合法化的结构性趋势，背后是税收、执法成本与公共健康目标的再平衡。需注意该委员会仅为技术咨询机构，最终决策仍取决于内阁与立法程序，单一报道不足以判断时间表。对研究方与品牌而言，长期启发在于：合规能力与产品信息披露将取代灰色渠道成为市场准入核心，感官层面的尼古丁递送设计也需纳入监管沟通框架。

news.title: ITC利润下滑20%，税负与成本双重挤压
news.summary: 印度快消与烟草巨头ITC公布利润同比下降20%，主因是税负上升与原材料等投入成本上涨的双重挤压。该表现反映烟草及快消企业在监管加码与通胀环境下的盈利脆弱性，也提示税收政策对烟草类企业利润的传导效应显著。
news.body: Special EditionAdvertiseCalendarIndustry GuideAboutOur MissionOur ReputationContactPrivacy PolicySearch ITC Profit Falls 20% Under Pressure from Taxes, Input Costs India’s ITC reported a 20% year-over-year decline in quarterly profit to 41.37 billion rupees ($455.1 million) for the three months ended Sept. 30, as higher cigarette taxes, price increases, and rising raw material costs pressured its tobacco business. Profit from its cigarette segment fell more than 25%, with the company attributing weaker industry volumes to an “unprecedented increase in tax.” Cigarette manufacturers, including ITC and Godfrey Phillips India, have raised prices in recent months following the introduction of a new cigarette excise duty in India. ITC said material costs increased 15% because of sharp input cost escalation linked to the fallout from the Middle East war. Despite the decline in profit, ITC’s total revenue increased 46% to 283.18 billion rupees ($3.1 billion), supported by demand for its consumer goods businesses and higher prices. The company said demand remained resilient in rural and urban markets but warned that uneven monsoon conditions and strengthening El Niño conditions could affect agricultural production and inflation. ITC shares have lost more than one-third of their value over the past year, compared with a 9% decline in India’s Nifty 50 index.
news.impact: 这一利润下滑是烟草及快消行业结构性压力的缩影：监管性税负持续抬升、农产品与包装等投入成本波动加剧，正在系统性压缩传统烟草业务的利润空间，并推动企业向快消品类多元化转移。需注意，单一企业季度利润受一次性因素与会计口径影响，不宜直接外推为行业整体趋势；且该报道未披露具体税率与成本结构，结论应保持谨慎。对研究方而言，长期启示在于将税收政策变量纳入烟草与快消企业的盈利模型，并关注监管趋严下品类结构迁移对品牌组合的深层重塑。

news.title: Zimbabwe Tobacco Research Shows Progress
news.summary: 据 Tobacco Reporter 报道，津巴布韦烟草研究取得进展。报道未披露具体研究机构、技术路径与量化结果，从标题判断应属烟叶生产端的研究推进，可能涉及品种、栽培或调制环节。对以烟叶出口为重要外汇来源的津巴布韦而言，此类进展关系到原料供给稳定性与品质一致性，也会影响下游制造端的成本与配方选择。
news.body: Special EditionAdvertiseCalendarIndustry GuideAboutOur MissionOur ReputationContactPrivacy PolicySearch Zimbabwe Tobacco Research Shows Progress Zimbabwe’s Tobacco Research Board (Kutsaga) presented research on fertilizer efficiency, greenhouse gas emissions, and energy-saving tobacco curing technologies at the 70th Cooperation Centre for Scientific Research Relative to Tobacco (CORESTA) congress, held in Victoria Falls. One study examined the use of biofertilizers to reduce nitrous oxide emissions from tobacco production, finding that combining 75% of the recommended chemical fertilizer application with 75% biofertilizer produced the most promising balance between crop productivity and emissions reduction. Kutsaga also presented its KCC2 tobacco-curing barn, designed to improve heat and moisture distribution while reducing reliance on grid electricity. Comparative trials found that KCC2 achieved a moisture-uniformity coefficient of variation of 3.11%, compared with 5.03% for its predecessor, KCC1. Malawi’s Agricultural Research and Extension Trust CEO Albert Changaya said his organization wants to adopt the technology and plans to invite Kutsaga engineers to Malawi to facilitate its transfer. Researchers also discussed alternative curing fuels, including liquefied petroleum gas, biomass briquettes, and biogas.
news.impact: 把这条信息放回结构里看，它指向的是原料端研究能力正成为烟草供应链竞争的前置变量：产地不再只是价格与产量的提供者，而逐渐承担品种与工艺的知识生产。但需警惕，单一来源的“进展”表述缺乏可核验指标，容易把常规试验包装成突破，也难以判断其对商业烟叶品质的实际转化率。对研究方与品牌方的长期启发是：原料研究的价值最终要在感官一致性与供应韧性上兑现，评估时应要求可复现的方法与量化终点，而非停留在叙事层面。

news.title: 产品警示标签削弱尼古丁产品吸引力
news.summary: 一项研究显示，在尼古丁产品包装上印制健康警示信息会降低消费者对产品的吸引力评价。该结果与烟草控制领域长期推行的包装警示政策方向一致，也提示产品外观与信息设计会直接影响消费者的购买意愿与产品偏好。
news.body: Special EditionAdvertiseCalendarIndustry GuideAboutOur MissionOur ReputationContactPrivacy PolicySearch Study Finds On-Product Warnings Reduce Appeal of Nicotine Products Research from McMaster University published in the Canadian Journal of Public Health examined how health warnings, nicotine strength, packaging, and price influence preferences for e-cigarettes, heated tobacco products, and cigarettes. Researchers surveyed 2,961 Canadians, including 1,839 e-cigarette nonusers aged 16-29 and 1,122 current users, using an online discrete choice experiment featuring JUUL pods, IQOS heated tobacco sticks, and du Maurier cigarettes. Health warnings printed directly on products had the largest effect on preferences. When warnings appeared on all three product categories, the predicted probability of choosing none of the products increased from 50% to 65% among nonusers and from 10% to 18% among current e-cigarette users. Warnings also reduced preferences for vape pods without increasing predicted preferences for cigarettes. A 40% increase in vape prices reduced current users’ predicted preference for vape pods from 55% to 48%, while increasing preferences for heated tobacco and cigarettes. Higher cigarette prices did not increase preferences for vaping. Lower nicotine concentrations increased the appeal of vape pods among nonusers and users who did not also smoke, while plain packaging had little effect on product preferences. The researchers cautioned that the experiment measured hypothetical choices rather than actual purchasing behavior and that the results may not reflect real-world consumption.
news.impact: 包装警示从烟草向新型尼古丁产品延伸，反映监管正把「信息设计」当作独立于配方之外的产品变量。研究仅以吸引力为结果指标，难以区分是健康风险认知还是感官预期被削弱，也未必能外推至真实货架情境。对品牌方而言，合规信息正成为产品体验的一部分，需在产品设计与消费者沟通层面提前将其纳入考量，而非事后补救。

news.title: 纽约烟草零售牌照抽签开闸
news.summary: 纽约市以抽签方式发放数量有限的烟草零售许可证，对新进入者设置配额门槛。此举意在压缩烟草销售网点密度，降低产品可及性，属于典型的需求侧准入管制。对零售商而言，牌照成为稀缺资源，存量持有者与潜在进入者的竞争逻辑被改写；对品牌方而言，渠道触达与终端陈列策略需重新评估。
news.body: Special EditionAdvertiseCalendarIndustry GuideAboutOur MissionOur ReputationContactPrivacy PolicySearch NYC Opens Lottery for Limited Tobacco Retail Licenses New York City opened applications for a lottery to award a limited number of tobacco and vape retail licenses in designated community districts. Applications will be accepted through Nov. 30, with the lottery intended to determine which applicants may receive licenses in areas where the city has capped the number of tobacco retailers. New York City’s Department of Consumer and Worker Protection identified available licenses in 38 community districts for tobacco retailers and 23 districts for electronic cigarette retailers. The Oct. 1 review found openings for 224 tobacco retail licenses and 41 e-cigarette retail licenses. The city caps the number of tobacco and e-cigarette retailers in each community district, and licenses become available when the number of active licenses falls below the cap. If applications exceed available licenses, the department will randomly select businesses and invite them to complete the licensing process.
news.impact: 此类配额制反映全球烟草监管从产品端向渠道端延伸的结构性趋势：可及性管控正成为控烟政策的新抓手。其效果依赖网点密度与消费行为的实证关系，而现有公开证据多来自单一城市试点，外推需谨慎；牌照分配也可能催生二级流转与寻租空间。对研究方，应关注渠道收缩对品类结构与品牌份额的差异化影响；对品牌方，长期启示是终端资源稀缺化将重塑渠道议价与市场进入策略，而非短期铺货调整。

news.title: 荷兰反烟组织拟起诉菲莫国际
news.summary: 荷兰反烟组织正筹备对菲莫国际提起投诉，指向其烟草产品的合规与公共健康责任问题。此举延续了欧洲民间组织通过法律与监管渠道向烟草巨头施压的趋势，可能推动更多司法辖区审视跨国烟草企业的产品责任与营销行为，对行业合规成本与公众形象构成潜在压力。
news.body: Special EditionAdvertiseCalendarIndustry GuideAboutOur MissionOur ReputationContactPrivacy PolicySearch Dutch Anti-Smoking Groups Preparing Complaint Against Philip Morris Dutch pulmonologist Wanda de Kanter and the Foundation for Youth Smoking Prevention (Stichting Rookpreventie Jeugd) are reportedly preparing a criminal complaint against Philip Morris International, alleging the company misleads consumers about the health risks of its heated tobacco products and violates restrictions on nicotine advertising. The complaint, being prepared with attorney Bénédicte Ficq, is expected to be filed within two weeks, with support from the Dutch cancer society KWF Kankerbestrijding and the lung health organization Longfonds. The foundation argues that Philip Morris presents heated tobacco as less harmful than conventional cigarettes, despite the Netherlands’ National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM) saying that heated tobacco products remain harmful and are not a safe alternative to smoking. The complaint follows an unsuccessful 2016 criminal case brought by Ficq on behalf of De Kanter’s organization against Philip Morris and other tobacco manufacturers. Prosecutors declined to pursue that case, concluding that the allegations did not constitute a criminal matter and that tobacco regulation was a matter for lawmakers. Ficq argues that existing prohibitions on tobacco advertising and misleading consumers provide grounds for prosecution in the new case.
news.impact: 该事件折射出全球烟草业监管从广告限制、包装警示向产品责任与法律追责延伸的结构性趋势，民间组织正成为推动企业问责的重要力量。需注意投诉尚处筹备阶段，其法律效力与结果存在不确定性，且报道未披露具体指控依据，推断空间有限。对品牌方而言，长期启示在于公共健康议题正持续重塑快消领域的合规边界与企业声誉管理逻辑。

news.title: 韩国烟草管控计划遭批存漏洞
news.summary: 韩国政府提出的新一轮烟草管控计划因覆盖范围存在空白、部分措施力度被削减而受到批评。争议集中在政策能否有效覆盖新型烟草产品、以及控烟资源配置是否被压缩。该事件反映出监管收紧与产业利益之间的持续张力，也提示政策设计中的执行缺口可能削弱整体控烟效果。
news.body: Special EditionAdvertiseCalendarIndustry GuideAboutOur MissionOur ReputationContactPrivacy PolicySearch Korea’s Tobacco Plan Draws Criticism Over Gaps, Cuts South Korea’s Ministry of Health and Welfare and Ministry of Food and Drug Safety announced the country’s first five-year tobacco harmfulness management plan, covering 2027-2031. The plan calls for expanding the number of harmful substances tested by 2030 to about 50 for conventional cigarettes and heated tobacco products and 30 for liquid e-cigarettes. Smokeless tobacco and water-pipe tobacco would also be added to the testing program. The government also plans to accelerate testing requests for new products by up to 17 months and develop additional testing methods for harmful substances and additives. The plan has drawn criticism for largely excluding nicotine analogs and nicotine-free products, which are not classified as tobacco under South Korea’s Tobacco Business Act. Imports of nicotine-free products have doubled this year, while online sales of nicotine analog products have increased. Critics also questioned the plan’s limited provisions for flavored tobacco products, whose market share rose from 9.8% in 2013 to 46.5% in 2023. Separately, the proposed 2027 budget for smoking prevention and cessation programs is 79.5 billion won ($58.8 million), down 14.4% from this year’s 92.9 billion won ($68.7 million).
news.impact: 控烟政策正从单一税价工具转向覆盖产品、渠道与消费场景的组合监管，但各国在执行层面的缝隙与妥协日益成为效果分化的关键变量。此类争议往往缺乏公开的量化评估支撑，批评方与监管方的立场差异也需审慎对待。对品牌与研究者而言，长期启示在于：监管风险不再只体现为税率变化，而是政策覆盖边界与执行力度本身的不确定性，需将其纳入市场准入与产品组合的前瞻判断。

news.title: 菲莫德国推高浓度加热烟草新品
news.summary: 菲利普莫里斯国际（PMI）于2026年10月在德国推出TEREA Bold Red和Bold Black两款加热烟草棒，烟草风味强度均为品牌评级10级，成为当地TEREA产品组合中强度等级最高的品种。两款新品分别具有皮革与温暖木质调性，以及木质与淡雅花香，均为20支装，每包售价8欧元，较常规TEREA高约2.6%。德国

上述强度等级为IQOS采用的烟草风味评级，不代表尼古丁含量、尼古丁释放量或产品健康风险等级。 两款Bold新品仍属于现有TEREA加热烟草棒产品体系，使用IQOS ILUMA及ILUMA i系列设备，沿用SMARTCORE感应加热技术。它们不适用于使用HEETS烟草棒的旧款IQOS设备。 TEREA Bold Red和Bold Black在德国的官方零售价格均为每包8欧元，每包20支。每条包含10包、合计200支，售价80欧元。 相比之下，常规TEREA 20支装每包售价7.80欧元，每条售价78欧元。 德国市场另有TEREA XL产品，采用26支装规格，每包售价10欧元。这一包装形式于2026年9月正式进入IQOS德国官方渠道，覆盖Russet、Sienna、Amber、Teak和Turquoise五种既有风味。 XL在保留既有烟草配方的同时，将每包支数由20支增加至26支，并形成略低的单位售价；Bold则维持20支装，通过烟草混合配方和更高的风味强度评级形成不同的价格档位。 这些价格均为德国官方零售标价，不代表不同产品的利润率或实际销售表现。 IQOS德国于2026年10月12日在官方新闻页面宣布TEREA Bold Red和Bold Black上市，并将两款产品列为可购买商品。 ILUMA或ILUMA i设备并完成账户注册；二是现有符合条件的用户在IQOS Club内解锁TEREA Bold专属徽章。 完成其中一种参与方式，可获得一次抽奖机会；同时完成两种方式，可获得两次抽奖机会。参与者还须满足账户注册及营销信息接收授权等活动条件。 按活动规则公布的奖品数量及标示价值计算，奖品总标示价值为36,750欧元。该金额并非菲莫实际营销支出。 XL产品。与XL通过增加包装支数
news.impact: 加热烟草正从替代品走向风味细分，强度分级成为产品差异化新维度。菲莫以10级强度与皮革、木质调性切入高端细分，反映品类成熟后从功能诉求转向感官体验竞争。但仅凭企业评级与单一市场定价，难以判断消费者实际感知与接受度，风味强度标签的行业标准化仍缺位。对研究方而言，感官分级与消费者感知的对应关系值得长期追踪；对品牌方，风味叙事能否支撑溢价，取决于感官承诺与真实体验的一致性，而非等级数字本身。

news.title: FDA首批尼古丁袋，BAT获美国准入
news.summary: FDA首次批准BAT旗下24款VELO尼古丁袋在美销售，标志BAT获得美国市场合法准入。此举延续FDA对新型尼古丁产品审评路径，为口含烟品类打开合规通道，也意味着传统烟草巨头在减害产品上的竞争从电子烟延伸至尼古丁袋赛道。
news.body: The FDA on Oct. 30 authorized 24 flavored VELO nicotine pouch products, giving British American Tobacco (BAT) its first U.S. marketing authorizations for the brand. The new marketing-granted orders cover products manufactured by Modoral Brands Inc., a Reynolds American subsidiary. Although the agency authorized 24 separate products, there are only eight flavor and pouch combinations. Each comes in three different packaging configurations. VELO Mini Pouch is authorized in Crema, Lime, Orange Crema, and Passion Fruit. VELO Mini Pouch 2 comes in Crema, Lime, Orange Crema, and Cinnamon. All contain 4 milligrams of nicotine per pouch, and each pouch weighs 400 milligrams. The unusual count reflects the FDA's decision to evaluate the packaging as part of each application. Containers can affect moisture, product stability, shelf life, and safety. All three approved packaging configurations feature certified child-resistant closures, intended to reduce accidental nicotine exposure among young children. The authorizations came through the agency's nicotine pouch pilot program, launched in September 2025 to speed up premarket tobacco product application (PMTA) reviews. The FDA says the program has shortened applicant response times and helped reviewers resolve scientific questions more efficiently. The agency also found that the VELO products contain substantially fewer harmful and potentially harmful chemicals than cigarettes and conventional smokeless tobacco. Several cancer-causing constituents, including some associated with oral cancer in smokeless tobacco users, were not measurable in the tested products. That does not mean nicotine pouches are harmless. The potential health benefit depends in large part on smokers switching completely rather than continuing to smoke. BAT's new approvals follow a series of nicotine pouch decisions this year. The FDA authorized 11 ZYN ULTRA products in August, expanding the range of permitted strengths and flavors. news.impact: 这折射出监管正把新型尼古丁产品纳入个案审评框架，品类合法化从电子烟扩散至口含袋，巨头竞争转向合规能力而非单纯营销。需注意：批准不等于市场成功，缺乏消费者接受度与渠道数据；FDA立场亦非全球统一。长期看，品牌方应把监管准入视为结构性壁垒，提前布局产品组合与证据链，而非押注单一品类。

news.title: ITC: Q2 FY27 Results
news.summary: ITC 公布 Q2 FY27 业绩，来源为行业媒体 Tobacco Insider，具体财务与分部数据未在标题中披露。作为横跨快消、烟草与食品的综合企业，其季度表现通常被视为印度消费需求、渠道结构与定价环境的参照指标；市场关注点集中于烟草业务的稳定性、快消品板块的增长质量与利润率走向，以及公司在通胀与监管环境下的应对。本条信息本身仅为业绩发布节点，缺乏可核验的数值细节，解读需以原始财报为准。
news.body: ITC Limited reported its Q2 FY27 financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revealing continued pressure on profitability from the unprecedented increase in cigarette taxation introduced in February 2026. However, the results also showed signs of sequential recovery in the core Cigarettes business, alongside robust growth across non-cigarette segments. On a Standalone basis, Gross Revenue increased 46.6% YoY to ₹28,152 Cr, primarily reflecting the accounting effects of the revised cigarette taxation framework. Standalone Net Revenue increased 3.1% YoY to ₹18,449 Cr, while EBITDA declined 17.4% YoY to ₹5,160 Cr. Profit Before Tax (PBT) fell 19.9% to ₹5,481.75 Cr, and reported Net Profit (PAT) declined 20.1% YoY to ₹4,137.12 Cr. Standalone Basic EPS was ₹3.30, compared with ₹4.13 in Q2 FY26. On a Consolidated basis, Gross Revenue increased 44.6% YoY to ₹30,431 Cr, while Net Revenue, as presented by the company, grew 5.1% to ₹20,454 Cr. Consolidated EBITDA decreased 15.7% YoY to ₹5,645 Cr. PAT before exceptional items declined 17.0% YoY to ₹4,249 Cr, while reported PAT fell 18.5% to ₹4,229.33 Cr. Basic EPS declined from ₹4.09 in Q2 FY26 to ₹3.32. The central development was the improvement in cigarette profitability relative to the preceding quarter. Although Cigarettes segment PBIT declined 27.2% YoY, it increased 14.1% sequentially, suggesting that ITC’s calibrated pricing and portfolio adjustments are beginning to moderate the impact of the tax increase. Meanwhile, non-cigarette businesses demonstrated greater resilience, with consolidated non-cigarette Net Revenue growing 20% YoY and EBITDA increasing 22%. FMCG-Others sustained double-digit growth, while Paperboards, Paper & Packaging and Agri Business delivered improved profitability. As highlighted in our Q1 FY27 analysis, ITC’s reported revenue continues to be materially affected by the structural change in India’s cigarette taxation system implemented on February 1, 2026. Following the expirati
news.impact: 单季业绩标题难以支撑趋势判断，却提示一个结构性事实：综合型快消企业的增长越来越依赖组合内板块间的对冲，而非单一品类的高增长。烟草提供现金流与防御性，食品与个人护理承担增量，但二者面对的监管与竞争逻辑并不相同，跨板块协同容易被高估。对研究方的长期启发是，应把企业披露口径与真实消费需求分开观察，警惕以整体营收增速掩盖品类间的分化；品牌方则需认识到，在多品类集团中，资源配置节奏比单点增长更能决定长期位置。

news.title: VAPORESSO推免预热开放系统设备VAST
news.summary: VAPORESSO发布VAST，称其为业内首款无需预热的开放式系统设备，核心在于消除注油后等待浸润的环节，改善首次使用与连续补油的即时体验。该信息来自行业媒体Vaping Post，属产品技术发布，具体技术路径、雾化结构与实测口感数据尚未披露，实际体验与一致性仍需第三方验证。
news.body: Featuring one-second coil saturation, a 10 mL refillable pod and Tri-Core Mesh Technology, VAST delivers a faster, more versatile and longer-lasting experience SHENZHEN, China, November 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — VAPORESSO, a global vaping technology brand, today introduced VAST, a refillable pod system designed to deliver greater convenience, versatility and lasting performance. Built around the concept of “VAST, FAST, LAST,” the device features no-wait priming, Tri-Core Mesh Technology and a high-capacity design in one streamlined platform for adult users. According to VAPORESSO, VAST is the industry’s first open-system device that requires no priming wait. Its innovative wicking structure enables the coil to become fully saturated in just one second after filling, allowing users to begin almost immediately. This eliminates the several-minute wait commonly associated with refillable devices while helping reduce dry hits caused by insufficient priming. With a total e-liquid capacity of 10 mL, VAST allows users to go longer between refills, minimizing interruptions and providing greater convenience for everyday use and travel. Its streamlined design combines a 2 mL pod with an 8 mL refill container and was developed with applicable TPD capacity requirements in mind. For longer-lasting and cleaner performance, VAST incorporates CORE GUARD Technology, featuring a nano-scale coating that helps protect the heating wire against e-liquid corrosion. Under VAPORESSO’s testing conditions, each pod supports up to six refills while maintaining stable performance. Upgraded SSS 3.0 Leak-Resistant Technology further helps manage e-liquid and condensation, reducing leakage during daily use and travel. By combining industry-first no-wait priming, three experiences in one pod and a compliance-conscious high-capacity structure, VAPORESSO VAST offers adult users more choice, less waiting and fewer interruptions. news.impact: 免预热从封闭式一次性产品向开放式系统迁移，反映电子雾化行业竞争重心正从硬件参数转向使用流程的摩擦消除，产品体验的「时间成本」被纳入设计变量。但单一厂商的「首款」宣称缺乏横向可比标准，行业尚无统一的预热判定与口感一致性评价方法，媒体转述亦难替代独立测评。长期看，品牌若要把此类体验主张转化为可信差异，需建立可复现的感官评价与消费者使用行为研究体系，而非停留于发布口径。

news.title: 山西省政府召开打击涉烟违法活动工作专班第一次全体会议

news.body: 近日，山西省政府召开打击涉烟违法活动工作专班第一次全体会议。省政府副秘书长，工作专班组长出席会议并讲话，山西省烟草专卖局主要负责人、工作专班副组长出席会议并讲话，省高院、省检察院、省委网信办、省外事办、省公安厅、省司法厅、省财政厅、省市场监管局、省交通运输厅、太原海关缉私局、省邮管局、山西边检总站、太原铁路公安局等工作专班成员单位有关负责人出席会议。山西省烟草专卖局党组成员、副局长主持会议。 会议分析了近年来涉烟违法犯罪形势变化，通报了2026年山西省打击涉烟违法活动工作情况，工作专班有关负责人围绕打击涉烟违法活动作交流发言。 会议要求，要充分发挥专班作用，扎实推进全链条打击涉烟违法活动。一是健全专班运行机制，建立常态化会商调度机制，深化信息互通、线索移交及联合执法。二是纵深推进“清源断链”专项行动，统筹推进打假打私集中整治、寄递渠道涉烟专项治理、零售终端综合治理，切实提升全链条打击整体效能。三是强化支撑保障，持续推进行政执法与刑事司法有效衔接，加强专业化执法队伍建设，加快“1+2+N”“情指行”一体化体系建设。 会议强调，一要提高政治站位，切实增强全链条打击涉烟违法活动的责任感紧迫感。二要聚焦重点任务，全面打响全链条打击涉烟违法活动攻坚战，一体推进“打、防、管、治、宣”各项工作举措。三要强化专班统筹，严格督导考核和责任落实，确保各项部署落地见效。 主管：国家烟草专卖局办公室 主办：《中国烟草》杂志社（中国烟草总公司传媒中心） 政府网站标识码：bm64000012 备案序号：京ICP备05033420号 地址：中国北京西城区月坛南街55号(100045) 京公网安备：110401200137 版权所有：国家烟草专卖局，未经许可，本网站包括图像、图标、文字在内的所有数据不得转载
news.impact: 多部门专班的高规格配置，折射出烟草治理正从单一专卖执法转向跨部门协同的系统性监管，涉及司法、网信、海关、物流等全链条，意味着非法烟草的渠道愈发隐蔽化、跨境化与线上化。对研究方而言，这提示灰色市场已成为扰动正规销量与价格体系的结构性变量，仅凭官方销量数据判断真实消费需求存在偏差风险；品牌方需意识到合规成本与渠道透明度正上升为长期竞争要素。但本条仅有会议信息，缺乏案件规模与流向数据，任何量化推断都应审慎。此为监管侧信号，与消费者洞察及感官研究无直接关联，不宜过度延伸。

news.title: Tobacco Regulation: Latin America
news.summary: 据Tobacco Insider报道，拉美地区烟草监管议题受到关注。该区域各国在控烟框架公约履约、包装警示、广告限制与税收政策上进度不一，监管趋严是总体方向。对跨国烟草企业而言，拉美市场的合规成本与产品准入不确定性上升，需按国别评估政策节奏与渠道结构变化。
news.body: The Colombian government has submitted a sweeping “Economic Rescue Bill” to Congress proposing steep tax hikes on vaping products, tobacco, and alcoholic beverages. Designed to close fiscal deficits while generating dedicated revenue for the national health system, the proposed legislation targets so-called “vice” consumer goods with some of the most aggressive rate adjustments in the region. Under the proposed framework, traditional combustible cigarettes will face a steep escalation in taxation. The specific tax levied on a standard 20-unit cigarette pack is set to rise from 4,068 pesos to 11,200 pesos. Loose tobacco, snuff, and chimú will incur a specific tax of 891 pesos per gram. To ensure tax collections keep pace with inflation over time, the bill mandates that these specific rates be automatically adjusted each year by the Consumer Price Index (CPI) plus an additional four percentage points. Electronic nicotine delivery systems, heated tobacco products, non-nicotine aerosol delivery devices, and refill liquids will also be subjected to unprecedented fiscal oversight. Under the proposed two-tiered rate structure, vaping liquids will face a specific tax starting at 1,000 Colombian pesos per milliliter in 2027, which will increase to 2,000 pesos per milliliter beginning in 2028. These specific fees will apply alongside a 30% ad valorem tax. The combined burden is likely to increase final retail prices for e-cigarettes and related vaping products by more than 50%. All additional revenue raised from the tobacco and vape duties is statutory earmarked for transfer to the Administrator of the Resources of the General System of Social Security in Health (ADRES) to shore up national healthcare coverage. Regional departments and the Capital District will be required to remit monthly tax collections to ADRES within the first 15 business days of each month to maintain consistent funding flow. news.impact: 拉美监管碎片化反映全球烟草治理的结构性趋势：监管权下沉至区域与国别层面，统一市场假设失效。这要求研究方放弃区域整体判断，转向政策颗粒度分析；品牌方则需将合规能力视为市场准入资产。需注意，单一行业媒体信源难以量化政策强度与执行落差，结论应保持审慎。

news.title: FDA Authorizes 24 VELO Pouch Products
news.summary: 美国FDA首次批准24款VELO尼古丁袋产品上市，标志着口服尼古丁袋这一新兴品类在美国获得联邦层面的合法销售资格。该授权基于上市前烟草产品申请（PMTA）的公共卫生评估，意味着监管机构认可其在成人吸烟者减害中的潜在角色。对行业而言，这为尼古丁袋品类打开了合规化通道，可能加速跨国烟草公司在该赛道的产品布局与渠道扩张，同时强化对未获授权产品的执法边界。
news.body: Special EditionAdvertiseCalendarIndustry GuideAboutOur MissionOur ReputationContactPrivacy PolicySearch FDA Authorizes 24 VELO Pouch Products On Oct. 30, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration issued Marketing Granted Orders to Modoral Brands Inc., a Reynolds American subsidiary, for 24 VELO nicotine pouch products, marking the first FDA marketing authorizations for British American Tobacco’s VELO brand in the United States. The orders cover eight product varieties across three packaging configurations, all containing 4 mg of nicotine. VELO Mini Pouch flavors include Crema, Lime, Orange Crema and Passion Fruit, while VELO Mini Pouch 2 comes in Crema, Lime, Orange Crema and Cinnamon. Each pouch weighs 400 mg. The FDA said its scientific review found that the authorized products contain lower levels of harmful and potentially harmful constituents than cigarettes and smokeless tobacco products, with several carcinogenic constituents, including those associated with oral cancer, below measurable levels. The agency evaluated whether the products could benefit adults who switch completely from other tobacco products while considering potential risks to youth and nonusers. The FDA emphasized that marketing authorization does not mean the products are safe and that adults who use tobacco must switch completely to potentially lower-risk alternatives to realize the full health benefits. The decision brings the total number of FDA-authorized nicotine pouch products to 67, including products marketed by Swedish Match USA’s ZYN and Altria’s Helix Innovations. The authorizations also give BAT a place alongside its two major competitors in the FDA-authorized U.S. nicotine pouch market. Only nicotine pouch products listed on the FDA’s authorized products list may legally be sold in the United States.
news.impact: 这一授权反映全球烟草监管正从「一刀切限制」转向「风险分级管理」，新型口服尼古丁产品被纳入减害框架，可能重塑传统卷烟与替代品的竞争格局。但需注意：单一审批不等于品类整体合法化，各市场监管路径差异显著，且缺乏长期独立的人群健康数据。对研究方而言，应关注监管科学如何定义「减害」证据标准；对品牌方，合规能力与产品证据链将取代营销速度，成为该品类长期竞争的结构性门槛。

news.title: 环球烟草定于11月4日发布Q2财报
news.summary: 环球烟草公司（Universal Corporation）宣布将于11月4日公布2025财年第二季度业绩。作为全球主要的烟叶供应商，其财报将反映烟叶采购价格、全球需求及汇率波动对上游供应链的影响，并为观察烟草农业端成本与库存周期提供窗口。
news.body: Special EditionAdvertiseCalendarIndustry GuideAboutOur MissionOur ReputationContactPrivacy PolicySearch Universal to Report Fiscal Q2 Results Nov. 4 Universal Corp. will release its fiscal 2027 second-quarter results after market close Nov. 4 and hold a conference call at 10 a.m. Eastern on Nov. 5. The call will be available via live webcast on the company’s website, with a replay accessible through Feb. 5, 2027.
news.impact: 烟叶供应商业绩是烟草产业链上游的晴雨表，其波动往往先于终端品牌显现。财报本身信息有限，不宜过度解读单季数字；更值得关注的是全球烟叶供需再平衡、气候与监管对种植端的长期约束，以及替代性原料对传统烟叶需求的渐进替代。对研究方而言，上游供应商数据可作为判断成本传导与品类迁移的先行指标。

news.title: 英国法院允许PA在上诉期执行电子烟目录法
news.summary: 英国上诉法院裁定，药品与健康产品管理局（MHRA）可在上诉审理期间继续执行电子烟产品目录法，要求零售商和制造商仅销售列入目录的产品。该裁决意味着合规义务暂不中止，行业需按现行目录制度运营。上诉最终结果仍可能改变监管框架，但短期内市场准入与产品下架风险上升。
news.body: Special EditionAdvertiseCalendarIndustry GuideAboutOur MissionOur ReputationContactPrivacy PolicySearch PA Can Enforce Vape Directory Law During Appeal A federal judge has rejected a request from vape businesses to temporarily block enforcement of Pennsylvania’s Act 57 while they appeal a ruling upholding the law. U.S. District Judge Julia Munley denied the request, allowing enforcement to continue. The law, which took effect Oct. 19, prohibits the sale of nicotine-containing e-cigarettes not listed in the state’s approved product directory. The plaintiffs, including MMA Group 1 Inc., which operates Tobacco Hut stores, and several distributors and vape businesses, sued in May, arguing that Act 57 is preempted by federal law and interferes with the FDA’s regulatory authority. Munley granted summary judgment to Pennsylvania on the federal preemption claims Oct. 14, finding that the law regulates retail sales rather than imposing separate federal premarket approval requirements. The plaintiffs appealed to the Third Circuit and sought a temporary stay, which Munley denied Oct. 28. Act 57 requires nicotine e-cigarettes to have FDA marketing authorization or qualify under specified pending application provisions to be listed in the state directory. Unlisted products are subject to seizure and destruction, with penalties ranging from $500 per product for a first violation to $1,500 per product per day for repeat violations.
news.impact: 这反映欧洲电子烟监管正从上市前审批转向可执行的产品目录与准入清单，执法确定性成为竞争要素。需注意裁决仅涉及上诉期执行，不预示终局；且摘要未披露目录覆盖范围与过渡安排，推断有限。长期看，品牌方应将监管合规能力前置为产品开发与渠道策略的固定成本，而非事后应对。

news.title: FDA尼古丁袋授权扩容，口味成焦点
news.summary: 美国FDA授权英美烟草旗下24款VELO尼古丁袋上市，涵盖青柠、百香果等口味，均为4毫克尼古丁规格，并采用经认证的防儿童开启包装。此次授权使FDA累计获授权尼古丁袋数量从43款增至67款，增长55.8%。英美烟草由此加入菲莫国际和奥驰亚所在的FDA授权产品阵容，进一步丰富美国市场获正式授权的尼古丁袋产品选择。
news.body: 封面图：美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）关于授权24款VELO尼古丁袋产品上市的公告截图。图片来源：FDA官网。 FDA最新授权： 英美烟草旗下24款VELO尼古丁袋获得美国FDA上市授权，累计获授权产品数量从43款增至67款，增长55.8%。 产品与口味： 新获授权产品均含4毫克尼古丁，涉及两个系列、五种口味名称，包括青柠、百香果等，分别采用三种经认证的防儿童开启包装。 产业竞争格局： VELO首次获得FDA上市授权，英美烟草由此加入菲莫国际和奥驰亚所在的尼古丁袋授权产品阵容。 审评试点进展： 此次24款VELO产品通过FDA尼古丁袋PMTA审评试点获得授权，使该试点累计授权产品数量达到47款。 FDA科学评估： FDA表示，新获授权VELO产品的有害和潜在有害成分水平低于卷烟及传统无烟烟草产品，并在审评中综合考虑成年使用者转换产品的潜在收益及青少年使用风险。 美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）10月30日宣布，授权24款VELO尼古丁袋产品在美国上市销售，使FDA累计授权的尼古丁袋产品数量从43款增至67款，增幅达55.8%。 此次获授权产品由Modoral Brands Inc.生产，该公司是英美烟草（British American Tobacco）旗下雷诺美国（Reynolds American）的子公司。这是VELO尼古丁袋首次获得FDA上市授权。至此，英美烟草、菲莫国际（Philip Morris International，PMI）和奥驰亚集团（Altria）三家大型国际烟草集团，均已有尼古丁袋产品获得FDA上市许可。 此次获授权产品分属VELO Mini Pouch和VELO Mini Pouch 2两个系列，均为小规格尼古丁袋，每袋重400毫克，尼古丁含量为4毫克。 VELO Mini Pouch系列包括Crema、Lime（青柠）、Orange Crema和Passion Fruit（百香果）四种口味；VELO Mini Pouch 2系列包括Crema、Lime、Orange Crema和Cinnamon（肉桂）四种口味。两个系列合计涉及五种不同的口味名称。 根据FDA公告，上述八个产品名称分别对应三种包装形式，因此共有24款产品获得上市授权。 FDA指出，包装可能影响产品稳定性、保质期、含水量和安全性，因此也是新型烟草产品上市前审评的重要内容。 此次获授权的三种包装形式均采用经认证的防儿童开启包装（Child-Resistant Packaging）。此前，FDA曾敦促尼古丁袋制造商使用此类包装，以降低幼儿意外接触尼古丁产品的风险。 这是FDA自2025年1月首次授权尼古丁袋产品以来，单批授权数量最多的一次。 2025年1月16日，FDA首次授权20款尼古丁袋产品，全部来自菲莫国际旗下ZYN品牌。 2025年12月19日，FDA授权奥驰亚集团旗下Helix Innovations LLC生产的6款on! PLUS尼古丁袋。这也是FDA尼古丁袋审评试点计划首次作出产品上市授权决定。 2026年8月，FDA又连续作出多项授权决定：8月4日授权4款on!产品，8月19日再授权2款on!产品，随后于8月21日授权11款ZYN ULTRA产品。至此，累计授权数量达到43款。 本次新增24款VELO产品后，FDA累计授权数量增至67款，单次增长近56%。 目前，FDA已授权的尼古丁袋涵盖每袋2毫克至11毫克的不同尼古丁含量，以及多种口味和产品形式。 在此次授权之前，FDA已授权的43款尼古丁袋全部来自两家制造商：菲莫国际旗下Swedish Match USA，以及奥驰亚旗下Helix Innovations。 其中，Swedish Match USA的ZYN和ZYN ULTRA系列共有31款获授权产品，Helix的on!和on! PLUS系列共有12款。此次英美烟草通过旗下Modoral Brands新增24款VELO产品，使三家大型国际烟草集团旗下品牌均进入FDA尼古丁袋授权名单。 VELO此前已在美国市场销售。10月30日的授权决定，使其特定产品在完成FDA科学审评后，正式获得上市许可。 随着英美烟草加入，美国FDA授权的尼古丁袋产品不再仅来自菲莫国际和奥驰亚旗下品牌，获授权产品的品牌覆盖范围和产品选择进一步扩大。 此次24款VELO产品均通过FDA的尼古丁袋审评试点计划完成审评。 该计划于2025年9月启动，旨在提高烟草产品上市前申请（Premarket Tobacco Product Application，PMTA）的审评效率。主要措施包括加强申请人与FDA审评人员之间的直接沟通、加快解决申请材料中存在的问题，以及提高科学审评效率。 截至2026年8月21日，FDA已通过该试点授权23款尼古丁袋。随着此次
news.impact: 尼古丁袋获授权数量短期增55.8%，反映监管路径正从模糊走向清单化，品类合法性与竞争门槛同步抬升。口味（青柠、百香果）进入授权范围，说明监管对感官吸引力的容忍边界在试探中调整，但青少年防接触包装仍是硬约束。需注意：授权数不等于市场份额，也不代表消费者接受度，更不意味着口味监管风险解除。长期看，品牌方的核心能力将从“抢先上市”转向“合规的感官设计”——在监管许可的口味空间内构建可被感知、可被复购的差异化，而非依赖未授权风味冒险。

news.title: FDA授权英美烟草旗下24款VELO尼古丁袋，涵盖青柠、百香果等口味 PMTA
news.summary: 美国FDA授权英美烟草旗下24款VELO尼古丁袋上市，涵盖青柠、百香果等口味，均为4毫克尼古丁规格，并采用经认证的防儿童开启包装。此次授权使FDA累计获授权尼古丁袋数量从43款增至67款，增长55.8%。英美烟草由此加入菲莫国际和奥驰亚所在的FDA授权产品阵容，进一步丰富美国市场获正式授权的尼古丁袋产品选择。
