Designed for users who appreciate a high-quality vaping experience, NeXLIM 2 combines powerful performance with next-level flavor. Exclusive to NeXLIM 2, OXVA's Super Pulse System helps deliver finer vapor, denser draws, and more consistent output for a richer flavor experience. A 2000 mAh battery with 5V/3A fast charging provides the power needed for extended use and Boost Mode, while the HD color display keeps key information easily accessible throughout the day. NeXLIM 2 MINI takes a different approach. Featuring a premium metal body, touch controls, and a screen-free design, it focuses on simplicity without sacrificing flavor performance. Compact and lightweight, it is designed for users who prefer a more straightforward everyday experience. Powered by a 1500 mAh battery with 5V/2A fast charging, NeXLIM 2 MINI is built for dependable all-day use. While designed for different users, NeXLIM 2 and NeXLIM 2 MINI share the same commitment to richer flavor and longer-lasting performance, giving users two ways to experience the next evolution of NeXLIM. news.impact: 以「风味」作为产品迭代的核心叙事，折射出电子烟行业竞争重心正从硬件参数转向感官体验的可感知差异，这与快消品领域从功能诉求向体验诉求迁移的长期趋势一致。但需注意，风味主张高度依赖主观感知与配方实现，缺乏公开的感官测评方法与消费者数据支撑时，此类宣称难以验证，媒体转述亦易放大营销色彩。对品牌方而言，长期启示在于将风味从口号转化为可测量、可复现的感官设计能力，而非停留在传播层面。

news.title: 爱尔兰电子烟口味限制或重塑戒烟格局
news.summary: 爱尔兰拟对电子烟实施口味限制，可能改变该国戒烟辅助工具的可及性与吸引力。报道指出，该政策将影响成年吸烟者转向电子烟作为减害替代的选择，进而波及戒烟路径与公共健康结果。文章聚焦政策对戒烟景观的潜在重塑，但未提供具体限制范围、生效时间或销量数据，立场偏向行业视角。
news.body: The country's proposed restrictions would significantly change how vaping products are manufactured, marketed, displayed, and sold. Supporters view the measures as necessary to reduce the appeal of nicotine products among young people. However, critics argue that restricting flavor options and limiting retail visibility could also affect former smokers who depend on vaping to avoid returning to cigarettes. Eoin O’Boyle, owner of OB Vape in Drogheda, has emerged as a prominent critic of the legislation. Drawing on his own experience quitting smoking and his work with customers, he warns that the restrictions could damage legitimate vape retailers, encourage illegal product sales, and make smoking cessation more difficult for some people. His concerns raise questions that extend beyond the vaping industry and into Ireland’s broader tobacco-control strategy. Ireland's Seanad has passed the final stages of a broad public health bill containing substantial restrictions on vaping products. The proposed measures target several aspects of the industry, including flavor descriptions, packaging, advertising, and in-store displays. Manufacturers would face restrictions on flavor names beyond tobacco and unflavored descriptions. Rules would also limit the use of colors and imagery on vaping devices and packaging. Advertising in shops and online would be restricted, and most vaping products would no longer be permitted to remain openly displayed to customers. Public-health minister Jennifer Murnane O’Connor has supported the restrictions as a way to reduce the attractiveness of addictive products to young people. Taoiseach Micheál Martin has also expressed serious concerns about vaping, characterizing it as a significant public health threat. From the government's perspective, reducing the visibility and appeal of vaping products is part of a broader effort to prevent nicotine addiction. news.impact: 口味监管正从青少年保护向戒烟工具属性外溢，折射减害政策与公共卫生目标间的结构性张力。此类政策将迫使品牌重新评估风味组合在成年戒烟场景中的角色，并可能加速行业向标准化、医疗化路径收敛。需警惕的是，单一政策效果受黑市、跨境购买与替代品竞争干扰，现有报道缺乏行为数据支撑，结论宜审慎。长期看，风味监管与戒烟证据体系的耦合将成研究重点。

news.title: 美属维尔京群岛电子烟监管新规
news.summary: 美属维尔京群岛出台电子烟综合监管法规，涵盖购买年龄限制、零售许可制度、室内使用禁令及跨州运输限制。该法规体系效仿美国本土州级监管框架，将电子烟纳入与传统烟草类似的管控轨道。对面向加勒比市场或跨境运输的电子烟品牌而言，合规成本与渠道准入壁垒将上升，需重新评估分销与物流安排。
news.body: Key regulatory considerations include restrictions on sales to individuals under 21, licensing requirements for retailers, indoor vaping policies, and limitations on shipping vaping products to the islands. Each The U.S. Virgin Islands demonstrates why vaping regulations must be evaluated according to the jurisdiction in which a transaction or activity takes place. The area involves distinct compliance considerations, and the applicable requirements may depend on the product, business activity, or location. The U.S. Virgin Islands prohibits the sale or distribution of electronic cigarettes and alternative nicotine products to individuals under 21. This restriction is a fundamental component of the territory's approach to regulating access to covered products. Retailers must establish procedures designed to prevent prohibited sales. Appropriate age-verification practices, employee training, and clear internal policies can help businesses meet their obligations and reduce the risk of regulatory violations. These responsibilities are particularly relevant to retailers offering a broad range of products, including electronic cigarettes, replacement cartridges, and other nicotine-related items. Businesses should verify the specific product categories covered by current territorial law and ensure their procedures account for applicable requirements. The minimum-age restriction also applies to consumers visiting from other jurisdictions. Individuals should not assume that the laws governing purchases in their home state determine what is permitted in the USVI. Local requirements must be followed when conducting transactions within the territory. For retailers, compliance should be treated as an ongoing operational responsibility rather than a one-time administrative task. Businesses should review their age-verification procedures periodically and consult current official guidance when questions arise about the scope of the law. news.impact: 该事件折射出电子烟监管的「碎片化」长期趋势：即便小型属地市场也在建立独立许可与运输规则，全球监管正从产品安全向渠道、物流、场所全链条延伸。品牌方需将合规能力视为市场准入的核心资产，而非事后应对。需注意该信息来自行业媒体，具体条款细节与执行力度尚待官方文本验证，不宜据此推断整体加勒比市场走向。长期看，监管套利空间收窄，渠道与合规的本地化布局将决定中小市场竞争力。

news.title: ALP targets Europe
news.summary: 据 Tobacco Journal International 报道，ALP 正将业务目标指向欧洲市场。结合欧洲监管分类，此举意味着该主体需面对欧盟及成员国在烟草与新型尼古丁产品上的准入、成分披露、包装与广告限制等合规框架。报道未披露产品形态、目标国家、时间表与规模，故其实际影响取决于具体品类与渠道策略，短期内更可能是布局信号而非可量化份额变化。
news.impact: 欧洲尼古丁与烟草市场正沿监管趋严与品类替代两条主线重构：传统卷烟受限，新型口含与雾化品类在合规缝隙中扩张，跨境主体的进入因而更像监管套利与渠道卡位，而非单纯品牌扩张。需注意，单一行业媒体报道缺少份额、销量与申报进度数据，难以判断其真实体量，也不排除信息释放本身带有招商或议价意图。长期看，监管合规能力正取代营销能力成为该领域核心壁垒，研究方宜把政策节奏纳入品类预测，品牌方则应把准入成本前置为结构性投入。

news.title: BAT Malaysia Profit Plunges 67%
news.summary: 据 Nicotine Insider 报道，英美烟草马来西亚公司（BAT Malaysia）利润同比骤降 67%。该消息以单一利润指标为核心，未在标题层面披露营收、销量、市场份额或具体财年区间，也未说明下滑源于合法市场萎缩、非法卷烟冲击还是成本与定价因素。对以马来西亚为重要市场的跨国烟草企业而言，这一幅度意味着盈利结构承压，并可能牵动渠道投入、品牌组合与合规策略的再评估。
news.body: Facebook Instagram TikTok Mastodon X Search AboutContact BAT Malaysia Profit Plunges 67% Illicit cigarette sales and a shrinking legal market continue to pressure revenue as costs ease. By Timothy S. Donahue British American Tobacco Malaysia is making money again, but not nearly as much as it did a year ago. The company reported a 67% decline in third-quarter net profit to RM2.3 million (US$567,000), down from RM7 million (US$1.72 million) a year earlier, as illicit cigarette sales and a shrinking legal tobacco market continued to weigh on its business. Revenue for the quarter ended September 30 reached RM302 million (US$74.4 million), while operating expenses declined 40% from the previous quarter to RM46.4 million (US$11.4 million) as costs related to its Route-to-Market (RTM) transformation program eased. For the first nine months of 2026, BAT Malaysia recorded a net loss of RM22.2 million (US$5.47 million), compared with a profit of RM81 million (US$19.95 million) in the same period last year. Nine-month revenue declined by approximately 18.5% to RM977.6 million (US$240.8 million), compared with RM1.2 billion (US$295.6 million) a year earlier. Despite weaker year-over-year results, the company reported sequential improvements as one-time restructuring expenses declined. BAT Malaysia returned to profitability in the second and third quarters, reducing its cumulative net loss from RM24.5 million (US$6.04 million) at the end of June to RM22.2 million at the end of September. The results highlight the challenges facing Malaysia’s legal tobacco industry, as illicit cigarette sales continue to pressure legitimate manufacturers and erode legal market volumes. BAT Malaysia’s RTM transformation program has also affected its financial performance, although declining implementation costs helped improve profitability in the latest quarter. The company’s board declared a third interim dividend of 2 sen per ordinary share, totaling RM5.7 million (US$1.40 million), payable on
news.impact: 单点利润跌幅本身信息量有限，却折射出烟草类快消品在成熟与半成熟市场的结构性困境：监管收紧、非法贸易侵蚀税基、消费习惯迁移共同压缩合法玩家的盈利空间。需警惕的是，此类行业媒体常以单一财务指标放大叙事，缺乏销量、份额与渠道结构佐证，结论易被过度解读。对研究方与品牌方的长期启发是：应把利润波动拆解为量、价、结构三层，并建立对非法贸易与监管变量的持续追踪，而非以短期财报数字判断市场健康度。

news.title: 环球烟草定档11月5日财报电话会
news.summary: 据 Nicotine Insider 消息，Universal（环球烟草）将11月5日召开财报电话会。作为以雪茄等烟草品类为主的美国公司，其季度业绩与电话会指引通常反映传统可燃烟草的价格弹性、渠道库存与监管成本传导。标题未披露具体业绩数据与议程，实际看点仍待会议内容确认。
news.body: Facebook Instagram TikTok Mastodon X Search AboutContact (Credit: Universal Corporation) Universal Sets November 5th Earnings Call The tobacco leaf supplier will release fiscal second-quarter results after markets close Nov. 4. news.title: JT Raises Outlook as Ploom Sales Surge
news.summary: 日本烟草（JT）上调业绩展望，主因其加热不燃烧产品Ploom销量激增。该消息显示，在传统卷烟需求长期萎缩的背景下，JT正将增长重心转向减害型烟草替代品，Ploom的市场表现已成为其业绩预期上修的关键驱动。此举也意味着JT在加热不燃烧赛道对菲莫国际IQOS等竞品的追赶力度加大，日本及海外市场的份额格局值得持续观察。
news.body: Facebook Instagram TikTok Mastodon X Search AboutContact JT Raises Outlook as Ploom Sales Surge Strong cigarette pricing lifts profits while heated tobacco expansion drives RRP growth. By Timothy S. Donahue Japan Tobacco is selling fewer cigarettes but making considerably more money from them, while Ploom’s expanding heated-tobacco business gives the company another engine for growth. The Tokyo-based tobacco company raised its full-year earnings forecast on Oct. 29 after reporting a 16.9% increase in adjusted operating profit at constant currency for the first nine months of 2026, driven by strong cigarette pricing and continued growth in reduced-risk products (RRP). Operating profit increased by 24.2%, while net profit rose by 21%. Favorable foreign exchange movements, including the Russian ruble’s appreciation against the yen, contributed to the reported results. Tobacco core revenue increased 8.7% at constant currency, with pricing and product mix contributing 9.6 percentage points. The gains offset declines in combustible volumes, increased Ploom investment, and higher manufacturing and operating costs. “Robust pricing [continues] to be the primary growth driver across many markets,” CFO Hiromasa Furukawa said during the company’s third-quarter earnings briefing. Total tobacco volume declined by just 0.3% over the nine-month period, while combustible volume fell 1%. Reduced-risk product volume, however, increased 31.1%, supported by Ploom AURA’s expansion in Japan and contributions from LYO, JT’s tobacco-free heated nicotine sticks in Europe. Ploom’s share of the heated tobacco category across JT’s initial 13 markets reached 11.6% in August, reflecting ongoing marketing investment and product expansion. Japan remained a particularly important market, although tobacco tax increases in April and October complicated quarterly shipment patterns. news.impact: 这一动向折射出跨国烟草巨头增长逻辑的结构性迁移：可燃卷烟收缩、新型烟草承接增量，业绩指引对单一产品线的敏感度上升。但需注意，标题仅披露销量激增与展望上调，未给出绝对规模、区域分布与利润率，销售增长是否转化为可持续盈利仍存疑，且监管趋严与品类竞争会放大波动。对研究方与品牌方的长期启发是：应把新型烟草的消费者转化路径与感官接受度纳入独立评估框架，避免以短期销量替代对品类结构性健康的判断。

news.title: 奥驰亚上调预期 卷烟利润攀升
news.summary: 奥驰亚集团上调业绩展望，主要受卷烟业务利润增长驱动。在销量长期承压的背景下，提价能力与成本控制成为利润改善的关键来源，也反映烟草巨头在传统可燃烟萎缩期仍能维持现金流。此举对依赖尼古丁品类的渠道与竞品定价策略具有参考意义。

By Timothy S. Donahue Altria is selling fewer cigarettes, earning more from them, and fighting to keep pace in nicotine pouches. That combination helped lift third-quarter earnings and prompted the company to raise its full-year outlook. The Richmond, Virginia-based tobacco company reported on Oct. 29 that third-quarter net revenues increased 1% to $6.13 billion, while revenues excluding excise taxes rose 3.6% to $5.44 billion. Adjusted diluted earnings per share increased 4.8% to $1.52, and reported EPS climbed 7.1% to $1.51. Altria raised its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $5.66–$5.74, reflecting 4.5% to 6% growth over 2025. The company also announced a $1 billion expansion of its share repurchase program, which now extends through December 2027. “Altria delivered strong financial performance in the third quarter, growing adjusted diluted earnings per share by 4.8%, while continuing to invest in our Vision and building on our foundation for the future,” said CEO Sal Mancuso. The company’s smokeable products business continued to generate higher profits despite declining cigarette consumption. Adjusted operating companies’ income increased 3.9% to $3.07 billion, supported by higher pricing and increased refunds of taxes and duties paid on imported cigarettes. “In smokeable products, PM USA grew operating companies income through its data-driven, total portfolio approach, with Cowboy Cut strengthening Marlboro’s premium position and Basic continuing to gain share in discount,” Mancuso said. The company’s smoke-free business presented a more complex picture. Shipments of on! nicotine pouches increased 13.3% to 47.8 million cans, up from 42.2 million a year earlier. However, on!’s share of the nicotine pouch category fell 1.3 percentage points to 13.5%, including a 0.9-point s
news.impact: 该事件折射出成熟品类衰退期的典型结构：销量下滑但利润上行，靠定价权与品牌忠诚度对冲总量收缩。需注意，此类结论多基于企业口径与单一信源，缺少销量、份额与区域拆分，难以判断是行业普涨还是份额集中。对研究者的长期启发是，应把「量价背离」作为监测成熟快消品类的核心框架，并区分结构性提价与短期成本传导；品牌方则需警惕提价空间随替代品渗透而收窄。

news.title: 英国新烟草与电子烟法规生效
news.summary: 英国新的烟草与电子烟法规正式生效， Trading Standards 对法规“堵住漏洞”表示欢迎。新规预计将收紧电子烟在口味、包装、陈列与销售渠道等方面的限制，并强化对非法与不合规产品的执法。对品牌而言，合规成本与产品组合调整压力上升，渠道陈列与沟通空间收窄，市场将加速向合规能力强的头部集中。
news.body: By Tony Corbin in Featured, Industry News 29th October 2026 The Chartered Trading Standards Institute (CTSI) has welcomed the next phase of the Tobacco and Vapes Act, which comes into force today (29 October 2026), closing long-standing loopholes that Trading Standards has been calling on the government to address. From today, it is an offence across the UK to sell any vaping or nicotine product to anyone under the age of 18. In England, Wales and Northern Ireland, this includes non-nicotine vapes and nicotine products such as nicotine pouches for the first time, products which until now could legally be sold to children. The public might be surprised to learn that these products were not already age restricted. Trading Standards said officers regularly hear from concerned parents and members of the public who assume these products are already age restricted and are shocked to be told that no offence has been committed and no action can be taken. These changes put that right. Key changes coming into force: From 29 October 2026: The following changes seek to protect children from becoming addicted to nicotine and give Trading Standards the tools to act: Retailers who are unsure whether a customer attempting to buy vaping or nicotine products is aged 18 or over should verify the customer’s age. The overwhelming majority of retailers already have strong age verification procedures in place, and they are encouraged to review the government guidance, brief their staff and make sure their policies now cover all vaping and nicotine products, including nicotine pouches. CTSI has previously urged retailers to prepare for these changes, joining forces with public health organisations earlier this year to set out what businesses need to know ahead of the new rules. CTSI said it is continuing to support businesses through this next phase, providing support, guidance and training on the new rules so that retailers understand their responsibilities and can comply with confidence.
news.impact: 这是欧洲监管持续收紧的缩影：电子烟正从“消费品”向“受控嗜好品”迁移，监管重心从准入转向口味、包装与渠道的系统性约束。此类政策多基于公共健康立场，缺乏对消费者替代行为与非法市场溢出效应的量化评估，效果仍待观察。长期看，合规能力将成核心壁垒，品牌需把监管情景纳入产品与渠道规划，而非被动应对。

news.title: Altria: Q3 2026 Results
news.summary: Altria 发布 2026 年第三季度业绩。标题仅披露发布时间与主体，未给出营收、利润、出货量或减害产品等具体数字，故无法量化判断。作为美国烟草巨头，其季报通常反映可燃烟定价与销量韧性、口含烟等无烟品类的扩张节奏，以及监管与诉讼环境对盈利的影响，是观察传统烟草转型的关键窗口。
news.body: Notes: Following four consecutive years of net revenue declines (FY2022-25), Altria is expected to return to modest top-line growth in 2026. Altria started the year on solid footing, reporting a 3.1% increase in net revenue (ex-excise) in H1 2026. Q2 ($1.48) and Q3 are typically Altria’s strongest quarters in terms of earnings seasonality. Altria delivered a solid Q3 2026 performance, demonstrating continued pricing power in combustibles and earnings resilience despite persistent macroeconomic pressures on adult nicotine consumers. Adjusted Diluted EPS grew 4.8% year over year (yoy) to $1.52 (beats $1.51 consensus estimate), supported primarily by higher adjusted Operating Companies Income (OCI) in the smokeable products segment and improved earnings from its investment in Anheuser-Busch InBev (ABI). Net revenue excluding excise taxes increased 3.6% to $5.44 billion (beats $5.31 billion consensus estimate). However, underlying volume trends remain challenging. Domestic cigarette shipments declined 2.9%, while the shift toward discount cigarettes continued to accelerate, reflecting consumer affordability pressures. In oral tobacco, strong growth in on! shipments was insufficient to offset continued declines in traditional moist smokeless tobacco (MST), while the segment’s adjusted OCI and margins contracted. Altria’s smoke-free expansion remains centered on on! PLUS, with new flavor extensions and broader distribution intended to strengthen its competitive position in nicotine pouches. Management raised its full-year 2026 Adjusted EPS guidance from $5.61-$5.72 to $5.66-$5.74, representing growth of 4.5% to 6.0% from $5.42 in FY2025. The revised range reflects confidence in Altria’s performance through the first nine months of the year. The company also announced a $1 billion expansion of its existing share repurchase program, extending its expiration date to December 31, 2027. news.impact: 单看标题不足以支撑结论，但可提示结构性趋势：烟草行业正处在可燃烟现金牛与新型尼古丁产品并行的过渡期，巨头业绩越来越取决于提价能力与无烟品类的组合而非单纯销量。需注意季报属公司口径，披露选择性较强，缺乏出货量拆分会掩盖真实需求变化。对研究者的长期启发是，应把监管、成瘾性消费粘性与品类替代放在同一框架观察，而非以单季数字判断转型成败。

news.title: Bangladesh: Tobacco Market
news.summary: 该报道聚焦孟加拉国烟草市场，涉及市场规模、消费结构与监管环境等议题。作为南亚人口大国，孟加拉国烟草消费基数庞大，本土与国际品牌并存，税收与控烟政策对市场格局影响显著。报道属市场观察性质，具体数据与政策细节需以原文为准。
news.body: A compression in gross revenue (inclusive of Supplementary Duty and VAT) alongside elevated operating overheads weighed heavily on the quarterly performance of British American Tobacco (BAT) Bangladesh. During the third quarter (July-September) of 2026, the company’s net revenue declined by 24.9% year-on-year to Tk1,259.6 crore, down from Tk1,677.1 crore recorded in the corresponding period of 2025, driven primarily by lower sales volume and reduced market turnover. This top-line contraction – coupled with higher operating costs stemming from ongoing inflationary pressures – directly squeezed the company’s bottom line. Net profit after tax plummeted by 67.3% year-on-year to Tk99.8 crore in Q3 2026, down steeply from Tk305.0 crore in Q3 2025. Consequently, basic earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter dropped to Tk1.85, compared to Tk5.65 a year earlier. These quarterly pressures also impacted cumulative performance for the first nine months (January-September) of 2026. Cumulative net revenue contracted to Tk5,090 crore from Tk5,754 crore, while cumulative net profit after tax fell by 28.8% to Tk513.0 crore from Tk720.3 crore – lowering nine-month cumulative EPS to Tk9.50 from Tk13.34. Despite the earnings pressure, the company strengthened its liquidity and cash position during the nine-month period. Net operating cash flow turned significantly positive to Tk2,270.9 crore (compared to a negative Tk1,171.9 crore in 9M 2025), aided by lower duty/VAT outflows on reduced volumes. Furthermore, BAT Bangladesh completely paid off its Tk970 crore in short-term bank borrowings, clearing its short-term loan debt entirely by the end of the third quarter. As one of the world’s top 10 cigarette markets by volume, Bangladesh occupies a central position in the global tobacco landscape. news.impact: 南亚烟草市场正处在人口红利、税收压力与控烟趋严的多重张力中，孟加拉国是观察这一结构性变化的典型样本。此类市场报道多依赖二手数据与行业口径，需警惕统计口径与立场偏差。对研究方而言，长期启发在于将监管变量纳入市场预测模型，并区分销量增长与价值增长的驱动差异，而非仅关注单一市场规模数字。

news.title: Japan Tobacco: Q3 2026 Results
news.summary: 日本烟草（JT）发布2026财年第三季度业绩。作为全球主要跨国烟草公司之一，该季度结果反映其核心可燃烟业务的韧性与新型烟草产品（如加热不燃烧Ploom）的推进节奏。标题未披露具体财务数据，故不宜对营收、销量或份额作量化推断；其意义更多在于为观察日本及海外市场的品类结构变化、定价策略与监管环境影响提供节点性参照。
news.body: Japan Tobacco (JT) delivered another quarter of solid financial growth, supported by resilient combustible pricing, continued market share gains, and accelerating momentum in Heated Products (Ploom). For the first nine months of 2026, consolidated revenue increased 13.6% year over year, while adjusted operating profit (AOP) rose 21.6%. On a constant-FX basis, core revenue and AOP increased 8.4% and 16.9%, respectively, highlighting continued underlying growth alongside the contribution from favorable foreign exchange. In Q3 alone, revenue increased 6.1% year over year to ¥1,005.3 billion (misses ¥1,020 billion consensus estimate), while AOP rose 13.0% to ¥310.7 billion. Basic EPS is down 2.7% to ¥105.1 (misses ¥111.5 consensus estimate). Consolidated tobacco volumes declined 2.5%, reflecting a 3.2% decrease in combustibles volume (vs. +0.2% in H1 2026) that more than offset 26.6% growth in RRP volume. Management raised its full-year 2026 forecasts for revenue, profitability, and earnings per share (EPS), while reducing its free cash flow (FCF) projection and maintaining its annual dividend target. The Tobacco Business remains JT’s principal earnings engine, accounting for 92% of the consolidated revenue and 100+% of the adjusted operating profit. In Q3, segment core revenue increased 6.3% on a reported basis and 5.4% at constant FX, while AOP rose 13.0% reported and 12.3% at constant FX. – Profitability Drivers: Strong pricing contributions across major markets, supported by favorable product mix and currency movements, more than offset the negative volume variance and inflation-related costs. The Q3 price/mix contribution to tobacco AOP was ¥74.5 billion, while volume contributed negatively. At constant FX, segment AOP reached ¥320.1 billion, compared with ¥285.3 billion in Q3 2025. – Total Tobacco Volume: Declined 2.5% year over year to 151.4 billion units. news.impact: 单季业绩本身信息有限，但放在结构层面看，全球烟草行业正经历可燃烟现金流收缩与新型烟草合规化扩张并行的长期转型，企业表现越来越取决于品类迁移速度与监管适配能力，而非单一市场销量。需注意，仅凭标题无法判断增长来自提价、份额还是新品，媒体口径亦可能带有立场偏向，量化结论应回到原始财报核对。对研究者的长期启发是：跟踪此类企业应把监管变量与品类替代节奏纳入统一框架，而非孤立解读单季数字。

news.title: Japan: Heated Tobacco Promotions
news.summary: 据 Tobacco Insider 报道，日本加热不燃烧烟草市场近期促销活动升温，各品牌通过终端陈列、体验活动和渠道激励争夺成年烟民。文章属产品技术分类，反映加热不燃烧品类在监管框架下的市场推广动态，但摘要未披露具体品牌、投放规模与销售数据，需谨慎看待其代表性。
news.body: Philip Morris Japan (PMJ) has rolled out its fourth nationwide convenience store promotion of 2026 for the IQOS ILUMA i series, initiating a Black Friday “early discount” wave across major Japanese retail chains. The limited-time promotion, running across major Japanese convenience stores including 7-Eleven, FamilyMart, and Lawson, slashes prices across the entire flagship lineup by up to ¥2,000 PMJ’s latest promotional drive comes immediately after rival Japan Tobacco (JT) concluded an aggressive discount campaign on October 25 for its Ploom AURA device, which temporarily cut entry pricing down to ¥1,480 (US$9.4). The back-to-back hardware discounts highlight an increasingly competitive fight for consumer acquisition and retention in Japan’s mature heated tobacco market. Following two separate tax adjustments in 2026 that raised consumable stick prices – pushing flagship TEREA packs up to ¥640 (US$4.1) – both manufacturers are using discounted starter hardware to reduce barrier-to-entry costs for new consumers. While JT has steadily grown its domestic category share from 10.9% in January 2024 to 18.3% in June 2026, Philip Morris International continues to command the Japanese market, with IQOS retaining approximately 68% share. Industry shifts indicate that British American Tobacco’s glo platform has served as the primary share donor in the category, allowing JT to pick up ground while PMI maintains its strong market lead.
news.impact: 加热不燃烧品类的竞争正从设备硬件转向口味组合、使用体验与渠道触达的系统性运营，促销升温说明品类进入存量争夺阶段，单靠新奇感已难支撑增长。需注意该报道缺乏可核验的销量与份额数据，且媒体立场可能放大促销现象；日本市场的监管与渠道结构也限制其外推性。对研究方而言，应把感官体验与消费者分层、渠道策略结合观察，而非将促销视为增长本身。

news.title: Imperial Brands: Major Shareholders

news.title: 电子烟戒烟：有支持效果翻倍
news.summary: 报道称，戒烟者单独使用电子烟即可获得一定帮助，而在配合专业戒烟支持时，成功率约为无支持情况的两倍。该结论指向电子烟作为戒烟工具的潜力取决于是否叠加行为或医疗支持，而非产品本身单独起效。对公共卫生与戒烟服务设计具有参考意义，但报道未披露研究设计、样本量与对照条件，结论强度需谨慎看待。
news.body: A British randomised trial published in NEJM Evidence shows that a simple vape kit sent by post helps more people quit smoking than automated support emails. Adding a few phone calls could almost double the chances of success. There is no longer any doubt that e-cigarettes help people quit smoking: the Cochrane review, which pools the randomised trials on the subject, concludes with high certainty that they outperform nicotine replacement therapy. However, most of these trials provided vaping alongside multi-session behavioural support. This was the case, for example, in the British trial published in 2019 in the New England Journal of Medicine, in which vaping, combined with four weeks of face-to-face support, was almost twice as effective as nicotine replacement therapy (18.0% quit at one year versus 9.9%). But such support is not always available, nor wanted by smokers. Cochrane also considers the evidence comparing vaping with behavioural support alone or no support to be less reliable, because of how the available studies were designed. This is precisely the question a new trial from Queen Mary University of London set out to answer. The trial was published in NEJM Evidence and funded by the NIHR, the UK’s public health research institute. The researchers recruited 1,170 adults who smoked daily and wanted to quit. Participants smoked an average of 19 cigarettes a day, were 48 years old on average, and most had already tried stop-smoking treatments. They were randomly assigned to one of three groups: The kit consisted of a battery and a tank, two 10 ml bottles of e-liquid at 18 mg/ml (tobacco and strawberry flavours), five spare coils and a guide to buying more supplies. It was expected to last around two weeks, after which participants bought whatever they needed themselves. The study’s primary outcome was demanding: continuous abstinence at six months, validated by measuring carbon monoxide (CO) in exhaled breath. Participants lost to follow-up were counted as
news.impact: 这一信息折射出减害产品正从“替代品叙事”转向“服务嵌入叙事”：产品效果越来越取决于配套的咨询、随访与行为干预体系，而非硬件本身。对品牌方而言，长期竞争力可能落在戒烟支持生态与真实世界证据建设上，而非单纯口味或设备迭代。需注意，此类结论多源于特定研究情境，外推至不同监管与人群环境时效应可能显著衰减，且行业资助研究存在立场偏倚风险，证据质量应作为独立审视维度。

news.title: 摩洛哥拟翻倍电子烟税并扩至可注油设备
news.summary: 摩洛哥计划将电子烟税负提高一倍，并把征税范围从一次性产品扩展至可注油设备。此举意味着监管从产品形态转向按品类统一课税，可能抬高终端价格、压缩低价产品空间，并推动消费者转向替代渠道或自制油方案。对以价格敏感市场为增长点的品牌而言，税基扩大比税率本身更值得关注。
news.body: Morocco’s 2027 finance bill would double the consumption tax on e-cigarettes to 100 dirhams per unit and, for the first time, apply it to refillable devices and their components. A year ago, the same minister rejected any increase. Morocco’s Council of Government adopted Finance Bill No. 60-26 for 2027 on 20 October, and the text was presented to parliament three days later. Article 5 of the bill published by the Ministry of Economy and Finance amends the 1977 dahir governing domestic consumption taxes (TIC): from 1 January 2027, e-cigarettes would be taxed at 100 dirhams per unit. The measure does more than double the rate. The 50-dirham levy created by the 2025 Finance Law only applied to disposable e-cigarettes. The new bill would cover every type of device. The bill inserts a definition of the e-cigarette into the TIC dahir. It covers any device that can be used to inhale vapour, with or without nicotine, through a mouthpiece, as well as any component of such a device, including cartridges, tanks and devices sold without a cartridge or tank. The product may be disposable, refillable with a bottle or tank, or recharged with single-use cartridges, and may be sold empty or prefilled. Article 3 of the bill also adds e-cigarettes to the list of goods on which the customs administration collects domestic consumption taxes. E-liquid rates are left untouched: only the e-cigarette line of the relevant tax table is amended. Morocco already taxes vaping liquids, and according to Le Desk, refills remain taxed at 5 to 10 dirhams per 10 ml bottle. The bill’s explanatory note puts forward two arguments. In its customs section, it says that limiting the tax to disposables led to new products designed to escape it, citing “CKD” products and empty pods. The note does not define CKD, a term generally used for goods shipped unassembled. In its tax section, the note points to a wide range of new devices that work as both disposable and refillable e-cigarettes. It also presents the m
news.impact: 这反映的是全球控烟财政化与税基扩张的结构性趋势：监管正从限制尼古丁产品转向扩大可征税品类，税负成为市场准入的隐性门槛。需注意，单一媒体报道缺乏税率细则与实施时间，难以量化真实价格弹性。长期看，品牌应把监管成本纳入品类选择与供应链布局，而非仅以口味或低价竞争；研究方则需区分税收转嫁与消费替代，避免把政策信号误读为确定的市场萎缩。

news.title: 爱尔兰推动妥协 立陶宛接任欧盟轮值主席
news.summary: 在立陶宛接任欧盟轮值主席国前，爱尔兰正做最后努力，推动各方就欧盟烟草与电子烟监管框架达成妥协。此事反映成员国在修订《烟草产品指令》等议题上的立场分歧，涉及口味限制、广告规范与产品准入等关键条款，结果将影响欧洲电子烟市场的合规路径与政策走向。
news.body: The Irish presidency of the EU Council has tabled a new compromise on the overhaul of EU tobacco taxation, which would for the first time subject e-liquids to a minimum excise duty. Dublin hopes finance ministers will reach agreement on November 9. But Sweden, which has been blocking the text since June, still has no new government, and the file could pass in January to Lithuania, one of Europe’s most restrictive countries on vaping. A few days ago, two compromise texts drafted by the Irish presidency and dated October 20 were sent to the delegations of the EU Member States. One concerns the directive on the structure and rates of excise duty, the other the directive on the general arrangements for excise duty. Classified “LIMITE”, they have not been made public. They were presented on Monday, October 26, to the Council’s High-Level Working Party on Tax Questions, whose agenda provided for an exchange of views “with a view to reaching agreement”. The finance ministers’ vote, initially expected at the October Ecofin, had been postponed to the November 9 Ecofin to give Sweden time to form a new government. The previous compromise, drafted by the Cypriot presidency, was withdrawn from the agenda in June, and the European Parliament then rejected the text by 439 votes to 181. Sweden is the reform’s main opponent. In April, Swedish Minister for Foreign Trade Benjamin Dousa pledged that his government would do everything it could to block the EU tax increase on nicotine pouches. Stockholm is not alone, however. Since the Commission presented its proposal in July 2025, around ten Member States have expressed reservations. Italy fears a rise in smuggling and, together with Romania, an impact on low-income smokers. Portugal is concerned about its fiscal sovereignty. Greece, Hungary, Croatia, Malta, Czechia, Slovakia and Luxembourg, for their part, consider the proposed minimum excise rates too high. Sweden has been run by a caretaker government since September 17. Defeated i
news.impact: 单一成员国的斡旋凸显欧盟决策的碎片化：监管趋严方向明确，但节奏与力度受轮值主席国更替和成员国博弈牵制。对行业而言，合规成本上升与市场准入不确定性将长期并存。需注意，本文仅呈现政治进程，缺乏条款细节与数据支撑，难以判断具体影响幅度。长期启发是，品牌应把监管情景纳入产品组合与配方规划，而非押注单一政策结果；研究者亦应区分政策信号与实际落地之间的时滞。

news.title: 英国禁售尼古丁产品予未成年人
news.summary: 英国正式立法禁止向18岁以下人群销售尼古丁产品，将原本针对烟草制品的年龄限制扩展至电子烟及新型尼古丁制品。此举反映监管层对青少年尼古丁成瘾风险的警惕升级，也意味着电子烟品类在欧美市场面临的口径正从「减害替代」转向「未成年人保护优先」，对品牌合规、渠道管理与产品定位均构成直接影响。
news.body: Special EditionAdvertiseCalendarIndustry GuideAboutOur MissionOur ReputationContactPrivacy PolicySearch UK Bans Sales of Nicotine Products to Under-18s The U.K. extended its age-of-sale restrictions to all nicotine products, including nicotine pouches, strips, and pearls, as well as nicotine-free vapes, effective Oct. 29 under the Tobacco and Vapes Act 2026. The changes apply across England, Wales, Scotland, and Northern Ireland. The law also prohibits adults from buying vaping or nicotine products on behalf of under-18s and bans promotional giveaways, substantial promotional discounts, and vending-machine sales of vaping and nicotine products. Retailers face fixed penalty notices of £200 for relevant offenses in England, Wales, and Scotland, with Northern Ireland’s penalty subject to approval by its assembly. Haypp’s Dr. Marina Murphy said the new age restrictions close a legal loophole that had allowed nicotine pouches to be sold to under-18s because they contain no tobacco and are not inhaled. Scotland is separately requiring retailers selling tobacco, vaping, nicotine, and herbal smoking products to register by April 29, 2027.
news.impact: 这并非孤立的国别动作，而是全球尼古丁监管逻辑的结构性转向：监管重心从成人减害叙事迁移至未成年人入口管控，电子烟的政策红利窗口正在收窄。需注意，此类政策效果评估多依赖销售与使用率数据，而黑市替代、跨渠道规避等变量常被低估，公开论证亦掺杂公共卫生立场与产业利益，结论需谨慎。对研究方，青少年行为与感知研究应前置为合规依据；对品牌，长期启发在于将年龄验证与产品沟通纳入核心战略，而非事后补救。

news.title: 瑞典反对欧盟烟草税上调
news.summary: 瑞典在欧盟会议前表态反对提高烟草税，立场与部分主张加税的成员国形成分歧。烟草税涉及公共健康、财政收入与非法贸易等多重目标，成员国利益差异使统一税率谈判复杂化。瑞典的反对可能延缓或削弱加税方案，也反映欧盟烟草监管中主权与协调之间的张力。
news.body: Special EditionAdvertiseCalendarIndustry GuideAboutOur MissionOur ReputationContactPrivacy PolicySearch Sweden Opposes EU Tobacco Tax Increase Ahead of Meeting Sweden is expected to oppose a proposed European Union overhaul of tobacco excise taxes at a Nov. 9 meeting of EU finance ministers, according to an EU official cited by Law360. The proposal would substantially increase minimum excise duties on cigarettes and other traditional tobacco products and introduce EU-wide minimum taxes for nicotine pouches, e-cigarettes, and heated tobacco. EU tax legislation requires unanimous approval by member states, meaning Sweden’s opposition could block the proposal in its current form. Sweden has objected particularly to proposed minimum taxes on tobacco-free nicotine pouches, arguing that member states should retain the ability to set tax rates according to differences in product risk. The European Commission’s July 2025 proposal would also introduce new tax categories for e-cigarette liquids and heated tobacco, while excluding traditional tobacco snus. EU ambassadors discussed a revised compromise in October, and finance ministers are scheduled to consider the package on Nov. 9.
news.impact: 烟草税分歧折射欧盟健康治理与成员国财政主权的结构性矛盾：加税在公共健康叙事下推进，却受非法贸易、跨境价差与农民生计等现实约束。此类博弈的长期结果是监管碎片化与政策节奏放慢，而非单一税率收敛。对研究方而言，需警惕将监管信号简单等同于消费变化；品牌方应关注税制差异如何重塑渠道与价格带，而非仅盯单次表决。

news.title: 奥驰亚上调2026年盈利指引
news.summary: 奥驰亚在第三季度实现增长后上调2026年盈利指引，反映其在传统烟草需求承压背景下仍维持定价能力与利润韧性。该动向显示公司正通过提价、成本控制及新型烟草布局对冲销量结构性下滑，对同业与监管观察者具有信号意义。
news.body: Special EditionAdvertiseCalendarIndustry GuideAboutOur MissionOur ReputationContactPrivacy PolicySearch Altria Raises 2026 Earnings Guidance After Third-Quarter Growth Altria Group reported third-quarter net revenue of $6.13 billion, up 1% year over year, while adjusted diluted earnings per share increased 4.8% to $1.52. Revenue excluding excise taxes rose 3.6% to $5.44 billion, driven primarily by higher revenue from smokeable products. Cigarette shipment volume fell 2.9%, including a 6.4% decline for Marlboro, while discount cigarette shipments increased 40.5%. Oral tobacco revenue declined 0.1%, and operating companies’ income for the segment fell 5.4%. For the first nine months of 2026, net revenue increased 1.4% to $17.67 billion, while adjusted diluted earnings per share rose 5.1% to $4.33. Altria raised its full-year adjusted earnings guidance to $5.66-$5.74 per share, representing growth of 4.5%-6% from 2025. The company also authorized a $1 billion expansion of its share repurchase program, bringing the program’s expiration date to Dec. 31, 2027.
news.impact: 该事件折射烟草行业的结构性主线：可燃烟销量长期下行，巨头依靠提价与产品组合升级维持盈利，盈利指引上调更多体现定价权而非需求扩张。需注意其基于公司口径、缺乏销量与品类拆分细节，不宜外推为行业整体回暖。对品牌方的长期启发是：在需求收缩品类中，利润管理能力与新型品类卡位将比规模增长更决定竞争位势。

news.title: 日烟上调2026年盈利预期
news.summary: 日本烟草在九个月利润增长后上调2026财年盈利预期，反映其以提价与产品结构升级对冲销量压力的能力。该动向显示传统烟草巨头在需求收缩环境中仍凭定价权与成本控制维持利润韧性，也为新型烟草投入提供现金流支撑。
news.body: Special EditionAdvertiseCalendarIndustry GuideAboutOur MissionOur ReputationContactPrivacy PolicySearch Japan Tobacco Raises 2026 Earnings Forecast After Nine-Month Profit Growth Japan Tobacco Inc. reported revenue of ¥2.99 trillion ($18.8 billion) for the first nine months of 2026, up 13.6% year over year, while operating profit increased 24.2% to ¥947.7 billion ($596.6 million). Profit attributable to the company’s owners rose 20.9% to ¥618.9 billion ($3.9 billion). Adjusted operating profit at constant exchange rates increased 16.9% to ¥934.7 billion ($5.9 billion), driven by pricing contributions across several markets, including the Philippines, Russia, Türkiye, the UK, and the U.S. Tobacco business core revenue rose 14.5% to ¥2.75 trillion ($17.3 billion), while reduced-risk product volume increased 31.1% and heated tobacco product volume grew 39.6%. JT raised its full-year 2026 forecast, projecting revenue of ¥3.9 trillion ($24.6 billion) and operating profit of ¥1.04 trillion ($6.6 billion). Adjusted operating profit is forecast at ¥1.08 trillion ($6.8 billion), up 21.9% from 2025, while profit attributable to owners is expected to reach ¥662 billion ($4.2 billion). The company also raised its forecast for adjusted operating profit at constant exchange rates to ¥1.03 trillion ($6.5 billion), an increase of 16.1%.
news.impact: 这折射出成熟品类在总量萎缩下的普遍路径：增长从销量转向价格与结构，利润表比销量表更能说明竞争力。需注意，企业指引属管理层预期，受汇率、监管与税负影响，不宜等同于行业景气回升。对研究方与品牌方而言，长期启发在于把监测重心从份额波动转向定价空间、品类替代节奏与政策成本传导，避免用单季利润误判需求趋势。

news.title: 韩国公布烟草有害成分检测结果
news.summary: 韩国官方发布烟草产品有害成分检测结果，属于产品技术监管范畴，涉及卷烟等品类中焦油、尼古丁及特定有害物质的披露。此举延续了韩国近年强化烟草成分信息公开的监管方向，对在韩销售的国际与本土品牌提出更高的配方透明度要求，也为其他市场的成分管制提供参照。
news.body: Special EditionAdvertiseCalendarIndustry GuideAboutOur MissionOur ReputationContactPrivacy PolicySearch S.Korea Releases Harmful-Ingredient Results for Tobacco Products South Korea released its first product-level harmful-ingredient test results for 465 tobacco products on Oct. 29, covering 256 conventional cigarettes, 104 heated-tobacco products, and 105 liquid e-cigarettes. The Ministry of Food and Drug Safety found formaldehyde, classified as a Group 1 carcinogen by the International Agency for Research on Cancer, in all 256 cigarette products, all 104 heated-tobacco products, and 99 of the 105 e-liquids tested. The tests covered 44 ingredients in cigarettes and heated-tobacco products and 20 in e-liquids, including nicotine, tar, and other potentially harmful substances. The government said it plans to develop testing methods to measure emissions generated during e-cigarette use, rather than testing liquids alone, and to begin testing and disclosing results for synthetic-nicotine products in 2027. The initial testing covered tobacco-derived nicotine products. Results for e-liquids reflect the contents of the liquids themselves and do not establish users’ exposure during inhalation or allow direct comparisons of health risks between product categories.
news.impact: 烟草成分强制披露正从个别市场扩散为全球性监管趋势，其本质是把产品内在构成从企业私域推向公共监督，重塑行业竞争基础。需注意单次检测结果样本与披露口径有限，难以直接推断长期健康效应或市场格局变化。对研究方而言，成分数据是可积累的纵向观察资源；对品牌方而言，配方透明度将逐步成为合规底线而非差异化卖点，提前建立成分管理与沟通能力更具长期价值。

news.title: 马来西亚BAT称非法烟占市场56%
news.summary: BAT马来西亚表示，非法卷烟已占该国市场56%，即超过一半的消费量落入未纳税渠道。这一比例反映出高税负与执法薄弱并存下，合法烟草商的销量与利润空间被持续挤压，也意味着政府税收流失与产品管控失效。对品牌方而言，价格带管理与渠道可见度正被非法产品重塑。
news.body: Special EditionAdvertiseCalendarIndustry GuideAboutOur MissionOur ReputationContactPrivacy PolicySearch BAT Malaysia Says Illicits Account for 56% of Market British American Tobacco (Malaysia) Bhd. said illicit cigarettes accounted for 56% of Malaysia’s total cigarette market volume as of July, down slightly from 56.2% in May but up from 54% at the end of 2025. The company welcomed the government’s enforcement funding under Budget 2027. BAT Malaysia reported third-quarter net profit of RM2.3 million on revenue of RM302 million, compared with revenue of RM300.8 million a year earlier. For the first nine months of 2026, revenue fell to RM977.6 million from RM1.2 billion, while the company reported a net loss of RM22.2 million, compared with RM24.5 million in the first half. The legal cigarette market contracted 3.9%, while BAT Malaysia’s sales volume fell 21.1%, reducing its market share by 1.9 percentage points. The company declared an interim dividend of two sen per share, totaling RM5.7 million, payable on Dec. 28.
news.impact: 高非法占比本质是税收政策、执法能力与消费价格敏感度共同作用的结构性结果，而非单一企业的经营问题。此类数据多由合法烟草商发布，存在以「非法占比」论证税负过重、争取政策话语权的立场偏向，需与独立测算交叉验证。长期看，当合法渠道份额被侵蚀，品牌的价格与合规优势会被灰色供给稀释，行业竞争逻辑从营销转向政策博弈；对研究者的启发是，市场规模的统计边界本身已成为需要审视的对象。

news.title: Skoka融资并提交55款袋装PMTA
news.summary: Skoka完成2150万美元融资，并向美国FDA提交55款尼古丁袋产品的PMTA申请。此举反映尼古丁袋赛道资本与合规投入同步升温：新进入者以融资支撑监管申报，试图在FDA审批门槛下建立合法市场地位，行业竞争正从产品铺货转向合规能力比拼。
news.body: Special EditionAdvertiseCalendarIndustry GuideAboutOur MissionOur ReputationContactPrivacy PolicySearch Skoka Raises $21.5 Million, Submits PMTA for 55 Pouch Products Skoka Inc. said it has raised $21.5 million and submitted a bundled Premarket Tobacco Product Application to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration covering 55 nicotine pouch products across 11 varieties and five strengths. The company submitted the application Oct. 1 and plans to begin U.S. retail distribution in 2027, subject to FDA authorization. Skoka said it has committed $15 million to its regulatory program, including pharmacokinetic studies, toxicology, stability testing, actual-use research, and label-comprehension studies. Founded in 2024 by Dan Aziz, Skoka developed its own formulations and has filed two patent applications covering ingredients and blending methods. The products are manufactured in the United States using globally sourced ingredients. Investors include executives and professional athletes, who invested in their individual capacities rather than as brand endorsers.
news.impact: 尼古丁袋品类正进入“合规即壁垒”阶段：PMTA申报数量与融资能力绑定，意味着中小品牌需以资本换取合法入场券，行业集中度可能上升。但单一企业申报规模不等于获批概率，FDA审评周期与证据要求仍是最大变量，融资额与产品数难以直接推断市场前景。长期看，合规成本将重塑品类竞争格局，品牌方需提前布局毒理与行为学证据链，而非仅靠渠道扩张。

news.title: 英国取消电子烟店商业税率减免引争议
news.summary: 英国政府取消电子烟零售店享有的商业税率减免，行业批评此举将加重合规零售商的经营成本，并可能促使其转向非法渠道或压缩门店网络。该政策反映监管层在控烟目标与产业生存之间的再平衡，对电子烟渠道结构与品牌分销策略构成直接压力。
news.body: Special EditionAdvertiseCalendarIndustry GuideAboutOur MissionOur ReputationContactPrivacy PolicySearch UK Removes Business Rates Relief for Vape Shops, Drawing Industry Criticism The UK government announced today (Oct. 28) that vape shops in England will lose eligibility for Small Business Rates Relief (SBRR) and reduced Retail, Hospitality and Leisure (RHL) business rates multipliers effective April 1, 2027, under its Autumn Budget 2026. The Treasury estimates the changes, which also remove RHL multiplier eligibility for adult gaming centers, will generate £10 million annually. The government is raising the SBRR threshold for qualifying retail, hospitality, and leisure properties to £18,000 in ratable value for full relief and £21,000 for tapered relief, measures it says will extend support to about 70,000 additional high street businesses. The government has not yet finalized the definition of a vape shop for the new rules. The UK Vaping Industry Association (UKVIA) criticized the decision, warning it could create a two-tier retail market in which specialist vape shops face additional costs while convenience stores selling the same products retain tax relief. “The Government risks creating a deeply unfair, two-tier vaping retail market in which responsible specialist retailers are financially penalized while other businesses selling exactly the same products continue to benefit from business rates relief,” said John Dunne, UKVIA director general. Dunne also questioned whether the Treasury’s projected £10 million in annual revenue justified the potential impact on legitimate retailers and jobs. UKVIA called on the government to clarify which businesses qualify and to introduce a retail licensing scheme that distinguishes compliant retailers from those selling illegal products or selling to minors. British e-liquid manufacturer Riot Labs estimated that an independent vape shop with a ratable value of £6,000 could face an annual bill of about £2,300, while one value
news.impact: 此举折射出发达市场对电子烟从「减害工具」向「受管制消费品」的制度性收拢：财政与公共卫生目标正取代产业友好政策。需注意，政策效果缺乏公开的渠道弹性数据，行业批评亦含立场偏差。长期看，品牌方应把渠道合规成本纳入市场准入评估，并警惕监管收紧通过零售端传导至产品组合与定价体系。

news.title: ITGA Marks World Tobacco Growers’ Day
news.summary: 国际烟草种植者协会（ITGA） marking 世界烟草种植者日，旨在关注全球烟叶种植群体的生计与产业贡献。该事件属于行业组织层面的象征性倡议，而非具体监管动作，反映烟叶供应链上游在控烟趋严与需求结构变化背景下的处境。对欧洲监管语境而言，其意义在于提示烟草价值链上游利益相关方仍在积极维护自身话语权，与下游控烟政策形成张力。
news.body: Special EditionAdvertiseCalendarIndustry GuideAboutOur MissionOur ReputationContactPrivacy PolicySearch ITGA Marks World Tobacco Growers’ Day The International Tobacco Growers’ Association (ITGA) marked World Tobacco Growers’ Day on Oct. 28, an annual observance established in 2012 to recognize tobacco-growing communities worldwide. ITGA President Marcílio Drescher extended his appreciation to tobacco growers and their families, acknowledging the work and challenges involved in farming. “We understand the hard work, dedication, and challenges that are part of the daily lives of tobacco-growing families,” Drescher said. “That is why we want to extend our warmest regards and heartfelt appreciation to every tobacco grower, as well as to all those who work hard to produce so much of the food we put on our tables.”
news.impact: 该事件本身信息量有限，更多是行业组织的仪式性表态，不宜据此推断具体产销数据或政策走向。但放诸长期趋势可见，控烟框架持续收紧与烟叶种植端生计诉求之间的矛盾将长期并存，供应链上游正试图通过话语建构争取政策空间。对研究方而言，需区分行业倡导与事实证据，避免将立场性表述当作市场信号；对品牌方而言，原料来源的可持续性与种植者利益正日益成为合规与声誉叙事的一部分，值得在供应链透明度层面持续观察，而非作短期应对。

news.title: ITGA论坛聚焦东方烟草市场与监管
news.summary: 国际烟草种植者协会（ITGA）论坛围绕东方烟草（Oriental tobacco）的市场前景与监管环境展开讨论。议题涉及该品类在香料型卷烟中的供需格局、主要产区的种植经济性，以及欧盟等市场在成分监管、添加剂规则上的政策走向对上游种植端的影响。论坛同时关注监管趋严背景下种植者的合规成本与议价能力。
news.body: Special EditionAdvertiseCalendarIndustry GuideAboutOur MissionOur ReputationContactPrivacy PolicySearch ITGA Forum Examines Oriental Tobacco Markets and Regulation The International Tobacco Growers’ Association (ITGA) and North Macedonia’s Union of Tobacco Producers held the Oriental Tobacco Forum on Oct. 27 in Prilep, North Macedonia, bringing together growers, researchers, and industry representatives to discuss global leaf markets, production trends, and regulation. North Macedonia has approximately 15,000 tobacco growers who produce 25 million kilograms annually and exports more than $200 million worth of tobacco each year. ITGA estimates global tobacco production will decline about 5% in 2026 following a strong 2025 crop, with a further decrease projected for 2027. Global Oriental tobacco production is estimated at 138 million kilograms in 2026. Forecasts presented at the forum put North Macedonia’s 2026 crop at 30.8 million kilograms, up 17.5% from 2025, and Bulgarian Oriental production at 4.9 million kilograms, up 43.2%. Greek tobacco production fell to 10.52 million kilograms in 2025 from 12.27 million in 2024, while Turkish tobacco purchases reached approximately 68 million kilograms by the end of August 2026, compared with 48 million kilograms a year earlier. The forum also covered proposed revisions to EU tobacco product and advertising directives, tobacco excise taxation, and developments under the World Health Organization’s Framework Convention on Tobacco Control. ITGA representatives discussed regulatory effects on growers and rural economies ahead of the treaty’s 12th Conference of the Parties, scheduled for 2027 in Yerevan, Armenia.
news.impact: 东方烟草体量小但风味不可替代，其议题折射出监管向下游传导至原料端的结构性趋势：配方合规正重塑原料选择与产区竞争力，种植端议价权被进一步压缩。需注意，论坛信息多来自产业方立场，公开数据有限，供需与监管影响的量化结论应谨慎采信。长期看，感官差异化原料的稀缺性与合规成本将共同决定该品类走向，值得品牌与原料研究方持续追踪。

insights.title: 2026 Us Truck Study
insights.summary: 贝恩发布2026年美国卡车研究，聚焦美国公路货运市场的战略与方法议题，覆盖运力供需、承运商与货主格局及周期波动。对快消等依赖公路运输的行业而言，其关乎物流成本、交付可靠性与渠道履约效率，属于典型的B2B市场结构研究，不涉及终端消费者的感官或偏好层面。
insights.body: Bookmark content that interests you and it will be saved here for you to read or share later. Bookmark content that interests you and it will be saved here for you to read or share later. A surge in market demand arrives as autonomy takes center stage and Tesla scales its capacity. By Bob Brinckman, Joshua Hinkel, and Ryan Morrissey A surge in market demand arrives as autonomy takes center stage and Tesla scales its capacity. By Bob Brinckman, Joshua Hinkel, and Ryan Morrissey en At a Glance Demand for commercial trucks is strong, with nearly 80% of US operators planning to make major fleet investments over the next six to 12 months. Total cost of ownership (TCO) has increased in importance as a key purchase criterion, driven by elevated diesel prices and continued tariff pressures. For most fleet operators, electric vehicles (EVs) have reached TCO parity with conventional diesel trucks. Tesla enters the market, with a new and large semi factory. Of US fleet operators, 67% would be open to buying a Tesla if appropriate enablers, such as charging infrastructure, were in place.  Autonomy is primed for rapid expansion; 73% of operators are evaluating how to use autonomy. Many of those customers are also interested in EVs. Sales and service remain fundamental to holding or taking share in this bull market. Customers say faster lead times and more transparent pricing would win their business. Demand for commercial trucks has surged US fleet operators are buying: 79% expect their fleet to grow over the next 12 months, and more than one-third project a fleet increase of 10% or more (see Figure 1). Elevated fuel prices, freight demand recovery, and aging fleets are the primary demand drivers.  The lesson from the last upcycle is that availability wins. Whichever OEMs can quote and deliver on credible lead times will take market share from competitors. To win those deals, leading OEMs must ensure post-pandemic supply chain resilience programs are fully operational
insights.core: 核心论点应在于：美国卡车运输正经历运力与需求的再平衡，承运商的定价能力与货主的议价空间随周期逆转，战略选择与运营方法比短期运价更重要。其价值在于提示物流成本与服务水平是快消生意增长的外部约束变量，而非可忽略的后台细节。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：运力周期的拐点能否被提前识别，并将其纳入成本与履约的假设体系；快消企业应建立对物流市场结构性变化的持续监测视角，而非把运价当作短期噪音。
insights.viewCMI: 从CMI视角看，卡车运价与运力松紧是快消品成本结构与渠道履约的外部前置变量，会经由到岸成本、货架可得性与促销节奏传导至消费者体验。该研究折射的结构性趋势是：物流周期正从单纯的成本项演变为供应链韧性与服务差异化的竞争维度。长期启发在于，判断品牌增长时应把运输市场的供需周期纳入外部环境扫描，而非仅盯终端份额与价格。

insights.title: Product Launch Insights: Make Better Decisions Earlier | Kantar LaunchSignals powered by Quilt.AI
insights.summary: 凯度推出 LaunchSignals（由 Quilt.AI 提供支持），定位为帮助品牌在更早阶段做出更优产品上市决策的工具。其核心主张是把上市判断前移，借助数据与信号在概念或早期阶段提升决策质量，折射出快消行业新品失败率高、上市决策窗口前移的普遍压力，以及研究工具向更早、更快、更数据化演进的结构性趋势。

See all Suggested searches BrandZ Marketplace Future Proof Get More Perspectives Your launch is talking, are you listening? 09 November 2026 Share Dr Nicki Morley Global Innovation Lead, Kantar Here's an uncomfortable truth about product launches.  We spend months, sometimes years, getting an innovation ready: we screen the ideas, optimise the concept, test the pack, debate the price and fight for the listings. Then, it finally meets real people in the real world, and we wait for the tracker wave, the sales data and the quarterly review. All valuable but usually too late to pivot.   Pace is not the only issue. I was recently talking to a senior innovation leader at a large drinks company. They had concerns about some of the data. By the time the numbers arrive, investment has become commitment: media budgets have been spent, launch plans are in motion, and changing course comes at a far greater cost.  We call it post-launch evaluation. Too often, it's too late to make an impact. I've spent much of my career helping brands make better innovation bets, and I've come to believe the launch window is the most overlooked moment in the whole innovation journey. The commercial stakes are significant, and it's where we've historically had the least information about a product. That's changing, and I think it changes the job of everyone responsible for growth.&
insights.core: 中心论点是上市成败应在更早阶段被预判，而非等到上市后复盘。凯度以数据/AI 信号支撑早期决策，价值在于把试错成本前置压缩；其重要性在于新品是快消增长主引擎却失败率高，早期信号能力正成为研究供应商的竞争焦点。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：早期信号究竟预测的是注意力还是复购？哪些品类因感官体验难以被数字化代理而更需保留真人测评？应建立「早期信号—上市表现」的长期回溯校验机制，而非一次性采用工具。
insights.viewCMI: 从 CMI 视角看，这是研究供给侧的一次卡位：把上市决策从「事后验证」推向「事前预判」，反映品牌在增长焦虑下对更快、更便宜决策依据的需求。值得警惕的是，早期信号若只依赖数字行为与代理指标，可能高估声量、低估真实购买情境。长期启发是：新品决策的核心不是更早拿到结论，而是建立能区分「早期热度」与「可持续复购」的监测框架，并明确哪些假设必须留给市场检验。

insights.title: 连续九年“全勤”进博会，澳优把全家营养的版图又铺大了一点
insights.summary: 作者：小食代 近日，第九届进博会在上海开幕。连续九年赴约的澳优，今年依旧没有缺席。 这家乳企以“全球营养 呵护 […] 连续九年“全勤”进博会，澳优把全家营养的版图又铺大了一点最先出现在小食代。
insights.body: 近日，第九届进博会在上海开幕。连续九年赴约的澳优，今年依旧没有缺席。 这家乳企以“全球营养 呵护成长”为主题，携旗下佳贝艾特、海普诺凯、Nutrition Care（下称：NC）、Oz Farm、Amalthea、CBM六大品牌共62款产品亮相进博会。展会第二天，五款新品集中首发，还官宣了和南昌大学食物过敏创新团队联合共建研发中心。 对澳优来说，进博会早已超出一场展销的范畴，它更像一面窗口，映出这家乳企全球化的真实成色。 近几年，国内婴配粉市场转入存量竞争，如何在婴幼儿之外找到新的增长人群，成了摆在不少乳企面前的同一道题。澳优给出的解法，是“全家营养”。 先看这次集中亮相的新品。澳优一次性发布五款新品。其中三款来自核心羊奶粉品牌佳贝艾特，分别是铂御婴幼儿配方羊奶粉、高才升成长配方羊奶粉、营嘉高钙富硒羊奶粉。 另外两款由旗下澳洲营养品牌NC推出，为NC金标养胃粉、养胃片。 从产品排布来看，这次发布直接覆盖了婴幼儿、学生及成年消费群体。品类上同时包含配方羊奶粉与专业营养补充产品。 放在当下环境里看，这套动作符合行业和消费的发展趋势。这几年，国内新生儿出生规模逐步趋稳，传统的婴配粉市场已经全面进入存量阶段。头部乳企大多在原有奶粉主业之外，慢慢把产品边界往儿童、成人、中老年以及日常营养品方向延伸。不少头部品牌都在推进类似的全生命周期布局，核心逻辑是希望在守住婴配基本盘的前提下，通过细分人群覆盖和品类扩容，找到新的长期收入支撑点。 从这个角度来说，澳优本次五款新品的集中发布，可以看作其“全家营养”产品矩阵的进一步扩大，也是为了找到新的长期收入增长点支撑。 这次推出的学生粉、成人粉和营养品，不是凭空新增的几条产品线。每一个品类拓展，都在原有供应链和研发积累的基础上往前推进。相当于把过去在婴配粉领域沉淀的经验，复用在了更宽的用户场景里。 在进博会现场，澳优与南昌大学食物过敏创新团队同步官宣联合成立“国际过敏营养与安全防控研发中心”。据了解，这支团队是国内食物过敏领域唯一[1]入选科技部创新人才推进计划的“重点领域创新团队”，先后承担23项国家自然科学基金、我国首个[2]“食物过敏”国家“863”计划以及科技部国际合作项目，研究成果填补了我国乳糜泻流行病学数据的空白。 根据规划，该研发中心将围绕乳蛋白致敏因子鉴定、过敏快速检测、低敏原料开发以及过敏营养干预等方向持续攻关，同步推进标准研制、临床研究与成果转化。对澳优而言，这批科研力量的注入，将进一步赋能其在低敏营养赛道的布局。 同样瞄准消费者真实喂养痛点的，还有旗下荷兰高端进口奶粉品牌海普诺凯。它将进博会展台直播间变成链接万千家庭的沟通枢纽，联合生活方式平台小红书发布《实心肉宝喂养答案书》。内容聚焦母婴群体高度关注的“长肉与体质”问题，围绕营养补充、消化吸收、骨骼体格发育以及科学转奶四个维度给出系统解答，依托海普诺凯荷致的“百年精研全面配方”与荷兰专利（专利号：NL2019906）的A2β-酪蛋白加OPO组合，传递“长实肉不长虚肉、长体质不长虚胖”的务实喂养观念。 在澳优眼中，进博会是一扇高水平对外开放的窗口。全球营养科技创新的成果在此交汇，产业伙伴也在这里寻找协同共生的机会，企业则能借这个平台对接全球产业链、首发创新成果，并持续感知全球家庭营养需求的变迁。 对企业来说，能在这里首发新品、对接全球产业链，本身就意味着一种贴近市场的响应能力。进博会的溢出效应，也在这种反复对接中被不断放大。 连续九届的在场，也有赖于澳优那张看得见的全球网络。如今澳优在全球共建设有11座工厂，搭起以澳优全球研发中心、欧洲研发中心、澳洲研发中心等为核心的"1+6+N"全球研发体系，形成覆盖婴配奶粉、保健食品、特医食品、个性化营养品及服务的生命全阶段营养呵护体系，产品销往近60个国家和地区。2025年，旗下佳贝艾特海外销售额对比2018年首届进博会时增长了273%，全球化业务生态稳步成型。 一张覆盖近60个国家和地区的销售网络，背后是供应链、研发与本地化运营的长期投入。对乳业这样投入重、周期长的行业来说，这样的积累很难在短期内完成。 澳优表示，九年来持续参展，澳优既是中国高水平开放的见证者，也是实实在在的受益者。进博会打通了“展品变商品”的完整链路，助力企业订单量不断提升。在他眼中，更重要的价值在于，进博会为全球不同市场主体搭建了高效对接的平台，让各方在充满不确定性的环境里依然能够保持链接、推动合作。 九个年头，放在一家企业的生命周期里并不算长，放在中国乳业的全球化进程里却有分量。从首届进博会时的摸索，到今年把新品、科研与合作一并摆上台面，澳优的进博之路，验证出一条有别于单纯贸易出海的路径：汇聚全球优质营养的智慧与资源，再服务于全球市场。 站在被赋予“恒久”寓意的九年节点上，澳优表示，接下来会继续坚持奶粉、营养品双线并
insights.core: 澳优连续九年全勤进博会，以「全家营养」扩大产品版图，折射乳企从婴配粉单点向全生命周期营养延伸的路径；其意义不在单次展会曝光，而在于品类边界与人群覆盖的持续外扩，是存量竞争下寻找新增量的典型样本。
insights.action: 值得长期监测的是「全家营养」各人群段的真实渗透与复购结构，而非SKU数量；需验证品牌信任能否跨年龄段迁移，以及品类扩张是否伴随专业心智的稀释，建立以人群生命周期价值为核心的观察框架。
insights.viewCMI: 从CMI看，「全家营养」本质是人群资产的重构：婴配粉受出生率约束，企业转向儿童、成人、中老年分段覆盖，以延长用户生命周期价值。这折射结构性趋势——乳企竞争从单一品类份额转向家庭场景与人群宽度的争夺，渠道与品牌信任成为跨品类迁移的关键杠杆。长期需追问：家庭营养是真实需求分层，还是品类堆叠的叙事？跨人群延展能否复用原有品牌心智，而非稀释专业性。

insights.title: 对话瑞士莲中国区总经理马征：把中国当作“高强度健身房”，在离消费者最近的地方寻找增长之道
insights.summary: 作者：吴容（原创） “中国市场对品牌来说，就像一座高强度的健身房。训练越严格，越能催生出更强的体能，帮助品牌穿 […] 对话瑞士莲中国区总经理马征：把中国当作“高强度健身房”，在离消费者最近的地方寻找增长之道最先出现在小食代。
insights.body: “中国市场对品牌来说，就像一座高强度的健身房。训练越严格，越能催生出更强的体能，帮助品牌穿越周期。”谈到中国市场，瑞士莲中国区总经理马征用了这样一个比喻。 这种“高强度”正在变得更加具体。一边是消费需求快速变化。消费者对巧克力的关注点正在从品牌进一步走向品质、健康、配料和体验，消费场景也从传统节日礼赠延伸到分享和日常自享；另一边，消费渠道和消费者注意力进一步碎片化，对品牌的产品创新、营销效率和组织反应速度提出了更高要求。 瑞士莲中国也在调整自己的打法。过去三年，其围绕产品、营销、渠道、供应链和组织进行了系统升级。今年又进一步拓展零售店和企业礼赠业务，希望在传统商超之外建立新的增长曲线。 这些投入逐渐显现成效。马征透露，在连续两年双位数增长后，今年1至10月，瑞士莲中国业务继续保持高双位数增长，预计全年保持双位数增长，增速高于集团平均水平。更长期来看，到2030年，瑞士莲中国希望销售额和销售量对比2025年翻一番。 比增长数字更值得关注的是，在一个竞争越来越充分的市场，瑞士莲正在尝试建立一套更适合中国的经营方式。“业绩增长之外，我希望瑞士莲在中国成为这样一家企业：产品创新受欢迎，品牌建设树标杆，渠道合作有口碑，社会责任有担当。同时，我希望中国市场成为集团全球的创新策源地，让更多中国灵感走上世界舞台。”马征说。 “听劝”听起来是一句轻松的表达，但在马征看来，它背后实际上是一套非常严肃的经营逻辑：让消费者的声音真正进入企业的决策系统。 今年7月，瑞士莲中国首家零售店在上海开业。3.9米高的软心彩虹墙、首次引入中国的近30种口味的 Pick & Mix 缤纷甄选巧克力专区，让消费者可以按照自己的喜好进行选择和组合。马征透露，“开业约4个月后，门店多项经营指标已达到或接近瑞士莲成熟市场主流门店水平。” 马征回忆起，门店开业后，消费者的一项反馈很快引起了她和团队的注意。当时不断有消费者主动询问店里有没有提供咖啡，团队没有把这句话当成一句普通建议，而是迅速思考：咖啡和瑞士莲的巧克力专长，能不能发生新的化学反应？于是瑞士莲在门店推出了云顶黑巧美式、阿芙佳朵等产品，它们也迅速成为门店受欢迎的产品。此外，消费者对于黑巧、坚果、水果类产品的偏好，也进一步帮助团队理解中国消费者对于“美味与健康平衡”的需求。 马征表示，“我们是一个听劝的品牌。” 所谓“听劝”，并不是消费者提出什么，品牌就简单照做。在她看来，更重要的是从消费者的反馈中识别真实需求，再将这种需求与品牌自身的专业能力结合起来，这也是瑞士莲对“本土化”的理解，不是简单给全球产品加上中国元素，而是让中国消费者的声音进入产品、营销、渠道乃至经营决策。 目前，瑞士莲正在中国建立并完善消费者倾听项目，希望获取更多第一手反馈；与此同时，中国文化和社交媒体上的本地内容，也越来越多地成为产品和营销创新的来源。 此次进博会上的首次亮相的高达6米多达18种口味的软心巧克力彩虹墙，以及首次进驻进博会的鲜制醇巧工坊、苏绣主题非遗限定礼盒以及升级版大师课，实际上都是这种思路的不同体现。 零售店因此承担了销售之外的另一项功能，即成为品牌直接观察中国消费者的“前哨站”。在马征看来，巧克力消费季节性明显，一家门店至少需要经历约8至10个月，完整覆盖淡旺季，才能真正判断其经营模式。因此，对于后续开店，瑞士莲的态度是“稳中求快”。“数量不是最重要的，先把适合中国市场的模型跑出来。”她说。 今年瑞士莲中国还迈出了重要一步：正式进入企业礼赠市场。此次进博会上，瑞士莲首次设置To B企业定制专区。马征将2026年定义为瑞士莲中国的“B端元年”。在此之前，瑞士莲中国的业务主要面向C端消费者。 马征表示，中国礼赠市场的需求和趋势相对稳定，高品质巧克力正成为企业客户的选择之一，应用场景包括员工福利等。凯度发布的《2026中国礼品行业展望白皮书》也显示，食品饮料已是企业礼品采购的重要品类，在企业总福利预算中的采购占比普遍达到30%至50%。 她进一步指出，目前，公司希望形成更加清晰的三层业务结构：商超继续承担核心业务，零售店成为第二条增长曲线，而To B礼赠业务则被视为潜在的第三条增长曲线。 但进入一个新渠道，并不意味着简单把原来的产品搬过去。“B端与C端业务的考量不同，我们要深入一线，多看，多听，多聊，找到合适伙伴、把握业务需求。”她说。 过去三个月，马征与三四十位长期从事B端业务的合作伙伴进行了交流。她发现，企业客户考虑的问题远比“买什么产品”复杂，包括客单价、差异化、交付效率、采购成本、供需波动以及服务能力。 这意味着，瑞士莲需要重新建立一套适应B端的能力。一是渠道能力，真正理解不同客户的采购逻辑和交付标准；二是产品能力，围绕不同场景开发适合企业客户的产品、包装和价格带；三是服务能力，进一步提高研发、供应链和业务团队的响应速度。
