temperatures and cost millions of dollars in food waste, Reut
insights.core: 欧洲零售商正面临日益严峻的网络攻击威胁，文中提出的即时解决方案虽能短期止血，却无法根治问题。这揭示出零售业数字化转型中安全投入与业务连续性的结构性矛盾：攻击成本低于防御成本，单点修补难敌系统性风险，长期韧性建设才是关键。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：零售业的安全投入是否被当作可量化的信任资产而非合规成本？应建立「安全事件—消费者信任—客流与客单」的长期关联监测视角，并重新验证「即时修补可替代系统韧性」这一假设是否成立。
insights.viewCMI: 从CMI视角看，网络攻击已从IT议题升级为影响消费者信任与生意连续性的市场议题。门店停摆、支付中断、会员数据泄露直接冲击购物体验与品牌资产，而欧洲零售高度集中的格局放大了单点故障的行业外溢效应。这折射出数字化越深、信任越脆弱的悖论：消费者对便利的期待与对安全的敏感同步上升，安全能力正从后台成本转为前台竞争力。长期需监测消费者对数据安全的支付意愿与品牌容错阈值。

insights.core: 区域杂货商在成本与竞争压力下仍录得稳健季度，说明贴近本地需求的商品与定价组合具备抗压性；关键不在增速高低，而在其能否在大型连锁与折扣渠道夹击中维持客流与 basket，这决定区域零售的长期生存空间。
insights.action: 值得长期监测的是区域零售的客流与 basket 结构是否在通胀回落期仍能维持，以及本地化选品能否转化为可复用的商品差异；需反复验证「社区黏性等于长期忠诚」这一假设。
insights.viewCMI: 区域零售的稳健更多来自本地化选品与价格感知的匹配，而非规模效应。这折射出渠道分化下「就近+熟悉」的消费价值仍在，但需警惕其可持续性依赖通胀期价格传导而非真实客流增长。长期应追问：区域商的护城河是社区关系还是商品差异，两者在通缩期会否同时弱化。

insights.core: 中心论点是零售竞争正从货架效率转向体验与情绪价值：神秘包用盲盒式不确定性和独家性，把普通托特包变成引流与复购触点。关键在低成本高感知差异，而非产品功能本身。
insights.action: 值得长期监测的是：消费者把「不确定性」视为乐趣还是负担的阈值在哪里；独家周边对到店频次与客单的拉动是否可持续；以及当同类盲盒式机制被普遍模仿后，品牌差异化还剩什么。

insights.core: 亚马逊以25美元提供8磅火鸡及全套配菜，将节日整餐打包为一口价，本质是用价格确定性切入生鲜杂货的节庆场景。其重要性不在折扣力度，而在电商平台以套餐化、全包式供给争夺传统由实体商超把持的节日餐桌，反映渠道边界正被重新划分。
insights.action: 值得长期监测的是：节日整餐的「全包」承诺能否稳定兑现，以及消费者对套餐内火鸡与配菜的品质感知是否被价格叙事掩盖。应建立对节庆场景中「便利—品质—价格」三者权重的持续追踪视角，而非只看单次成交。
insights.viewCMI: 这是渠道与定价层面的信号：节日整餐被打包成标准化SKU，价格成为唯一显性卖点，说明平台正用确定性对抗实体零售的体验优势。折射的结构性趋势是「节庆消费套餐化」与电商向生鲜核心场景渗透，传统商超的节日客流护城河被侵蚀。长期看，值得追问的是：当价格透明化后，零售商靠什么维持节日溢价——供应链效率还是自有品牌，而非一次性促销。

insights.title: Wayfair notches ‘strongest quarter of growth’ since the pandemic
insights.summary: Wayfair公布疫情以来最强增长季度，反映家居耐用品需求在长期低迷后出现回暖信号。作为线上家居零售平台，其业绩改善既与住房市场、利率环境相关，也折射出消费者对大件商品支出意愿的边际修复，对家居零售与电商竞争格局具有风向标意义。
insights.body: Let Retail Dive's free newsletter keep you informed, straight from your inbox. The retailer posted nearly 10% revenue gains and 4.7% growth in active customers in Q3, even as consumer spending habits change in the home category. Wayfair’s Q3 results beat both analysts’ and the company’s own expectations. “At the start of this year, we told you we expected to take share in the U.S. at a pace we had not seen in several years. With U.S. revenue growing double digits against a roughly flat category here in Q3, we've done exactly that,” Shah said in a statement Wednesday. Revenue growth was driven by a 4.7% increase in active customers, reaching 22.2 million, and a 12.2% increase in orders delivered, though average order value decreased slightly in the period. Notably, Wayfair was able to grow its customer base without significantly increasing its advertising spend, according to GlobalData Managing Director Neil Saunders. Ad spend was up 2.4% year over year. As a percentage of total revenue, ad spend was 9.9% compared to 10.6% last year. Wayfair’s growing network of stores will continue to help the retailer offset the high costs of acquiring customers online, Saunders noted. The company itself has previously touted the benefits of its physical stores in acquiring new customers, stating that at its Chicago-area location, over half of shoppers are new to the Wayfair brand. Wayfair in August announced plans to open its 10th store for that brand, set to open in Altamonte Springs, Florida, in 2028. It will join existing and upcoming locations in areas including Atlanta; Denver; and Columbus, Ohio. Wayfair also appears to be benefiting from its assortment across multiple home categories. While consumers are delaying or forgoing larger, more expensive remodels, they’re still engaging in smaller projects. “This is particularly helpful for Wayfair as its very broad offer and authority across many categories suits more fragmented and occasional buying patterns,” Saunders said. Get
insights.core: 核心论点是Wayfair录得疫情以来最强增长季度，说明家居线上零售正走出需求低谷。关键在于这一反弹是宏观周期与渠道结构共同作用的结果，而非单纯促销拉动；其重要性在于为大件耐用品消费是否真正复苏提供了观察样本。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：家居需求的反弹究竟由房市周期、置换延迟还是渠道迁移驱动？应建立对耐用品置换周期、线上渗透率天花板与消费者价格敏感度的长期监测视角，而非用单季增长推断复苏确立。
insights.viewCMI: 从CMI看，这一信号的价值不在于单季增速，而在于家居这类高客单、低频耐用品需求是否出现结构性拐点。疫情透支、高利率与房市冻结曾长期压制需求，如今回暖更可能是被延迟的置换需求释放，而非消费信心全面修复。长期需追问：线上家居渗透率是否已进入平台期，消费者是否从「买新」转向「换旧与修补」，以及价格带与履约体验如何重塑渠道忠诚。单季数据不足以证明趋势，需持续监测置换周期与房市联动。

insights.title: Outdoor Voices inks licensing deal for UK and EU
insights.summary: Outdoor Voices 通过授权许可（licensing）方式进入英国与欧盟市场，而非自建渠道或直营扩张。这反映小众运动生活方式品牌在增长承压后，转向轻资产、伙伴驱动的国际化路径，以品牌资产换取区域运营能力与渠道覆盖，降低跨境扩张的资本与执行风险。
insights.body: Let Retail Dive's free newsletter keep you informed, straight from your inbox. The activewear lifestyle brand is partnering with Focus Brands to expand into new markets, with an initial focus on wholesale and e-commerce. Outdoor Voices’ partnership with Focus Brands is intended to “introduce the brand to new consumers while maintaining the distinctive identity that has made Outdoor Voices a recognized name in American activewear.” Focus Brands has previously worked with sportswear and lifestyle brands including Nautica, Ellesse, K-Swiss, Patrick and Reebok, per the release. Earlier this year, Outdoor Voices inked a deal with Sam’s Club to offer a limited-edition collection of women’s, men’s and kids’ apparel and accessories. The company is currently under the leadership of founder Tyler Haney, who left in 2020 amid rumored clashes with then-board chair Mickey Drexler and returned for the 2025 relaunch. “Outdoor Voices was built on a simple idea: that movement should be fun, accessible and something that brings people together,” Haney said in Tuesday’s release. “It’s exciting to see that original spirit continue to find new audiences around the world. The opportunity to bring Outdoor Voices to communities across the UK and Europe is a natural extension of what we set out to create — a brand that inspires people everywhere to get out and Do Things.” Consortium, which also owns California Pizza Kitchen, Jonathan Adler and Draper James, bought Outdoor Voices a few months after the brand was forced to close all its stores and move to an online-only model. Since then, Consortium has worked with Outdoor Voices to build strategic wholesale relationships, expand its e-commerce capabilities and grow its international partner network, per Tuesday’s release. “Outdoor Voices has an incredibly compelling brand identity and a philosophy that resonates well beyond its home market,” Michael DeVirgilio, Consortium founding partner, said in Tuesday’s release. “Our strategy has been to
insights.core: 核心论点是：品牌国际化的杠杆从「自营扩张」转向「授权变现」。关键证据是交易结构本身——以许可而非直营进入 UK/EU。其重要性在于，它把品牌从运营重负中剥离，但也意味着对终端体验与定价的控制力被让渡，品牌资产成为主要赌注。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：授权模式下品牌体验的一致性由谁守护？应建立跨区域品牌健康与价格形象的持续监测视角，验证「轻资产扩张是否以品牌溢价为代价」这一假设，而非只看短期覆盖增量。
insights.viewCMI: 从 CMI 看，这是小众运动休闲品牌在核心市场增速放缓后的典型选择：以许可换取区域渠道与本地运营能力，用较低资本撬动增量生意。结构性趋势是品牌资产与运营能力解耦，授权成为中型品牌跨境的默认路径。长期启发在于，品牌需重新界定「可控增长」的边界——授权能放大覆盖，却稀释定价权与消费者体验一致性；真正要监测的是区域品牌认知与复购，而非签约数量。

insights.title: ‘This will normalize’: What Adidas’ Q3 reveals about the broader footwear market
insights.summary: Retail Dive 以 Adidas 第三季度业绩为切口，讨论其表现对整个鞋类市场的指示意义。文章将单一品牌季度数据置于更广的行业背景下解读，暗示鞋类需求、竞争格局或渠道结构正在出现值得关注的变化，其影响超出 Adidas 自身，对同业与零售渠道的判断具有参照价值。
insights.body: Let Retail Dive's free newsletter keep you informed, straight from your inbox. CEO Bjørn Gulden acknowledged difficulties in the lifestyle footwear market but said growth won’t happen until “the market is clean.” Last week, Adidas put out Q3 results in line with its preliminary expectations for record sales and profits. Revenue was up 9% year over year with even stronger trends in DTC, which grew 17% year over year. CEO Bjørn Gulden said on a call with analysts that net sales have grown every quarter since Q1 of 2024, and the retailer has also notched an operating profit each quarter during that timeframe. The biggest challenge the brand is facing right now is the state of the market itself. “The lifestyle footwear market is currently difficult and yes, you see a lot of discounts,” Gulden said. “Of course it is difficult then to plan growth in the lifestyle footwear market currently. But that’s why it’s so important then to grow in the performance footwear market — and that’s what we’re doing.” Adidas’ performance category was up 14% on a currency neutral basis in Q3, while lifestyle rose a more modest 3%. The results mirror a trend Nike called out in its own Q3 earnings a month ago, when the activewear giant acknowledged it had oversupplied the Jordan brand and would need to pull back on launches going forward. That specter will haunt Adidas’ results for the next few quarters, according to Gulden, who predicted the lifestyle market might improve in the back half of next year but stressed that it’s highly dependent on the actions of Adidas’ competitors. “The market can only grow in footwear lifestyle when the market is clean,” Gulden said. For now, performance is more in demand. Data from Circana also marks this as an industrywide trend. Although lifestyle sneakers accounted for the largest share of footwear sales in Q3, performance footwear was “the industry’s primary growth engine,” according to a Monday report. Running in particular is driving growth in performan
insights.core: 核心论点是把 Adidas 的季度表现当作鞋类市场的先行信号，而非孤立财报事件。其重要性在于：单一头部品牌的拐点往往预示品类层面的需求或竞争再分配，但摘要未给出具体数据，结论强度需待完整证据检验。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：品牌季度波动中，多少来自真实消费需求变化，多少来自渠道补库存与促销节奏？应建立以品类为单位的需求与份额监测框架，持续验证「单品牌信号能否外推为品类趋势」这一假设。
insights.viewCMI: 从 CMI 视角看，头部运动品牌季度表现被解读为品类信号，反映的是鞋类消费的需求弹性、品牌份额再分配与渠道库存节奏，而非单家企业经营问题。值得追问的结构性趋势是：运动鞋消费是否正从品牌驱动转向场景与性价比驱动，头部集中度是否松动。长期启发在于建立跨品牌、跨渠道的品类监测视角，把单季财报噪声与真实需求拐点区分开，避免以一家表现推断全行业。

insights.title: UK records two raw milk outbreaks
insights.summary: 英国报告两起与生乳（未经巴氏杀菌牛奶）相关的疫情，属食品安全监管与公共卫生事件。对快消品行业而言，它指向生乳及生乳奶酪等小众品类的合规与风险边界，也牵动消费者对'天然/未加工'标签的信任。事件本身不涉及感官测评方法，主要影响在监管、渠道准入与消费认知层面。

insights.core: 核心结论是生乳类产品的微生物风险并未随其'天然、少加工'的消费叙事而消退，监管与溯源能力仍是该类品类的生死线。关键意义在于：小众高溢价品类一旦出现安全事件，信任修复成本远高于其市场规模，风险治理应先于品类扩张。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：消费者对'天然/少加工'的偏好，在安全事件冲击下的耐受阈值与修复周期如何变化？应建立对生乳类小众品类'信任—风险'联动的长期监测视角，并重新验证'少加工即更优'这一消费假设的稳固程度。
insights.viewCMI: 从CMI看，生乳及生乳奶酪属于典型的'少加工=更健康'叙事驱动型小众品类，其溢价建立在消费者对天然与工艺的信任上，而非可验证的功能利益。两起疫情暴露该类品类的结构性脆弱：市场教育越强调'原始纯粹'，安全事件对品牌与渠道信任的冲击越被放大。长期启发是，小众高端品类的增长逻辑必须把合规与可追溯纳入品牌资产，而非仅作为成本项；同时应持续监测消费者对'天然'标签的风险感知如何随事件波动。

insights.title: Congresswoman has concerns about sale of infant formula company
insights.summary: 美国国会议员对婴儿配方奶粉公司出售表达关切，涉及外资收购与食品安全监管交叉议题。事件折射婴幼儿营养品赛道的高敏感属性：供给集中、监管门槛高、公众信任脆弱。对行业而言，交易审查已不只关乎资本与份额，更牵动供应链安全与品牌信任，可能影响未来该品类的并购路径与市场准入判断。

insights.core: 核心论点是婴幼儿配方奶粉的产权交易已被纳入食品安全与公共信任框架审视，而非单纯商业行为。关键支撑是立法者对出售的公开关切本身，说明监管与政治因素正成为该品类交易的决定性变量；其重要性在于，它提示市场集中度高的刚需品类，资本动作会直接触发信任与合规风险。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：婴幼儿配方品类的品牌资产究竟由什么支撑，监管背书与产权归属在消费者信任中的权重如何变化；以及该品类并购审查趋严是否会重塑市场集中度与创新节奏。应建立对监管信号、供应链安全与品牌信任联动的长期监测视角。
insights.viewCMI: 从CMI看，婴幼儿配方奶粉是信任驱动、低容错的刚需品类，消费者决策高度依赖品牌安全感与监管背书，而非价格或口味差异。产权变动会被消费者解读为品质与供应稳定性的信号，进而影响品牌资产与渠道信心。结构性趋势是：食品领域的资本交易正被公众以「安全治理」而非「商业效率」的框架评估。长期启发在于，该品类的市场份额与增长逻辑必须把监管与信任风险内生化为核心变量，而非外部扰动。

insights.core: 斯洛文尼亚大肠杆菌病例上升、沙门氏菌下降，并发生一起涉及多种病原体、致777人患病的水源性疫情。核心结论是：食品安全风险结构正在从传统食源性病原体向水源性、多病原体复合暴露迁移，单一病原体监测框架可能低估系统性风险，这对公共卫生与食品供应链的预警逻辑具有结构性意义。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：当风险从单一食源性病原体转向水源性、多病原体复合暴露，现有的监测指标与消费者风险感知之间是否存在系统性错配？应建立跨病原体、跨传播途径的长期监测视角，而非依赖单病种趋势判断整体安全。
insights.viewCMI: 从CMI视角看，这则公共卫生信号的市场含义不在病例数字本身，而在于风险认知如何传导至消费行为与品牌信任。沙门氏菌下降易被误读为「食品安全整体改善」，而水源性多病原体暴发提示风险来源正在分散化，消费者对「天然/本地水源」的信任假设可能被重新定价。长期启发是：食品饮料企业需把水源与多病原体暴露纳入品牌风险管理，而非仅聚焦传统食源性指标；渠道与产地叙事将越来越需要可验证的安全背书。

insights.title: Kale chips recalled because of thallium contamination
insights.summary: Food Safety News 报道称，一款羽衣甘蓝脆片因铊污染被召回。事件属于食品安全合规与供应链风险范畴，涉及重金属污染这一低概率但高严重度的危害类型。对品类而言，它提示“健康光环”蔬菜零食同样可能暴露于原料产地与环境污染物风险，影响品牌信任与渠道处置，但摘要未给出涉事品牌、批次规模与污染来源等细节。

insights.core: 中心论点是：以“天然、健康”为卖点的蔬菜类零食并不天然免疫重金属污染，铊这类罕见高毒污染物一旦进入成品，会把召回成本与品牌信任风险同时放大。关键证据是官方召回这一事实本身；其重要性在于揭示健康定位品类的安全溢价假设需要被重新检验。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：消费者对“天然/植物基”的信任是否被系统性高估？应建立对健康定位品类安全事件的持续监测视角，观察召回是否改变品类信任与溢价容忍度，而非仅当作个案处置。
insights.viewCMI: 从CMI视角看，这折射出健康化零食赛道的一个结构性张力：消费者为“蔬菜=安全健康”的直觉买单，而该直觉与真实供应链风险并不同步。重金属污染虽属低频事件，却对信任的破坏呈非线性——健康定位品牌一旦卷入，溢价基础被动摇。长期启发是：品类的“清洁标签”叙事越强，越需要把安全可验证性纳入品牌资产，而非仅靠成分故事；同时应关注消费者对召回信息的反应差异，以及渠道端对高风险原料品类的筛选逻辑如何演化。

insights.title: Gene editing could replace a lifetime of medication, but there's a catch
insights.summary: 基因编辑疗法有望一次性替代终身用药，但文章提示存在关键限制（如安全性、递送、成本或伦理可及性）。这标志着慢病治疗从长期管理转向一次性干预的范式信号，对支付方、药企商业模式与患者可及性均构成结构性冲击。
insights.body: Imagine receiving a single treatment that could keep your cholesterol under control for decades, potentially eliminating the need for daily medication. Advances in gene editing are bringing that possibility closer to reality. But scientists say the same technology that could revolutionize medicine also raises difficult questions about safety, permanent genetic changes, and unintended consequences. Gene therapy is already being used to treat certain serious illnesses. These treatments can introduce working copies of genes, silence harmful genetic activity, or make changes directly to DNA. Unlike conventional medications that must be taken repeatedly, some genetic treatments are designed to work after just one administration. More than 6,000 rare genetic disorders have been identified, although only a small proportion currently have targets that can be treated. Gene therapies have already achieved important successes against conditions such as spinal muscular atrophy and sickle cell disease. Now, researchers are exploring whether similar approaches could help prevent or manage far more widespread health problems, including high cholesterol, heart disease, obesity, and diabetes. That raises a fundamental question: Just because scientists can permanently change a person's genetic activity, does that mean they should? In a perspective published in JAMA Internal Medicine, University of Michigan Health Frankel Cardiovascular Center cardiologists Eric D. Smith, M.D., and Venkatesh L. Murthy, M.D., Ph.D., outline how doctors and researchers should weigh the potential benefits of genomic therapies against their risks. The two gene therapy researchers explain why these treatments are so promising, what makes them different from conventional medicines, and what must happen before they can be safely offered to millions of people. Why One-Time Gene Therapy Is Different From Daily Medication One of the most appealing features of gene therapy is the possibility of achieving lasting
insights.core: 核心论点是基因编辑的「一次性治愈」逻辑虽诱人，但「catch」意味着疗效持久性、安全风险与成本可负担性尚未解决。其重要性在于：若一次性疗法成立，传统长期用药的现金流与依从性假设将被重估。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：一次性干预的「结果承诺」能否被真实世界证据持续验证？支付与可及性假设是否需要重新建模？应建立对「疗效持久性—成本—信任」三角的长期监测视角，而非追逐单次技术新闻。
insights.viewCMI: 从CMI视角看，这是一次「价值主张」的重构：消费者从为持续服药付费，转向为一次性结果付费，支付意愿、风险容忍与信任门槛随之改变。折射的结构性趋势是医疗消费从「过程管理」向「结果承诺」迁移，支付方与患者对高价一次性疗法的可及性、分期或保险机制将成为新竞争维度。长期启发是：评估任何品类时，都应追问其价值究竟绑定在持续使用还是终局结果上。

insights.title: AI helps Stanford scientists discover a “natural Ozempic” with a surprising advantage
insights.summary: 斯坦福团队借助AI筛选发现一种被称为“天然Ozempic”的候选物质，报道强调其一项出人意料的优势。该发现处于早期研究阶段，价值更多在于展示AI如何加速功能性成分的发现路径，而非已证实的市场产品。对快消与营养品行业而言，它提示减重与代谢健康赛道的原料创新节奏可能被技术压缩。
insights.body: Scientists at Stanford Medicine have identified a naturally occurring molecule that could lead to a new generation of weight loss medications. Early animal experiments suggest that it can suppress appetite and promote fat loss much like semaglutide, the active ingredient in Ozempic, while potentially avoiding some of the drug's troublesome side effects. The molecule, known as BRP, works differently from existing treatments. Rather than affecting several organs throughout the body, it appears to act more selectively on a part of the brain responsible for controlling hunger and metabolism. This more focused approach could eventually help people lose weight without experiencing problems such as nausea, constipation, or substantial muscle loss. Researchers discovered BRP with the help of artificial intelligence, which allowed them to search through thousands of possible biological compounds. The findings were promising enough that the scientists began preparing for the next major step: determining whether the molecule is safe and effective in humans. "The receptors targeted by semaglutide are found in the brain but also in the gut, pancreas and other tissues," said assistant professor of pathology Katrin Svensson, PhD. "That's why Ozempic has widespread effects including slowing the movement of food through the digestive tract and lowering blood sugar levels. In contrast, BRP appears to act specifically in the hypothalamus, which controls appetite and metabolism." A Different Approach to Weight Loss The hypothalamus is a small but essential region deep within the brain. Among its many responsibilities, it helps regulate hunger, energy use, body temperature, and other functions needed to maintain the body's internal balance. Because it plays such a central role in appetite, it is an important target for researchers developing obesity treatments. Semaglutide works by imitating a hormone called glucagon-like peptide 1, or GLP-1. This hormone helps regulate blood sugar and
insights.core: 核心论点是AI可作为发现工具，缩短从生物机制到候选成分的筛选周期，并找到兼具额外优势的天然替代方案。关键支撑是AI筛选方法本身，而非临床数据；其重要性在于原料发现范式可能从经验试错转向计算驱动，但证据强度仍属早期。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：AI发现的“天然”成分，其功效证据链与感官可接受性是否同步成熟？应建立对功能性原料从发现到消费者感知的全程监测视角，而非追逐单点新闻。
insights.viewCMI: 从CMI看，这条消息的价值不在单一成分，而在减重与代谢健康需求正被技术供给端加速回应。GLP-1类药物已重塑消费者对“体重管理”的认知，天然替代叙事会进一步模糊食品、补充剂与药品的边界，催生新的价格带与信任竞争。长期需警惕“天然即安全”的消费者心智被过度放大，以及监管与功效宣称之间的落差如何影响品类信誉。

insights.title: Kids who eat more ultra-processed foods show a troubling brain response
insights.summary: ScienceDaily报道，摄入较多超加工食品的儿童在脑部反应上呈现令人担忧的模式，提示饮食结构与神经功能存在关联。该议题同时牵动家长消费选择与产品配方设计，对食品行业的健康化叙事和感官设计提出新拷问。
insights.body: Children who consume more ultra-processed foods (UPFs) may have stronger brain responses to tempting foods, potentially helping explain why these products are associated with weight gain. A new study published in JAMA Network Open found that children who ate more of these foods showed heightened activity in the brain's reward system when looking at pictures of appetizing foods. Those stronger responses were also associated with increases in body fat over the following year. Ultra-processed foods include many everyday products, such as breakfast cereals, packaged bread, and instant soups. They are manufactured to be appealing, convenient, and able to remain fresh for extended periods. Many contain artificial sweeteners, coloring agents, and other ingredients rarely used in home cooking. These products make up a substantial portion of children's diets, accounting for approximately 67% of the calories consumed by children in the United States. Previous research has associated ultra-processed food consumption with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular disease. However, scientists are still trying to understand the biological processes that might explain these connections. The new investigation, supported in part by the National Institutes of Health, combined magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), dietary assessments, and measurements of children's body composition to explore whether the brain's response to food could play a role. "Children's brains are still developing, habits are still forming and food preferences are still being made. It's an important period where the brain is very sensitive to food and the food environment," said the study's senior author, Kathleen A. Page, MD, professor of medicine and pediatrics and co-chief of the Division of Endocrinology and Diabetes at the Keck School of Medicine of USC. "We're particularly interested in understanding these processes in children, because we believe that intervening early could make a real difference." Brain
insights.core: 核心论点是超加工食品的高摄入与儿童大脑反应异常相关，关键证据来自脑反应测量而非单纯行为观察，其重要性在于把「吃什么」从营养议题推进到神经与感知层面，为配方与沟通策略带来不确定性。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：超加工与脑反应的关联是因果还是混杂？感官适口性设计与饱腹、奖赏机制之间应建立何种长期监测视角？家长认知中「科学证据」与「焦虑叙事」的权重如何演变，需持续验证而非一次性结论。
insights.viewCMI: 从CMI看，这条信息强化了家长对超加工食品的信任赤字，健康焦虑正从成分表转向「对孩子大脑的影响」这类更难验证的叙事。市场含义在于，主打儿童场景的品牌若继续以口感与便利为卖点，可能面临价值主张的边际递减；结构性趋势是「清洁标签」向「神经友好」延伸，但证据尚弱，品牌若过度承诺反噬风险高。长期应追问：家长的真实决策依据是科学证据还是焦虑传导。
insights.viewSensory: 从感官研究看，脑反应异常提示超加工食品的高适口性设计可能绕过了正常饱腹与奖赏调节，指向感官属性与感知机制之间的错配。这动摇「越好吃越好卖」的默认假设，也暴露现有偏爱性测评只看即时喜好、忽视摄入后神经与代谢反馈的方法局限。长期启发是感官评价需引入更接近真实进食情境的动态与生理测量，重新界定「好口感」的边界。

insights.title: Scientists may have finally explained why our brains and bodies are cross-wired
insights.summary: ScienceDaily 报道，科学家提出新解释：大脑与身体的神经通路存在交叉连接，可能说明感知、情绪与生理反应之间的耦合机制比既往认知更紧密。该发现属于基础神经科学进展，对理解感官输入如何被加工、以及身体状态如何反向影响感知具有潜在意义，但距离消费市场应用尚远。
insights.body: Why does the left side of the brain control the right side of the body, while the right side controls the left? This unusual arrangement is one of the most intriguing features of the nervous system, and scientists have proposed a new explanation that reaches back hundreds of millions of years. Dr. Martin Wessendorf, a neuroscientist and associate professor emeritus at the University of Minnesota, studies how the brainstem regulates neurons in the spinal cord. Daniel Wang specializes in cognitive neuroscience and neurodegenerative diseases. Together, they have examined the evolutionary origins of the brain's crossed connections. In a study published in Frontiers in Neuroanatomy, the researchers explore several neural circuits in four-limbed animals that are cross-wired (meaning one side of the brain connects with the opposite side of the body). Their hypothesis suggests that these connections may have developed because evolution built new brain circuits around an ancient visual system. The brain contains numerous pathways that cross from one side of the central nervous system to the other. Understanding why these contralateral (midline-crossing) connections exist requires examining how different sensory and movement circuits developed over evolutionary time. How the Brain Processes Visual Information One possible explanation begins with the eyes. When light passes through the eye's lens, the image projected onto the retina is reversed. Objects appearing to our right are projected onto the left side of the retina, while objects on our left are projected onto the right. Visual information travels along the optic nerve to a structure called the optic chiasm. Here, nerve fibers are organized so that information from the right visual field reaches the left side of the brain, while information from the left visual field is directed to the right side. Some of these signals reach an ancient brain structure called the optic tectum (which in mammals is called the superior coll
insights.core: 核心论点是大脑与身体并非单向指挥关系，而是存在交叉 wiring，感官与生理信号相互调制。关键价值在于为「感知是具身的」提供神经机制层面的证据，提示感官研究不能只盯产品属性，还需纳入身体状态变量。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：现有感官测评是否默认评价者处于「中立生理状态」，这一假设是否需要重新验证？应建立将内感受与生理状态纳入变量的长期感官监测视角，而非继续把感官反应视为产品固有属性。
insights.viewSensory: 该文对感官研究的启发在于感知机制的底层假设：若大脑与身体交叉连接，则风味、质地、香气等感官评价就不是纯认知判断，而受生理状态、情绪与内感受调制。这提示描述性测评与偏爱性测试需关注评价者的身体状态与个体差异，而非把感官反应当作稳定属性。长期看，感官设计应从「产品刺激—感知」线性模型转向「刺激—身体—感知」耦合模型，重新审视跨人群感官阈值与情绪介导的偏好波动。

insights.title: DOJ subpoenas Smurfit Westrock over containerboard pricing
insights.summary: 美国司法部就箱板纸定价向Smurfit Westrock发出传票，指向包装用纸市场的价格协同疑虑。事件处于调查阶段而非定论，但对刚完成合并的全球纸业巨头构成合规与声誉压力，也可能牵动下游包装成本与客户议价关系，反映监管对上游原材料价格信号的高度敏感。
insights.body: Let Packaging Dive's free newsletter keep you informed, straight from your inbox. The action is related to a grand jury investigation. The company’s subsidiaries are also still defendants in an ongoing class-action price-fixing lawsuit. The U.S. Department of Justice subpoenaed Smurfit Westrock on Sept. 22, according to a securities filing the company released Wednesday morning. This stems from a grand jury investigation in the Northern District of Illinois regarding the pricing and sale of containerboard and related products. Smurfit Westrock said in the filing that it’s “fully cooperating” with the investigation and “believes that its business practices and those of its subsidiaries have been conducted in compliance with U.S. antitrust laws.” “While the Company is currently unable to determine the ultimate outcome of these matters or estimate the range of potential loss due to the early stage of these proceedings, it is possible that an adverse outcome could have a material impact on its financial condition, results of operations, or cash flows,” the document says. Smurfit Westrock did not respond to a request for comments by publication time. Typically when a grand jury is involved, prosecutors have some evidence of an agreement among competitors, according to a Wednesday memo from Adam Josephson, packaging industry analyst and founder of Sakonnet Research. His didn’t find other instances of DOJ price-fixing prosecution related to U.S. containerboard producers in recent decades. Smurfit Westrock also noted in the securities filing that it’s still part of an ongoing class-action containerboard price-fixing lawsuit, which is also playing out in the Northern District of Illinois. The suit was filed in July 2025 and accused producers — including Cascades, International Paper, Packaging Corporation of America and others — of creating a “cartel” and engaging in price collusion to boost profits at the expense of customers. Smurfit Westrock was dismissed from that lawsui
insights.core: 核心并非单一企业是否违规，而是箱板纸这一高度集中、成本传导链条长的上游市场，其定价行为正被置于反垄断审视之下；传票本身即证据有限，却足以说明监管对集中度与价格同步性的警觉，其重要性在于重塑上游定价的合规边界。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：在集中度上升的原材料市场，价格信号的「同步」与「协同」边界如何界定？企业应建立对上游定价机制、合同条款与监管动向的持续追踪视角，并重新验证「成本可预测」这一长期假设。
insights.viewCMI: 从CMI视角看，这是上游成本信号与下游议价结构的博弈：箱板纸价格直接进入品牌商的包装成本，进而影响定价与促销空间。行业集中度提升后，价格同步性易被解读为协同，监管介入会改变成本传导节奏与合同谈判逻辑。长期启发是，快消企业应把上游原材料价格机制纳入常态化监测，而非只盯终端销量与份额；成本端的结构性变化，往往比消费趋势更早决定利润弹性。

insights.title: DS Smith details ‘transformation’ prior to spinning off from IP
insights.summary: DS Smith 在从 International Paper 分拆前，对外详述其业务与运营的“转型”安排，涉及包装企业的组织、产能与战略重心调整。事件本身属公司治理与业务重组范畴，对快消品包装供应链格局有间接影响，但摘要未涉及消费趋势或产品感官层面的实质信息。
insights.body: Let Packaging Dive's free newsletter keep you informed, straight from your inbox. Facility closures, workforce reductions and strategy resets have boosted productivity during the roughly 18 months since being acquired by International Paper, executives said. International Paper is still on track to split into two geographically-oriented companies by the first quarter of 2027 or sooner, executives confirmed during a capital markets day Tuesday. But they still did not signal whether Memphis, Tennessee-based IP would sell the London-based spinoff, after it disclosed in recent weeks that unsolicited bids had cropped up. IP acquired DS Smith in January 2025 and announced in January 2026 that it would split into two independent companies. The legacy North American assets from both companies will be part of International Paper, and the legacy European assets will be part of DS Smith. The new company has 14 paper mills and approximately 180 packaging sites. Tuesday’s event largely focused on the streamlining efforts underway to make the EMEA business more profitable prior to spinning it off as DS Smith. Executives repeatedly highlighted three tenets in the transformation journey: cutting costs, disciplined reinvestment and prioritizing customer relationships. “How do we combine the best from both and create a better organization?” said Tim Nicholls, president of DS Smith, who is widely expected to become that company’s CEO after the split; he was previously IP’s CFO. The optimization has involved numerous site closures, workforce reductions and strategy revamps during the more than a year and a half since International Paper acquired DS Smith. The mid-term focus is for organic investments such as facility upgrades. “We haven't simply focused on improving the business we have. We have fundamentally redesigned our business to make it stronger, simpler and more competitive,” said DS Smith’s Ana Soldo, managing director for East EMEA. As part of the optimization, DS Smith is sh
insights.core: 中心论点是分拆前的转型是主动重塑而非被动剥离，关键在组织与业务结构的重新配置；其重要性在于包装供给端的集中与分化会沿供应链传导至品牌方的成本、交付与创新节奏，值得持续观察。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：包装供给端集中与分拆，会如何改变品牌方的包装创新自由度与可持续承诺兑现节奏？应建立对上游包装产能与资本动作的持续监测视角，而非一次性评估。
insights.viewCMI: 从 CMI 看，这是包装供给端的结构性信号而非消费信号：分拆与转型会改变纸基包装的产能布局、议价能力与服务模式，进而影响快消品牌的包装成本、上市速度与可持续叙事。长期启发是，品牌方需把包装供应商的资本动作纳入供应链与品类增长的监测视野，而非只盯终端消费数据；同时警惕把企业重组误读为消费趋势。

insights.title: CalRecycle lowers plastic tonnage baseline for SB 54 source reduction
insights.summary: 加州CalRecycle下调SB 54塑料源头减量义务的吨位基线，意味着包装生产商需在更低的塑料用量起点上达成减量目标，合规压力与成本结构随之变化。该调整属法规执行口径变化，影响包装设计、材料选择与供应链成本，对快消品牌包装策略形成间接约束。
insights.body: Let Packaging Dive's free newsletter keep you informed, straight from your inbox. Compared with a 2024 estimate, the updated figures suggest lower overall plastic tonnage but a higher number of individual components. CalRecycle originally issued the Source Reduction Baseline Report on Dec. 31, 2024, with estimates for the weight of plastic and number of plastic components associated with plastic covered material sold, offered for sale or distributed in the state in 2023. This updated figure is based on calculations by producer responsibility organization Circular Action Alliance, which solicited company-level data from registered producers earlier this year. “The updated source baseline includes data from 2,127 producers of plastic covered material, accounting for about 50% of total participant producers,” CalRecycle said. The individual source reduction plans were reviewed by CAA but not submitted individually to CalRecycle. In those documents, producers were also supposed to outline source reduction already achieved in the previous decade. Prior to the release of the updated report, researchers at the Benioff Ocean Science Laboratory at UC Santa Barbara analyzed preliminary producer estimates compared with landfill characterization studies and wrote to CalRecycle with concerns. CalRecycle’s update “has consequences beyond accounting,” said Alex Fox, communications specialist with the lab, in an email prior to CalRecycle releasing updated numbers. “A baseline that starts too low shrinks the amount of plastic producers must eliminate.” After seeing the updated report, Fox said the group was “surprised to see the mass for the updated baseline number go down and the number of items go up.” CalRecycle noted that “not all producers have submitted accurate data” and that producers whose data is not yet reflected in the calculation “will be included in a future correction.” Allowable methods for source reduction under SB 54 include implementing reusable or refillable alte
insights.core: 基线下调并非放松监管，而是把减量基准前移，使企业已做的塑料削减难以计入未来达标空间，实质提高了持续减量的边际难度。关键在基准口径而非目标数值，这决定包装合规成本的分摊与创新节奏。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：当合规基线不断前移，包装减量是否会从材料替代转向规格与剂型重构？应建立对监管口径变化与包装成本传导的长期监测视角，并重新验证「可持续包装不损体验」这一假设在更严约束下是否仍成立。
insights.viewCMI: 从CMI看，这是监管口径重塑包装成本曲线的信号：塑料减量从一次性合规变为持续追赶的基准，成本会沿供应链传导至定价与渠道结构。长期启发是，包装可持续性正从营销叙事转为硬性经营约束，品牌需重新评估「已减量」资产的折旧逻辑，并监测消费者对绿色溢价的承受度是否跟得上合规成本上升。

insights.title: Kraft Heinz to sell North American coffee business to private equity firm
insights.summary: 卡夫亨氏将北美咖啡业务出售给私募股权公司，属其组合收缩与聚焦的一环。北美咖啡（含Maxwell House等）长期增长乏力、份额承压，剥离可释放资源投向调味品等高毛利核心品类。对行业而言，这反映包装食品巨头在私募接盘下重构品牌组合的常态，也提示咖啡赛道的渠道与品牌逻辑正被重估。
insights.body: Let Food Dive's free newsletter keep you informed, straight from your inbox. The food giant is offloading brands including Maxwell House and Sanka in a deal that values the segment at $650 million. Since Cahillane took the helm, the former Kellanova executive has wasted little time taking steps to reverse stagnating performance at the storied maker of Oscar Mayer cold cuts, Philadelphia cream cheese and Heinz ketchup. Cahillane paused a plan to split the company, overhauled Kraft Heinz’s operating structure, pledged to invest $700 million in the business and brought brands into trendy categories such as Kraft Mac & Cheese into protein and Jell-O with no artificial colors or sweeteners. Kraft Heinz has reportedly tried to sell underperforming segments like coffee for years, and some analysts have recently speculated that it could make a renewed push under Cahillane to further sharpen the focus around its core portfolio. “This transaction is a meaningful step in unlocking value from our portfolio and will further accelerate the momentum behind our transformation,” Cahillane said in a statement. “Our continued stake reflects the confidence we have in their long-term potential under One Rock's focused ownership.” While the coffee space has been strong, Kraft Heinz was going up against other coffee giants, including Nestlé with Nescafé and Nespresso and J.M. Smucker with Folgers and Dunkin’. The sale allows Kraft Heinz to focus on other higher-growth categories where it has a bigger presence while benefiting from further upside in coffee by retaining a 30% stake. Kraft Heinz on Wednesday said net sales during its third quarter fell 2% to $6.12 billion, with sales in North America, its largest region, slipping 3.4%. The company narrowed its organic net sales forecast to drop between 0.5% and 1.25%, versus an earlier projection of as much as a 2% decline. Cahillane said market share, sales and volume trends are improving in every region compared to a year ago. “We are incr
insights.core: 核心论点：出售并非退出咖啡，而是用组合取舍换取资源集中——把增长乏力的成熟品牌交给更擅长成本与现金流管理的私募。为什么重要：它揭示大食品公司正以「品类聚焦+资产轻化」应对增长焦虑，私募则成为成熟品牌的新宿主。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：传统咖啡品牌的感官价值主张（便捷、熟悉风味）是否仍能支撑溢价？私募持有期内的配方与品质投入会否改变品类感官基准？应建立对成熟品牌「所有权变更—产品感官一致性—消费者感知」链条的长期监测视角。
insights.viewCMI: 从CMI看，这是成熟品牌在消费分层中的位置重估：北美家庭咖啡需求被现制咖啡、精品化与自有品牌分流，传统罐装/烘焙咖啡的品牌溢价被侵蚀，私募接盘意味着营销投入可能转向效率而非品牌建设。以小见大，快消巨头的增长逻辑正从「多品牌覆盖」转向「核心品类深耕+边缘资产变现」，品牌资产的长期维护与短期现金流之间的张力值得持续观察。

insights.title: Mondelēz sues YouTuber’s Joyride candy brand for copying Sour Patch Kids
insights.summary: 亿滋国际起诉YouTuber创立的Joyride糖果品牌，指控其产品抄袭Sour Patch Kids的视觉与品牌标识。事件反映大品牌对新兴网红品牌借势模仿的容忍度下降，也凸显社媒时代品牌资产保护与创作者商业化之间的张力，对快消品牌的知识产权策略与渠道竞争具有示范意义。
insights.body: Let Food Dive's free newsletter keep you informed, straight from your inbox. The snacking giant said Sour Smacks’ designs and colors “cause confusion and unlawfully profit from the goodwill” of the popular gummy treat. Mondelēz International is suing Joyride Sweets for allegedly copying the design of the candy giant's Sour Patch Kids gummies for its "Sour Smacks" brand. The Oreo and Ritz maker claims the candy brand “features nearly identical copies” of Sour Patch Kids’ kid-shaped mascot, as well as yellow and green packaging “intended to copy, and cause confusion.” Joyride began selling sour gummy bears under the generic "sour fruit gummies" name in 2020, according to the lawsuit filed Monday in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Illinois Eastern Division. In 2025, Joyride launched a redesigned version of the sour chewy candy product under the name “Sour Smacks” and featuring humanoid-shaped gummies. "Joyride—true to its name—embarked on a brazen commercial strategy of 'joyriding' on the equity of America’s favorite sour chewy candy brand," according to the lawsuit. “It stole SOUR PATCH KIDS’ popular look, and dared Mondelēz to do something about it. But these KIDS will not be pushed around.” Mondelēz said Joyride and Sour Patch Kids are often sold at the same retailers and frequently appear side by side. Joyride, which includes YouTube content creator Ryan Trahan as a co-owner, leverages that proximity and resulting consumer confusion caused by the similarity of the packaging to “trick” shoppers into buying Joyride instead of Sour Patch Kids, Mondelez claims. The Sour Patch Kids owner said it repeatedly notified private-equity-backed Joyride that it was violating the company’s intellectual property rights, but Joyride refused to act. “Mondelēz is not in the business of suing ... But when, in an attempt to resolve this dispute, Mondelēz repeatedly asked Joyride to cease this infringement, Joyride refused to stop. Mondelēz thus was left with no cho
insights.core: 核心论点在于：网红品牌以「致敬式模仿」快速切入成熟品类，正触碰大品牌的知识产权红线。亿滋选择诉讼而非沉默，说明品牌资产的法律护城河被重新重视；其重要性在于为快消行业划定模仿与侵权的边界，影响后来者的产品与包装设计策略。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：消费者对「熟悉感」的偏好是否正在被网红渠道重新定价？品牌应建立对新兴渠道中模仿型产品的持续监测，并重新验证「视觉/包装识别」在购买决策中的权重是否被低估。
insights.viewCMI: 从CMI看，这是渠道权力转移的缩影：创作者借个人流量与低价模仿品切入成熟糖果品类，实质是以内容资产替代传统品牌资产，争夺货架与注意力。大品牌起诉既是维权，也是防御性市场信号，意在遏制「平替式」蚕食。长期启发是：品牌护城河正从口味记忆转向法律与标识资产的组合，监测新兴渠道中的模仿型竞争者应成为常态视角。

insights.title: Celsius accused of ‘healthwashing’ in class action lawsuit
insights.summary: Food Dive报道称，Celsius因被指在营销中夸大健康属性而遭集体诉讼，被控“健康洗白”（healthwashing）。这折射出功能饮料赛道在高增长与健康宣称合规之间的张力：当品牌以“健康/功能性”作为核心卖点时，宣称边界、证据支撑与消费者预期之间容易失衡，进而演化为法律与声誉风险，并波及品类整体的信任基础。
insights.body: Let Food Dive's free newsletter keep you informed, straight from your inbox. A consumer lawsuit takes issue with the energy drink company’s assertions that the beverage “accelerates metabolism” and “burns body fat.” Health claims are a key target in food and beverage litigation, especially as wellness and ingredients continue to be top priority for consumers and drive purchasing power. Earlier this year, Chobani, Liquid Death and David Protein faced class action complaints over labeling. Celsius has faced similar allegations over its health claims before. In 2011, a consumer in California sued claiming he did not burn calories as advertised, though a judge dismissed the complaint. Attorneys accuse Celsius of working to court consumers who seek fitness and wellness products, as these shoppers are more likely to pay premium prices based on the claims. The lawsuit’s authors are urging Celsius to stop using the claims, as well as cover monetary damages and attorneys fees. “Our products are clearly labeled, as they have been for many years, and go above and beyond FDA requirements,” a Celsius spokesperson wrote in an email. The complaint against Celsius comes as functional energy drinks and consumer demand for healthy beverages are both on the rise, which could prime more shoppers to buy products based on such claims. As more consumers turn to functional foods and beverages, some brands have invested heavily in research to back up those assertions and shield themselves from liability. Celsius has put forward studies on its drink's thermogenic properties, while prebiotic soda brand Olipop is investing to gauge the beverage's impact on gut health. However, these internal studies can also be open to scrutiny. The lawsuit against Celsius claims the research says there is no evidence that drinking the beverage will produce a “meaningful” fat loss without changes to diet and exercise. Reasonable consumers, reading the front of the label, would understand that statement to prom
insights.core: 核心论点是：功能饮料的健康定位一旦缺乏可验证支撑，营销话术就会从增长杠杆转为法律负债。关键不在单起诉讼胜负，而在“健康宣称—证据—消费者预期”三者错配被公开化，这对依赖健康叙事的品类具有警示意义。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：消费者对“健康”的判定依据是成分表、临床证据还是品牌叙事？应建立对健康宣称可信度与品类信任度的持续监测视角，并重新验证“健康定位必然带来溢价与复购”这一长期假设。
insights.viewCMI: 从CMI看，这是功能饮料“健康化溢价”叙事的信任成本显性化。品类增长高度依赖健康动机人群与成分心智，一旦宣称被质疑，受损的不只是单个品牌，而是“功能即健康”的品类联想。结构性趋势是监管、诉讼与社媒放大共同抬高健康宣称的举证门槛，品牌资产将更多由可信证据而非口号累积。长期需监测：健康动机消费者的信任弹性、宣称强度与复购的相关性、以及品类信任被个别事件拖累的溢出效应。

insights.title: Kimberly-Clark completes acquisition of Kenvue
insights.summary: 金佰利完成对Kenvue的收购，标志着快消品行业一次跨品类整合落地。两家公司分别以纸品个护与消费者健康产品见长，合并后将形成覆盖家庭护理、个人护理与健康消费的更大品牌矩阵，改变相关细分市场的竞争格局与渠道议价结构。

The combined portfolio includes 10 billion-dollar brands, such as Huggies, Kleenex, Kotex, Neutrogena, Tylenol, Listerine and Johnson’s Baby. The companies operate across complementary categories, including baby care, women’s health and active aging. Kimberly-Clark said the acquisition is expected to generate approximately US$2.1 billion in annual run-rate synergies. “We share a rich heritage: pioneering entire categories and forming deep, lifelong bonds with consumers around the world as we help generations of people take care of themselves and their loved ones, every day,” said Mike Hsu, chairman and CEO of Kimberly-Clark. “With Kenvue, Kimberly-Clark is equipped to combine deep consumer insight, groundbreaking science and innovation, brand-building expertise and strong commercial execution to lead the future of consumer health.” The company will operate through four business segments: North America, Asia Pacific Focus Markets, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and Enterprise Markets. The completion follows regulatory approval in Australia in September, when the Australian Competi
insights.core: 核心论点是一次以品类边界扩张换取规模与渠道协同的并购：快消巨头通过纳入健康属性资产，从低增长纸品向更高附加值健康消费延伸。其重要性在于渠道与品牌组合的重构，而非单一产品创新。
insights.action: 值得长期监测的是：健康与日常护理的品类边界是否在消费者心智中持续融合，以及并购后的品牌组合是否出现感官与定位上的自我竞争。应建立跨品类的消费者决策路径与品牌信任迁移的长期追踪视角。
insights.viewCMI: 从CMI看，这是快消与健康消费边界加速模糊的又一信号：消费者对「日常护理」与「健康管理」的购买决策正被同一套信任与功效叙事驱动，货架与心智的分类正在重排。合并后的品牌矩阵将强化对零售商的话语权，但也带来定位重叠与品牌稀释风险。长期需追问：健康属性溢价能否迁移到纸品等低关注品类，渠道协同是否真能转化为消费者选择，而非仅是成本端的规模游戏。

insights.title: Inside the unlikely rise of Australia’s camel milk industry
insights.summary: 澳大利亚骆驼奶产业在缺乏传统乳业资源禀赋的条件下形成小众品类，依托耐旱骆驼的独特供给与差异化定位切入市场。其兴起反映小众乳品在成熟乳业格局中寻找缝隙的路径，涉及供给稀缺性、品类教育与渠道渗透等结构性问题，对观察新兴品类如何从边缘走向规模化具有参照价值。

insights.core: 中心论点是骆驼奶在澳大利亚的崛起并非资源驱动，而是稀缺供给与差异化定位在成熟乳品市场中撕开缝隙的结果。其重要性在于揭示小众品类成长依赖品类认知与渠道渗透的长期积累，而非单一产品优势。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：小众乳品的差异化叙事能否转化为可持续的复购基础？应建立对品类认知、价格弹性与渠道渗透的长期监测视角，并持续验证「稀缺性溢价」在品类扩容后是否依然成立。
insights.viewCMI: 从CMI视角看，骆驼奶的机会不在与牛奶正面争夺主流，而在于以稀缺性与差异化叙事占据高价值细分心智，这折射出成熟乳品市场「品类碎片化」的结构性趋势：增量越来越来自边缘品类对特定人群的精准触达。长期启发是，小众品类的天花板取决于能否把「猎奇尝鲜」转化为「稳定复购」，这需要持续监测品类认知度、价格敏感度与渠道可得性三条曲线，而非短期铺货。

insights.title: FMCG has changed. Has its supply chain kept up?
insights.summary: 文章聚焦快消品行业变化下供应链是否同步进化，指出需求碎片化、渠道多元与产品迭代加速正使传统以规模效率为核心的供应链承压。核心议题是供应链能力与市场变化之间的错配，而非单纯成本或物流问题。
insights.body: Search for: × Search for: Latest News Categories Baby Bakery Baking Beverages Breakfast Canned foods Cleaning & pest control Condiments Confectionery Convenience meals Dairy & eggs Deli Fresh produce Frozen Fuel Home & living Liquor Meat, poultry & seafood Pantry Personal care & beauty Pet care Pharmaceuticals Plant-based foods Snackfoods Stationery & games Tobacco Technology Automation Data & analytics Software & systems Channels Supermarkets Convenience Wholesale Direct to consumer E-commerce Hospitality Supply chain Distribution Warehousing Logistics Procurement Wholesale Manufacturing Operations Business Leadership Marketing HR Customer Finance Regulatory Sustainability Startups Login Subscribe Email Login + Australia’s FMCG suppliers run some of the most digitally advanced supply chains in the country. This digitisation dominates operations and efficiency within their DCs, starting at the store point of sale (POS) to drive order management, inventory planning from suppliers, store replenishment, picking, pallet configurations, transport planning and the location within the store a pallet is destined for. For over two decades now, these areas have been a strong focus for Australia’s FMCG sector to become amongst the most advanced in the world. Despite these advancements, there has been a drop in focus on functions which would have been front and centre 30 years ago. This is the physical (not-so) basics, particularly as it relates to freight. So I ask this industry sector: Have the physical elements, particularly when it comes to freight, kept pace with the advancement of data capturing? Few sectors have been pushed as hard to digitise their supply chains as FMCG. To trade with Coles, Woolworths and Aldi, suppliers have had to adopt EDI ordering, keep their product and order data clean, and coordinate freight with retailers who increasingly manage the pickups themselves. Woolworths’ Primary Connect transport business, for example, services thousands of exte
insights.core: 中心论点是快消品的市场逻辑已变，供应链若仍以长周期、大批量、低柔性为假设，将成为增长瓶颈。关键在需求波动性与产品生命周期缩短对补货、库存与产能弹性的挑战，这决定品牌能否把市场机会转化为实际生意。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：需求波动的来源是渠道结构还是消费偏好迁移？应建立对品类生命周期、上新成功率与补货响应速度的持续监测视角，检验供应链柔性是否真正匹配市场变化。
insights.viewCMI: 从CMI视角看，本文折射的是需求端结构性变化倒逼供给端重构：消费分层、渠道碎片化与上新节奏加快，使销量预测与品类生命周期管理难度上升。供应链是否跟得上，本质是品牌响应市场信号的速度问题。长期看，快消竞争将从铺货与规模转向需求感知与柔性履约能力，企业需重新验证「稳定大单品+长周期计划」这一假设是否仍成立。

insights.title: Altos Tequila expands summer lineup with Paloma
insights.summary: Altos Tequila 在夏季产品线中新增 Paloma 即饮/预调形态，属于龙舌兰品类借夏季场景与经典鸡尾酒口味做产品线延伸。对品牌而言是以低门槛、场景化 SKU 扩大触达与货架占位；对品类而言反映龙舌兰从烈酒纯饮向即饮化、风味化迁移的竞争加剧。

Central to the seasonal lineup is the Altos Paloma beverage, which is available exclusively through Coles Liquor Group for an RRP of $26 for a pack of four. The product combines premium tequila with grapefruit and citrus flavour profiles, supported by a broader packaging refresh across the Altos range to enhance retail visibility. Commercial director Glen Scarlett noted that consumer demand for tequila continues to expand across multiple social occasions, driving the company’s focus on accessibility, retail execution, and product innovation. In Pernod Ricard’s promotional campaign, Altos is enhancing its consumer engagement through major hospitality and event partnerships. The brand will return as a partner for the Australian Open in January, following a previous event run that yielded strong purchase intent scores and commercial sales volume. Meanwhile, the brand is entering the quick-service restaurant sector through a partnership with Guzman y Gomez. Beginning December 1, the Altos margarita lime product will launch across 70 licensed Guzman y Gomez restaurants in Queen
insights.core: 核心不是多一个 SKU，而是龙舌兰品牌以 Paloma 这一高认知度鸡尾酒做即饮化延伸，用场景与熟悉风味降低尝试门槛、争夺夏季即饮货架。其重要性在于：品类增长正从纯饮教育转向便利化与风味化的渠道竞争。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：即饮化延伸究竟扩大品类新客，还是仅在既有饮用者间分流？应建立对「场合覆盖度、首次尝试转化、复购留存」的持续监测视角，而非以单次上新成败判断品类走向。
insights.viewCMI: 从 CMI 看，这是龙舌兰品类由「烈酒教育」转向「即饮场景争夺」的结构性信号：夏季、户外、即饮渠道是增量入口，而 Paloma 的既有认知可降低消费者首次尝试成本。品牌以产品线延伸而非新品牌切入，反映其在货架占位与品类心智之间求平衡。长期启发是：品类扩张的瓶颈正从口味教育转向场合覆盖与渠道可得性，谁能占据更多饮用场合，谁就更可能把品类热度转化为复购。

insights.title: Recall: Pump Spring Water – all products
insights.summary: Inside FMCG 报道 Pump 品牌全线泉水产品被召回，涉及该品牌所有 SKU，属食品安全与质量事件。召回通常源于潜在污染或标签合规问题，会直接冲击渠道库存、终端动销与品牌信任，并可能引发零售商下架与消费者信心波动。事件本身信息有限，但反映出快消品在质量治理与供应链透明度上的持续压力。

insights.core: 全线召回意味着问题可能出在共性环节（水源、灌装或标签），而非单一批次；其重要性在于，瓶装水的差异化本就薄弱，信任一旦受损，恢复成本远高于价格促销所能弥补，质量治理因此成为品牌资产的核心变量。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：瓶装水的品牌溢价究竟建立在哪些可验证的信任信号上？企业应建立对质量事件传播路径与消费者信心恢复曲线的持续监测视角，并重新检验「低价与便利足以抵消安全疑虑」这一假设是否成立。
insights.viewCMI: 从 CMI 看，瓶装水是低卷入、高复购、以信任为锚的品类，全线召回会放大「安全」这一基础属性的权重，短期引发渠道下架与竞品替代，长期则考验品牌能否把透明度转化为信任资产。结构性趋势是：消费者对食品安全的敏感度持续上升，社交媒体放大负面信号，品牌需把质量事件纳入常态化的声誉与渠道韧性管理，而非一次性公关。

insights.title: More than $1.2 billion in alcohol tax to go uncollected in growing trend
insights.summary: 报道称，在某种持续增长的行业趋势下，超过12亿美元的酒精税将无法被征收，涉及酒类销售与税收征管之间的结构性缺口。这一现象同时牵动公共财政、渠道结构与消费行为，提示酒类市场的实际流通可能正偏离既有税制假设，其规模已足以影响行业与政策判断。
insights.body: Search for: × Search for: Latest News Categories Baby Bakery Baking Beverages Breakfast Canned foods Cleaning & pest control Condiments Confectionery Convenience meals Dairy & eggs Deli Fresh produce Frozen Fuel Home & living Liquor Meat, poultry & seafood Pantry Personal care & beauty Pet care Pharmaceuticals Plant-based foods Snackfoods Stationery & games Tobacco Technology Automation Data & analytics Software & systems Channels Supermarkets Convenience Wholesale Direct to consumer E-commerce Hospitality Supply chain Distribution Warehousing Logistics Procurement Wholesale Manufacturing Operations Business Leadership Marketing HR Customer Finance Regulatory Sustainability Startups Login Subscribe Email Login + The Australian Taxation Office (ATO) has warned of a growing amount of uncollected tax on alcohol products due to the rise in the illicit market. This gap is expected to reach $1.23 billion, or 13.7 per cent of the total amount, in 2024 to 2025. The ATO said this is approximately a 0.4 per cent increase year-on-year. In 2015, the gap stood at 9.3 per cent. An estimated $1.06 billion, or 91.8 per cent of the gap, is from the shadow economy, the ATO added. Illicit alcohol activities known to the ATO include unauthorised manufacturing, unpaid excise duty, product diversion, cross-border transactions and deliberate fraud or evasion. “The alcohol tax gap includes excise and customs duties payable for beer, spirits and other excisable beverages,” the ATO explains. “It doesn’t include wine, which we estimate separately.” “Like all excise gaps, when excise rates increase, the value of the gap in dollar terms will increase even if overall levels of compliance remain the same. It is for this reason that we focus on the tax gap percentage when considering the change in the gap between years.” Alcohol excise rates in Australia are reviewed twice a year, with changes made in line with the consumer price index (CPI). They were most recently changed on August 3, whic
insights.core: 核心并非单一漏税事件，而是酒类消费与流通方式变化正使传统按渠道征收的税基持续侵蚀；超12亿美元的量级说明缺口已成结构性而非偶发，税制假设与市场现实脱节，值得作为长期观察指标。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：现有税基假设建立在怎样的渠道与消费结构上？哪些需求正流向统计盲区？应建立以消费行为而非征收节点为锚的长期监测框架，持续追踪税负感知、渠道替代与品类迁移之间的关系。
insights.viewCMI: 从CMI看，税收缺口是消费迁移的影子指标：跨境购买、非正规渠道与自制/替代品消费，往往先于官方统计显现。它折射渠道权力从受监管零售向灰色与线上转移，价格弹性与税负感知正在重塑购买路径。长期启发是：评估酒类市场不能只看合规渠道销量，应把「未征税流通」视为需求真实分布的信号，重建覆盖全渠道的消费监测视角。

insights.title: Comparative Metabolomic and Transcriptomic Analysis of Flavonoid Accumulation in the Zest and Pith of Guang Foshou at Green and Ripe Stages
insights.core: 该研究以广佛手为对象，用代谢组与转录组比较青果期与成熟期黄皮层与白皮层中黄酮积累差异，定位组织与成熟度特异的代谢与基因调控基础。其价值在于把风味相关物质积累落到组织层级与发育阶段，为感官品质的成因提供可追溯的生化解释。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：组织与成熟度特异的代谢差异，能否稳定映射到可感知的苦/涩阈值变化？应建立跨品种、跨成熟度的感官—代谢同步监测视角，而非依赖单点成分含量推断感官品质。
insights.viewSensory: 该文把黄酮积累拆到黄皮层与白皮层、青果与成熟两个维度，提示感官研究不能只以整果均质样本推断风味，组织异质性与成熟度是描述性感官差异的物质基础。其范式意义在于：感官属性应被理解为随发育与部位变化的动态谱，而非固定标签。长期启发是建立感官—代谢联合图谱，让苦感、涩感等属性的来源可定位、可复现，而非停留在终端评价。

insights.title: Valorization of agro-industrial beetroot peel waste (Beta vulgaris L.) as a natural colorant: chemical characterization and consumer-oriented sensory perception.
insights.summary: 该研究以甜菜根加工副产物（甜菜根皮废弃物）为原料制备天然着色剂，完成化学表征并开展面向消费者的感官知觉测评。其价值在于把副产物资源化、天然色素开发与消费者感官接受度放在同一链条中考察，为天然着色剂的可行性评估提供了化学与感官双重证据。

insights.title: Flavor characteristics and key compounds of jasmine tea prepared by one-step yellowing-scenting strategy: insights from sensory evaluation, metabolomic analysis and molecular docking.
insights.summary: 该研究以一步黄化-窨制（yellowing-scenting）工艺制备茉莉花茶，整合感官评价、代谢组学与分子对接，识别其风味特征与关键化合物，并尝试在化合物与嗅觉受体结合层面解释感知差异。其价值在于把工艺变量、化学组成与感官结果连成可检验的证据链。

insights.title: Alcohol consumption and dietary quality among adults with clinical and preclinical obesity attending a specialized obesity clinic in Portugal: a cross-sectional study
insights.summary: 该研究以葡萄牙某肥胖专科门诊的临床与临床前肥胖成人为对象，横断面考察饮酒与膳食质量的关系。其价值不在酒类市场，而在提示：在体重管理人群中，酒精摄入可能是膳食质量与能量摄入的混杂变量，为产品感官设计与无酒精/低酒精替代品的开发提供了人群侧写。

insights.core: 核心论点是肥胖门诊人群的饮酒行为与膳食质量存在关联，且需在临床体重管理语境下被识别和干预。关键支撑来自专科门诊样本的横断面设计，其意义在于把酒精从单纯的嗜好品重新定位为膳食质量与体重管理的一部分，而非独立的市场消费议题。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：酒精在感官体验中承担的“风味结构”功能能否被非酒精体系替代，以及体重管理人群的感官偏好是否随膳食质量变化而系统性迁移；应建立人群感官偏好与膳食质量的长期对照视角。
insights.viewSensory: 从感官研究看，该文虽不测感官属性，却提示酒精作为风味载体（乙醇的灼热感、香气溶剂效应、苦味与甜味平衡）在肥胖人群的饮食体验中可能被低估。若产品开发面向体重管理人群，无酒精/低酒精替代品的感官补偿——如何用风味结构复现酒精带来的口感厚度与余味——是值得长期追问的感官设计命题，而非简单减糖减脂。

insights.title: Limosilactobacillus reuteri ameliorates diet-associated metabolic dysfunction in PCOS-like rats: associations with intestinal lipid remodeling and GPR120-related regulation
insights.summary: 《Frontiers in Nutrition》发表大鼠研究，发现罗伊氏粘液乳杆菌可改善饮食相关PCOS样代谢功能障碍，关联肠道脂质重塑与GPR120相关调控。属机制层面的动物实验证据，未涉及人体感官评价或消费者行为，对快消品的产品感官设计与市场策略暂无直接可迁移结论。

insights.core: 核心论点是菌株干预经由肠道脂质重塑与GPR120通路缓解PCOS样代谢紊乱；证据来自PCOS样大鼠模型，属益生菌-宿主代谢互作的机制探索，价值在于为功能原料的生物学合理性提供早期动物证据，但距人体有效性与感官可接受性尚远。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：动物模型中的代谢机制证据在何种剂量与基质下能转化为人体可感知、可接受的产品？功能原料的「功效-感官代价」权衡应建立为常态化评估框架，而非等机制成熟后再补感官验证。
insights.viewSensory: 从感官研究视角看，本文只触及产品的「上游」——原料的生理功能假设，完全未涉及风味、质地、香气等感官属性与人群感知差异。益生菌功能宣称若要落地为可消费产品，必须面对菌株代谢物带来的异味、发酵风味与质构适配等感官代价，以及描述性测评与偏爱性测试中的个体差异。这提示功能原料研究需尽早与感官设计并行，否则机制再漂亮也可能止步于适口性门槛。

insights.title: Functional food intervention alleviates cognitive impairment by reshaping the gut microbiota and restoring propionate levels: evidence from edible bird’s nest supplementation
insights.summary: 该研究发表于 Frontiers in Nutrition，通过燕窝补充实验提出功能性食品可经重塑肠道菌群、恢复丙酸水平来缓解认知障碍。其价值在于把功能功效与肠-脑轴机制相连，为功能食品 claim 提供生物学路径；但作为机制研究，尚未回答感官接受度与消费者支付意愿问题。

insights.core: 核心论点是功能食品的认知益处并非直接作用，而是经由肠道菌群与丙酸代谢介导，燕窝作为载体提供了证据。其重要性在于把「功能」从模糊宣称落到可测量的代谢标志物，但样本与人群外推性仍需检验。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：功效标志物能否与感官接受度、日常摄入依从性建立联合模型？应建立「功效—感官—依从」的长期监测视角，而非仅验证单一机制。
insights.viewSensory: 从感官研究看，该文只触及功效机制，未涉及风味、质地与接受度。燕窝的感官特征（胶质感、气味清淡）恰是长期依从性的关键变量，而依从性直接决定功效能否在真实消费中兑现。长期启发是：功能食品研发应把「有效剂量下的感官可接受性」前置，而非事后补救。

insights.title: School-based nutrition interventions conducted in Greece and the Republic of Cyprus: a scoping review
insights.summary: 该文以范围综述方法系统梳理希腊与塞浦路斯两国校园营养干预研究，聚焦干预设计、实施与评价方式。作为感官研究主题文献，它间接揭示儿童味觉偏好与食物接受度在校园场景中的被忽视程度，对理解地中海地区儿童饮食行为塑造具有参考价值。

insights.core: 综述核心在于呈现两国校园营养干预的研究图谱与证据缺口，而非验证某一具体感官机制。其价值在于暴露：现有干预多从营养教育切入，较少将感官测评与食物接受度纳入设计与评价，导致干预效果与儿童真实进食行为之间存在脱节。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：校园场景中，感官接受度与营养知识之间的因果链究竟如何？应建立跨地区、跨年龄的儿童食物偏好与感官描述长期监测视角，检验「感官暴露先于教育」这一假设是否稳健。
insights.viewSensory: 从感官研究视角看，该综述折射出校园干预长期以知识灌输为主、感官维度缺席的范式局限。儿童食物接受度受风味、质地、重复暴露与厌恶学习共同塑造，若干预设计不纳入描述性与偏爱性测评，就难以解释「知道却不愿吃」的落差。长期启发在于：感官测评应前置于干预设计，成为连接营养目标与真实摄食行为的桥梁，而非事后附加的评价工具。

insights.title: Context matters: fermented foods and the gut microbiota
insights.summary: 《Frontiers in Nutrition》一篇观点文章强调发酵食品对肠道菌群的作用受「情境」制约，涉及食物基质、菌株、摄入方式与个体差异等因素。这提示发酵食品的健康效应不能一概而论，感官属性与消费场景同样是影响研究结论与产品沟通的重要变量。

insights.core: 核心论点是发酵食品与肠道菌群的因果关系高度依赖情境，包括产品基质、发酵工艺、食用方式与人群差异，因此脱离情境的泛化结论不可靠。其重要性在于为发酵食品的功效宣称与产品设计划定了边界，提醒研究需控制情境变量。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：发酵食品的感官属性在何种食用情境下稳定可复现？个体感知差异与菌群差异如何共同调节体验？应建立把感官评价与食用情境、人群特征同步记录的长期监测视角，而非追逐单次结论。
insights.viewSensory: 该文将「情境」置于发酵食品感官与健康关联的中心，意味着感官研究不能只测孤立样品的风味或质地，而须把基质、发酵工艺、搭配食用与个体感知差异纳入设计。这折射出从静态属性描述转向情境化感知评价的范式变化；长期看，描述性分析与偏爱性测试都需记录食用情境，否则感官结论难以外推，也难以支撑产品沟通。

insights.title: Foodservice Price Index September 2026
insights.summary: NielsenIQ 发布2026年9月食品服务价格指数，以月度价格追踪反映全球餐饮供应链成本变动。该指数为行业提供成本传导与定价环境的量化参照，对评估餐饮渠道通胀压力、菜单定价空间及食品饮料厂商的渠道利润具有基准意义。

insights.core: 指数本身不是新闻，而是持续监测工具：其价值在于揭示食品服务渠道成本的月度方向与波动幅度，为判断餐饮端定价压力、供应商议价环境提供可比较的时间序列证据，而非单点结论。
insights.action: 应长期追问：餐饮渠道成本变动如何跨渠道传导至零售定价与消费者价格敏感度？哪些关于渠道利润分配与提价能力的假设需要周期性重验？宜建立成本指数与终端价格、客流联动的长期监测视角。
insights.viewCMI: 食品服务价格指数属于典型的外部市场信号，其意义不在单月数值，而在成本向菜单价、客流与渠道结构的传导链条。持续跟踪可区分周期性波动与结构性涨价：若成本上行而终端提价受限，餐饮渠道将挤压供应商毛利并加速自有品牌与集中采购。长期启发是，快消企业需把餐饮渠道成本指数纳入与零售价格指数并列的监测框架，理解渠道间的替代与利润再分配，而非仅视其为采购参考。

insights.title: What is NIQ Consumer Life?
insights.summary: NielsenIQ 推出「Consumer Life」这一消费者洞察产品，意在把分散的消费行为数据整合为对消费者生活状态的整体刻画，服务于品牌与零售商的决策。其信号意义在于：市场研究正从单点购买数据转向对消费者全生活场景的持续追踪，数据供应方正重新定义「消费者理解」的交付形态。

insights.core: 核心论点是把消费者从「购买者」还原为「生活者」，以生活场景而非品类边界组织洞察。关键不在产品本身，而在数据整合逻辑的转向——这决定未来品牌能否在品类之外识别需求。其重要性在于，它可能改变甲方评估洞察价值的标准。
insights.action: 值得长期追问：以「生活场景」组织洞察，是否会系统性低估产品本身的感官差异对复购的驱动？应建立一套能同时观测场景需求与产品感知体验的长期监测视角，并持续验证「场景解释力」是否真的优于品类解释力。
insights.viewCMI: 这是典型的 CMI 供给侧演进：从品类份额、渗透率等结果指标，转向以生活场景为单位的需求结构描述。折射的结构性趋势是，品牌增长逻辑正从「抢份额」转向「找场景增量」，渠道与定价决策越来越依赖跨品类的生活形态数据。长期启发在于：当数据颗粒度细化到生活事件，CMI 的价值不再是解释已发生的购买，而是预判尚未被品类定义的需求；但场景化数据易产生相关性幻觉，因果与可执行性仍需警惕。

insights.title: Preparing For The Next Wave Of Weight Loss Drug Adoption Snap Chart
insights.summary: 贝恩以图表形式梳理减肥药（GLP-1类）采用率持续攀升的下一波趋势，提示快消品企业需预判用药人群扩大对食品饮料消费场景、份量与品类结构的连带影响。文章属市场层面的前瞻性观察，未涉及具体感官属性或测评方法。
insights.body: Bookmark content that interests you and it will be saved here for you to read or share later. Bookmark content that interests you and it will be saved here for you to read or share later. By 2030, we expect nearly one in three US adults will have used a GLP-1 medication such as Ozempic. By Sarah Hershey, Dan Topler-Garcia, Ruth Lewis, Sonal Dash, and Daniela Carbinato en The hidden drivers of GLP-1 adoption GLP-1 drugs have already had a material impact on consumer behavior. Pyxis by Bain data from credit card transactions suggests that GLP-1 users in the US spend about 3% to 4% less on groceries overall across categories and about 5% less on fast food. Our expectation that GLP-1 usage will surge between now and 2030 is based on a broad range of likely developments, including a reduction in both the price of the drugs and their side effects, growth in direct-to-consumer sales in the US, and access to GLP-1 treatments through European private clinics. Adoption could end up being even higher than our forecasts due to factors that are harder to quantify accurately, such as intermittent use of GLP-1 drugs by consumers (microdosing), off-label adoption, and gray market access in certain countries. For consumer packaged goods companies (CPGs), grocers, and restaurant brands, the appropriate strategic response will vary according to industry and category exposure. However, it’s crucial that all exposed companies build the data, technology, and ecosystem capabilities to stay close to rapidly changing consumer behavior. Data powered by Dynata, a leading global first-party data and insights platform. We work with ambitious leaders who want to define the future, not hide from it.
